reviewsWithKeywords.title: Extreme Seaweed on the Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Staying at Occidental Punta Cana right now. (January 23, 2026) Bavaro Beach is as wonderful as ever, EXCEPT that this year the seaweed buildup is the worst that I have wver seen. It is a foot high on the beach here every day. The ocean is full of it to the point that swimming is not possible without getting weed all over you. If seaweed on the beach is something that bothers you, I’d recommend the Caribbean side beaches at Bayahibe at the moment. They do their best at removing it here at Bavaro. The rake machine went down the beach at 7 am yesterday and by 10:30 am the beach was full of weed again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The island is beautiful but the things around it overshadowed the experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I want to share my experience. To begin with, I had a very good day visiting Saona Island. Now I would like to talk about the problematic points.First, the morning driver picks you up at 7:45 a.m. to take you to a meeting point, but the actual departure is only around 9:30/10 a.m.Once I arrived in Bayahibe, a man who introduced himself as the owner touched me to pull up my dress because, according to him, my chest was showing too much. I did not feel any malicious intent, but it was clearly inappropriate and unacceptable.Then, there was an incident on the way back. On the way there, the driver picked me up at the correct address, but on the way back, the new driver, Alfri, tried twice to drop me off at the wrong location. He seemed annoyed and was mocking me. Other passengers in the car, concerned for my safety, told me not to speak to him because they were getting off and I would be the last one remaining. Once everyone had left, he calmed down and started making jokes about the fact that he was “Moreno” and I was “negrita,” “very black black black.” In my country, this would be considered colorism.I wanted to share my experience because you will have single women booking with you, and it is important that they feel safe and comfortable with the behavior of your team.I contacted customer service (Andy) to ask for the owner’s contact information so I could share my experience directly, but he refused to provide any contact.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: From Kenya to Punta Cana: An Incredible Experience!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My first time in Punta Cana, and wow — what an unforgettable experience!We stayed in nearby apartments just a short walk from the beach, and everything about the stay was fantastic. Even with the language barrier, Google Translate made communication easy and added to the fun of the experience.The food was absolutely delicious, the drinks were flowing and refreshing, and the overall vibe was warm, welcoming, and full of life. I’m from Kenya, and it was a pleasant surprise to meet people from Haiti who knew about Kenya because of our peacekeeping mission there — such a small world moment that made the trip even more special.I would go back in a heartbeat. Punta Cana is vibrant, beautiful, and full of great people. Highly recommended — this is a must-visit destination! 🌴✨

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good beach not that great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place but too expensive. Beach is clean, too overcrowded. Perfect weather, good for families and solo trip. Felt little unsafe

reviewsWithKeywords.title: mix of calm sailing and glimpses of marine life
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I appreciated how the guides respected the environment and explained local conservation efforts. Photo opportunities were everywhere , sandbanks, palm trees, and water so clear it felt unreal. Lunch on the beach featured fresh seafood and local dishes that were delicious and authentic. The boat ride there was smooth and scenic, with a nice mix of calm sailing and glimpses of marine life.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: genuine warmth of the local staff
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Saona Island felt like stepping into a postcard: endless white sand, clear turquoise water, and gentle breezes. Lunch on the beach featured fresh seafood and local dishes that were delicious and authentic. The boat ride there was smooth and scenic, with a nice mix of calm sailing and glimpses of marine life. What stood out most was the relaxed island vibe and the genuine warmth of the local staff.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Photo opportunities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Photo opportunities were everywhere â€” sandbanks, palm trees, and water so clear it felt unreal. The boat ride there was smooth and scenic, with a nice mix of calm sailing and glimpses of marine life. Overall, an unforgettable day that balanced adventure and relaxation perfectly. reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overestimated experience

Wi-fi, drinks, etc. There are much more beautiful beaches in Brazil, closer and with less stress to get to.I indicate other tours in RD.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over crowded and poor facilities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was so dissapointing.We was collected at 7.30am and returned to hotel at 8.30pmThe facilities were extremely poor all the toilets were blocked the showers were trickling a small a.ount of water not enough to even rinse sand off.You are constantly badgered by the looky looky men.The food was veey good and enough loungers.The boats are so overfilled and we only actually got 2.5hrs on the island. reviewsWithKeywords.title: A true paradise facing the sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I give this resort 5 stars because it exceeded all our expectations. From the moment we arrived, the staff was very friendly, always attentive and with a smile. The pool is spectacular, spacious and clean, ideal for relaxing at any time of day.The oceanfront location is unbeatable. Waking up to the view of the Caribbean Sea and walking along the white sand beach is simply a dream. The facilities are very well maintained, with beautiful gardens and perfect spaces to relax or enjoy as a couple or family.The food was another highlight: the buffet was very varied, with fresh, quality options. We also tried some a la carte restaurants and everything was delicious.The room was comfortable, clean, and had an incredible view. The whole atmosphere is one of total tranquility and enjoyment.I recommend this place 100%, whether for a romantic getaway or a family vacation. We will definitely be back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Adalgiza at Barcelo Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We met Adalgiza Rosa during our stay at the resort, and she was amazing! Super friendly, always on top of our drink orders, and just had the best energy. She really added something special to our trip. If you’re at the resort and she’s working—you're in great hands!

reviewsWithKeywords.text: The usual all inclusive. Nothing bad. A couple things above average including good variety of à la carte restaurants, lazy river and surf facility. Service and rooms are average. Many of the 1st floor rooms with swim out are musty and stinky.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A Mixed Bag: 3-Star Experience at a Supposed 5-Star Resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My stay at this resort from May 17th to May 20th was a combination of enjoyment and significant letdowns. I'm rating it 3 stars because, for a resort that markets itself as 5-star and charges accordingly, it failed to deliver on many fronts.Arrival & Room:Upon arriving at the Babaro Beach front desk, we were met with an uncomfortable 28°C (approx. 82°F) temperature due to poor air conditioning and ventilation – it felt like we were baking.The rooms are very dated and in clear need of refurbishment.Pros: The TV had hundreds of channels, and the complimentary minibar with drinks was a welcome touch. Thankfully, the A/C and ceiling fans in the room worked well.Cons: The room's condition was poor: peeling paint, worn-out doors, dirty light switches, and a persistent, unpleasant smell reminiscent of drains.Resort Grounds & Amenities:Views & Beach: The views are nice, though not exceptional compared to other Caribbean resorts. The beach, a bay with crystal-clear water, is beautiful and rich with marine life. Some seaweed was present, but this is a natural process and not a negative in my view. However, shaded spots were scarce; you either had to arrive very early or wait until around 5 PM for the sun to lessen.Pool & Bar (Babaro Beach): The Babaro Beach pool was a solid 8/10. Though the jacuzzi area was small, the main pool was large, well-maintained, and enjoyable. The absolute standout was the open bar – it was incredible! The bartenders were 10/10, exceeding all expectations with their service and friendliness.Major Disappointments:Organization & Logistics: A major source of frustration was the poor organization of events, dining, and access to facilities.Gym: Guests from the adults-only Babaro Beach section had to walk 15 minutes in 30°C+ (86°F+) heat to reach the gym. The gym itself was poorly equipped, with only three small lockers and, shockingly, just one bathroom.Dining: Reaching the à la carte restaurants at the Babaro Palace meant another 20-minute walk in the sun. The shuttle service offered (a 5-minute ride) often had a 15-minute wait time, which was ridiculous.Food Quality: The buffet food quality was generally low.Casino: My father and I went to the casino hoping for some fun, but more than half the machines were broken. Worse, the dealers at the roulette and blackjack tables had terrible, unwelcoming attitudes, lacking any charisma or effort to make guests feel comfortable. The service was appalling.Disco: The disco was just okay – a bit small. Compared to everything else, it seemed fine at the time, but in reality, it wasn't impressive.Overall:Three days at this resort felt like more than enough. Staying longer would have likely meant either confining myself to the subpar room or risking illness from the food. This resort has potential, but it urgently needs to address its maintenance, organizational issues, and staff training in certain areas to justify its 5-star claim and pricing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Barcelo bavaro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The views and entertainment are great. Amazing beach, pool and food variety. The best was the service, staff is great. Nathali Mota texted us everyday to see if we need something for the room or in general, and to be sure that we are having a good time, she is very professional and caring. reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good white-sand beach, firm footing, no pebbles/stones.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Okay, I am specifically reviewing the area from the south-east end at Barcelo Bavaro up to Huracan Beach Club (which I will call the north-west end).  There are a ton of nice-looking beach-front properties along this area — I stayed at Barcelo Bavaro Palace at the south-east end.  The beach starts narrow at the south-east and gently widens out the further north-west you get, but the beach was not crowded.  In general, the beaches are near-white sand, and fairly easy to walk on, it seeming to compact to a firm footing.  Practically no pebbles or stones to speak of.  When I did a 2-mile hike along the beach, the going was easy, although I preferred my beach sneakers on for the cushioning — plenty of folks go barefoot though.  The water is warm and calm, partly due to a lot of hotels/resorts putting out wave-calming bouys/nets.  The amount of seaweed varies, and at the south-east it is at its least, and gets heavier towards the north-west, to the point where in a couple of places they are actively harvesting seaweed washed up on the beach.  Fresh seaweed is fine, but the stuff drying out can harbour a bunch of little insects, so be careful.  I did get bitten on the ankles a couple of times in the shallows, but it seems I was in the minority, and there were plenty of unblemished folks out there.  The further north-west you go, the more “sales people” you will encounter — none of them too pushy, but they are trying to sell anything, from fishing trips and speedboat rides, to cigars and “other smoke-ables”, to photo opportunities with parrots and lizards.  For your own entertainment, if you have a tiny bit of bread, you can crumble it up into the shallows, and tiny almost invisible little silver fish will appear frenzied for the food.  Other wildlife included pelicans, a ray I saw from the waters edge, some sort of birds of prey soaring majestically, and probably some mollusks — I saw evidence of their holes, but refused to dig them up from their homes to find out.  Most of the resorts have shade of some sort — the Barcelo has largely palm trees, and the further north-west you go, they rely more on cabana-type shelters.  The sun can be fierce, so remember to top up on sunscreen and take bottled water with you.  Yes, you can run along the beach, but not many folk were — it’s hot, and nice to enjoy at “island-pace” stroll speed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A perfect beach for a delicate sunrise photoshoot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A perfect beach for a delicate sunrise photoshoot: serene mornings with few people, a gentle breeze, and the soft glow of the sun rising over the ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach and pool - good for family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was a fine hotel.  I was looking for a hotel with a lot to do for my 4 kids and a beautiful ocean, and this fit the bill.  The ocean was super calm and shallow.  We saw turtles and rays and fish swimming around and it was magical.  There were lots of waterslides and pools for the kids and they loved it.  I did not love having to use the cards to exchange for towels - it is such a bother and does not feel like a 5 star resort.  The food was terrible.They were able to get us connecting rooms and that was very nice and it was a great set up for our family of 6.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see when in the DR
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach it beautiful! One of the best beaches I’ve ever seen!! The views look like they been taken from a postcard. If you’re in the DR this is a must do!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaria Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaria beach is beautiful and there are many activities to do. The resorts are located on the beach and are next to each other so it would be difficult to get a good place to lounge on the beach without a reservation at one of the resorts. The vendors come nonstop to try to sell their products and services. They will go away when told that you’re not interested but as soon as one leaves another is right behind them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An amazing beach to relax and enjoy the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is amazing, with soft, calm sand, no peddling and calm waves to get into the sea and enjoy the warm water of the Caribbean. There are very good resorts in this area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at Grand Palladium, the beach very nice, turquoise water with some waves, white sand! Spectacular for morning or sunset walking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bravo Bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is stunning, I much preferred Bavaro beach to Macao beach. We stayed at the grand Bavaro Princess, platinum club and the Bavaro private beach here was stunning

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Breathtaking Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely breathtaking beach. One of the most beautiful ones I've ever seen and I've been around quite a few. It's been years since we've been there, but I'm dying to go back.!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sublime!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, perfect for a long walk while admiring the breathtaking turquoise of the ocean! Very nice to swim there too! We loved it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Harassment, low level place.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Most disappointing choice. Horrible location especially for ladies, harassment on streets when you walk to the beach and cars full of locals stop and call you to join them to the car or whistle to a woman like to a dog. Makes you feel as if they just got out from jail and see women first time. At the beach people always need something from you- to sell you something, to offer you escort or pick you up. If you’re a woman and don’t walk on a leash with your man, local men who work at the beach may ask out loud so everyone can hear if you work at night and how much you cost. They know you don’t, but it’s fun to humiliate women for their culture. They don’t know whats respect, don’t keep a distance and come really close, some are aggressive and don’t take no as an answer. No way to sit and have a snack with the sea view or relax under the sun. People can walk their dogs at the beach and even stop right in front of you to let them do their toilet without any “Im so sorry”, no it’s your problem if you don’t like sunbathing or eating near dog toilet. Besides hotels security like Vista Sol can kick you out as if you’re homeless or illegal here even you stay here forever and come to sit at same places, but today you can and tomorrow you can’t sit. So you buy or rent a home but even the beach is for public but hotels treat ppl as if it’s their place and we should be very careful where to step, where to be so brave and spoiled to sit (with security breathing to your back just in case you cross invisible line). As a result no way to normally reach the beach without stress, stay at the beach in peace with comfort or even walk. About comfort-this beach doesn’t offer sunbeds. I have to go far away from here to another beach to rest and have better conditions and more friendly and respectful environment. Definitely last time in this country and will never recommend to have such a low level experience to my friends.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach at punta cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: nice long beach, very busy in high season,  water isn't  cold,  staff sweep seaweed a mess from ocean. this beach is definitely in top 3 for us

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very negative
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I state that I never write reviews. .. let alone negative. STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE.Booked for 3 nights a superior beachfront room. Exorbitant price for the service offered. Inedible food. You can access various restaurants outside of the all inclusive but they are always reserved or you have to queue to access them. The sea has nothing Caribbean full of algae. And last but not least golf. We had included green fees in the package, too bad that the golf cart (worst thing not reported the price on their site) costs 85 dollars per person , so in two 170 euros

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Райский остров
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited the wonderful Lopesan hotel, and its diversity really impressed us! There are a total of eight restaurants in the resort, but one of them became our absolute favorite. This restaurant offers an incredible variety of dishes from different national cuisines, and we were completely delighted. We went there for breakfast, lunch and dinner: we liked it so much! Each dish was prepared with dedication and its taste was simply unforgettable.I want to highlight especially the staff, always friendly and professional, who gave us attention and care, making each visit comfortable and pleasant.Special thanks to the chef, Nelson Mantela. I even joked that maybe he's Nelson Mandela's son, because his charisma and hospitality are really fascinating. When he appeared in the room, the atmosphere became even warmer and more inspiring. It seemed that his energy set the pace for the whole restaurant, even the clocks seemed to follow his beat!I recommend this place to everyone who appreciates exquisite cuisine, high quality service and a welcoming atmosphere. We'll definitely be back!
The beach is very beautiful and lively (I went on a Sunday). The guys selling photos with araras and lizards spoiled a bit of the experience, sad for the animals.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach, Sun and fun!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach is one of my favorite beaches. Soft white sand and crystal clear waters. At the time I went, unfortunately it was a little bit windy but still had a great time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: the tan was great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had an amazing time at this beach – definitely one of my favorite spots for sunbathing and relaxation! The sand was soft and clean, and the water was crystal clear with just the right temperature for a refreshing dip. But the best part? The tan! After just a few hours, I was glowing with the perfect sun-kissed tan. The beach has just the right amount of sunlight, and there’s a nice breeze that keeps things comfortable, even in the hottest hours of the day.I also loved how peaceful the atmosphere was, without being too crowded. It was the ideal place to unwind and enjoy the sun without any distractions. If you're looking to get a great tan and enjoy a beautiful, serene beach day, this place is a must-visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just for a walk if you're in a resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a very long beach with hard, flat sand that you can walk endlessly. The sand is fine and white and the sea has a spectacular turquoise color that contrasts with the white waves. I didn't like that walking all the time you come across people from the resorts and you hear the music of each resort. There's some stretch where it's not easy to get through and you can get hurt. It's okay only if you're staying at a resort but to go to see that beach I don't recommend it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went there early in morning and water was very clean. We think it is the best beach we have ever seen. We liked it so much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Palladium Bavaro and went to that area of Bavaro Square. Very nice, beautiful sunrise so you don't miss it. We parasailled on the beach, beautiful. Beautiful colors

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Simply fantastic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful hotel, nice location, super friendly and very tasty and lots of food. Had a renovated room, everything was top , double bed and a bed separately were there as a couple , bathroom with walk-in shower, double sink, bathrobes provided. In-room bar , stocked fridge , top location, were also very quiet, very good sleep .Best holiday ever, definitely going back next year, best service ever

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Dominican Republic is renowned for its beautiful and clean beaches, and I got to experience it firsthand for the first time. I will definitely consider going back there again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely to see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really the opinion in this case is very personal, the beach itself, the sea view, is spectacular. The point is that in my country it is not customary to go to the beach and be constantly approached, for me it takes away all the charm of going to these places. Every minute you get someone offering you braids, tours, photos with animals, etc. Depending on the hotel you stay is the type of facility you will have. The water in this day and age is not very hot. It is enjoyed a lot but I think it is not how they sell it, one imagines a lot of peace but it is not so real that expectation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: An unforgettable holiday
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place! I loved going there for our vacation with my spouse. The place is great and one can enjoy an azure colored sea and a sandy beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: How stunning is this
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was absolutely the nicest beach we’ve ever visited.Soft, white sand, stretching as far as you can see.Not many people, so it is shocking when you compare it to the usual solidly covered beaches of menorca.Easy to spend all day, swimming and relaxing here.We’ve become obsessed with this tropical location / will we ever be able to go anywhere else?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful even, calm waters, a good extension of shallow depth to explore, clean and warm water, white and fine sand, there are areas with algae, but did not spoil our experience ❤️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun, Fun, Fun!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was amazing! The view was very beautiful and spectacular! The sand was pretty, white and smooth to walk on. The water was clear and beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A very nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is beautiful, the sand soft, the beach is pretty clean. A little sargassum but it was continuously cleaned in the mornings

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice be not the best
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very tropical and flora with soft sand, some rocks (recommend water shoes) and lots of seaweed and a lime-green tint color during our week stay at the beginning of November. I would compare to Playa Del Carmen in Mexico during the seaweed season for color. Definitely not Negril or Cancun in color but nice and blessed to have been able to visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fantastic water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: With its fine white sand and fantastic water, this beach was the best. It was worth a look even though it was a little further from our hotel and had a smaller beach. Did get busy and quite a few traders understood the message if you were firm.didn't take away from the incredible beach, though.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Tropical Sunrise Location
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand beach is well maintained. There is seaweed, but most resorts remove a fair amount each morning. Great spot to enjoy sunrise each day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superior beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was easily the superior beach in this area. Kept very clean, it does get it’s fair share of hawkers and sellers but they do go if you make it clear you’re not interested.Spent quality time here, perfect.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The hotel is very large with a variety of restaurants, with very good food and entertainment (disco, casino, theater, shopping). It has everything you need to spend an amazing holiday. The beach is a paradise, the only thing I would add would be some straw umbrellas since the only protection from the sun, are palm trees and according to the time of day, they do not shade. But then, all excellent. We will return without hesitation.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White Party
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went to a WHITE PARTY here, during the day it’s nice, but walking on the beach when it’s dark didn’t feel safe although there was a party going on, random people asking if you wanted to buy any illegal substances.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: How to destroy a paradise beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A regrettable show with dolphins on a paradisiacal beach.We have been coming to Playa Bávaro for 20 years and mass tourism and all the marketing around has caused what was a paradise to become almost a commercial center for mass tourism.On this vacation we have found the unpleasant "surprise" that right in front of one of the best beaches in the world, they have built up to 3 dolphinariums, destroying the paradisiacal view and generating noise and visual pollution worthy of any rave concert.What will be next, a shopping center on the beach?Don't count on us anymore.The positive part is that we are going to explore new destinations where savage capitalism, destroying natural paradises, has not arrived.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach, but full of sellers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love this beach, one of the most beautiful beaches in Punta Cana. We have gone there several times. Recommend to everyone

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing entertainment 👌
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this place.Pones Rissa ,Yaison,Marlene's,Franyer y Kanela they are amazing. You made my vacation unforgettable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but very neglected beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach... but in May there is a lot of seaweed!!! Extremely much! Locals collect it in huge piles on the beach! On top of that, people throw rubbish! What a shame for these natural wonders! Also a lot of party beaches that leave extra rubbish in the water right where people swim! They place a lot of emphasis on making money, not on nature!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Number one beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was the number one beach, white sand and amazing water. It was a bit further on from our hotel and smaller beach, but worth the look. Did get busy and quite a few traders, just be firm and they get the message.Still didn’t detract from the amazing beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved the place. It was clean and lively. When we were there, it was extra packed. and so we had to find extra chairs somewhere. But that wasn't a big deal. The beach was still gorgeous.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach of more than 20 km with fine white sand. The water with its shades of blue and turquoise is crystal clear.You will find several hotels of all categories and for all budgets. Lots of walkers on the beach all day long, it feels safe there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach fabulous
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is beautiful.  Sand and water awesome......Vendor are prominent...Tell them no upfront.They will still chat with you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The hotel is very good at the Iberoestar, the problem is the beach and the sea.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too busy, too much waves, you can't stand without exerting force so that the waves don't knock you over... The waves crash on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BEAUTIFUL beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Such a perfect beach! We didn't even feel the need to explore the ACTUAL Punta Cana area as we loved Bavaro right outside of our condo so much. Tons of great restaurants and an easy drive to several tourist activities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: "A mediocre experience at Bavaro Beach"
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is a pleasant place. The sandy beach is nice and the water is clear. There are some activities nearby and the local restaurants are ok. This is a reasonable choice for a day at the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Recommend this hotel BARCELO Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice week, quiet, very good buffet restaurants, excellent service and the room and site extremely clean. Breakage to a patio door, repair in less than 10 minutes, same thing for the air conditioning in another room, repairs in 10 minutes. We recommend this place.The only downside is that it is difficult to reserve restaurants à la carte at suitable times (10:00 a.m., 10:30 a.m.), even if we made the request for multiple restaurants the morning after our arrival. The second downside, the bathrooms in the rooms need to be refreshed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seaweed still a problem in Mar 2024
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at the Meliá Punta Cana Wellness resort. Wonderful hotel and great staff. Beautiful pools.  So large there is a shuttle to take you from the front desk/ dinner restaurants to the beachfront and pool. Highly recommend upgrading and getting a room closer to the beach. Biggest issue- the seaweed. Although all the high end hotels clean the beach every morning, there is so much, it's not fun. And by lunch, it's all back again- brought in by the tide. And when you are in the water you get covered in it or you have to wade/swim through it to get to a clean part of the ocean. I hated it. I only went in once as a result. I know they are trying to deal with it but it really ruins the experience. If I had known, I wouldn't have come.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, warm waters.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, the only thing missing is for the hotels to clean the algae more frequently to prevent accumulation. The warm and turquoise water, a pleasure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro beach bar Hideawy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love it!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Exceptional sea and landscape. Could the city council or the hotels themselves clean the sargassum on the beachfront every day (early in the morning).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice and central beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, there are restaurants where you can eat and have a place in front of the beach to rest; There are vendors, and one block away is the area of shops and restaurants.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fun with family
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing time as always. Thanks for the friendly days.  Food was good. Sun was shining water was warm. Life is good on vacation

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach. Every time we visit we have a great time. Walking along the shore is calming and relaxing even with hundreds of other people around. There are people that come along and clean in front of the different resorts every morning so that the seaweed is gone.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: one of the most popular shorelines in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is Punta Cana’s main beach and is one of the largest and most popular beaches in the area. The town of Bavaro is lined with small shops and dotted with luxurious all-inclusive resorts. No trip to Punta Cana would be complete without some time spent on its gorgeous beaches. Playa Bávaro.It is one of the most popular shorelines in Punta Cana, with its powdery sands, swaying palm trees, blue waters, and a bevy of amenities, including water sports rentals, dining options, and nearby accommodations. there is so much confusion about where it starts/ends, and entrance to public beaches as 80% of beach areas are occupied by resorts. The beach stretches for 12 miles between Macao and Cabeza de Toro, but keep in mind that there are just four public access points at Corales, El Cortecito, Jellyfish, and Bibi Jagua.Bavaro Beach has several subsections that all have their name. However, they are all connected and you can explore them walking consecutively. El Cortecito and Corales are two of these stretches and are very convenient The clear waters off Bavaro Beach make it ideal for snorkeling, and many hotels on the strip include snorkeling equipment during your stay.don’t imagine it to be a crowded beach. There is always something going on, people are enjoying their beach walks and locals are sitting in the sand, but as the beach is extremely long and wide, you always have more than enough space, and it NEVER feels crowded.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a long, fine sandy beach. There are a few stones in the sea here and there. If you are sensitive, you should wear swimming shoes. When I was there, there was no algae problem. If you want to snorkel, you have to swim a little further out, because the water is a bit choppy near the beach and you can't see much.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Divine beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent beach!!! white sand and crystal clear, warm waters. There is no sargassum, so enjoyment is guaranteed all year round.It is the fourth time in the Dominican Republic and it never ceases to surprise me!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is very well maintained and beautiful. You can go for a long walk on this gorgeous beach. White sand. Most of the happening hotels are on this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro beach bliss
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous sandy beach, beautiful to walk along in the morning or evening. It goes on forever with little shops along the way with local crafts, spices etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: gorgeous soft white sand beach, the water is crystal clear that you can see the bottom and fishes. The color of the sea is in teal color, absolutely amazing.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is situated in Punta Cana on the East coast of Dominican Republic.  A fine stretch of white sand stretching for miles.The beach is well maintained and cleaned regularly - it is in good condition and doesn't suffer from rubbish or plastic littering.A Few beach vendors plying their trade (but not aggressive or pushy).  A decent beach with white sand and turquoise waters.  Great place to hang out for the winter.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely one of the most beautiful beachesIf you like walking next to palm trees and magical tropical waters it will reward you even more.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Calm beach, beautiful sea.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, calm sea. Excellent for walking and enjoying this beautiful beach. There are some tours leaving from the beach (catamaran, parasail, etc.)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good hotel, little entertainment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Good hotel in general, but with things to improve. Very good and varied Caribbean buffet, much better than the Palace buffet. Friendly and happy workers. I don't like in a 5-star hotel that you leave the sign at 8 in the morning to make the room and it is difficult for it to be ready before 3. I really liked il Divo for shows. The rest of the days are very very slow and it is only from 10pm to 11pm. A lot of Sargassum in January, although they clean every day. A big disappointment is that if you go by train to the Palace, at least in the first week of January all the shows were children's. In short, I had a good time and the hotel is good but the money we paid to go these days is not worth it, they have gone too far. The rooms are very large but very old, without the possibility of regulating the air well and with humidity. Very important, the spectacular New Year's Eve dinner, I admit that that alone makes the price higher this week

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perry Rothenberg December 2023
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked for hours on Bech barefoot one of the best beaches I have been to most of it is very clean no cigarette or rubbish to be seen  well looked after

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro at Melia Caribe Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful. Bavaro is the Atlantic Sea, which means that the water has a lower temperature than Bayahibe, which is on the other side of the island and is the Caribbean Sea.We stopped at Melia Caribe Beach. Good experience in general but much to improve. Above all, the attention of the staff in the restaurants: they don't say hello, they seem tired, without desire. Most activate if they know you will tip them.The hotel is too big. The common areas are impeccable. However, the cleaning of rooms and buffet restaurants is extremely poor.The beach is excellent but I would not return to this hotel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the best beaches I have ever been to. Sand was lovely to walk on, sea was great to swim in. Also really close to most of the hotels.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Meh
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a beautiful resort and they get 3 stars for that. If you don’t have children, book the beach side and you will do much better. The buffet on the palace side is sketchy. The meat looked gray every day. The sports bar was worse. If you need a hot tip on eating in there, using the panini grill, you can pull off a grilled cheese sandwich. The rooms are in need of a bit of renovation. I do believe there was actual feces on our trash can in our room. So three stars seems generous to me.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Contracted Salmonella
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Enjoyed the first few days. Contracted Salmonella on day 4 and spent the next 48 hours in room and last 4 days within 50 meters of a toilet.  Communication with staff was poor, some more helpful than others. We were in Adults only and Premium which seemed to cause some confusion at check in and things poorly explained. Had to complain about rowdy neighbours on 2 occasions, lots of young Americans(18/19 years olds). Cleaning staff were helpful brought in extra toilet roll. Food generally was OK. Steaks were good, rest of the restaurant and buffet food was mediocre. Beach was good, but quite a lot of seaweed which they tried to take away every day. As soon as you walk off the private beech you do get surrounded by hawkers, there are big signs to let you know this and also the sea weed has not been swept up. Beach is Easterly facing which is a pain as you are having to move sun bed every 45 minutes. I would not go back to this hotel or island again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed in Occidental Punta Cana.  Bavaro Beach is absolutely gorgeous.  Soft white sand, super clean.  Crystal clear water.  The surf can be strong so be aware if you are not a strong swimmer or confident in the water.  The beach back drop is beautiful too.  There are beach sellers but these are very polite & friendly and only engage if you show interest.  There is beach security if you are concerned but we didnt have any issues and left our bag by our sunbeds when we went into the sea or pool or went for a walk with no problems.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The quintessential Caribbean Beach experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Crystal clear water and white sand on the beach. Tropical palms, very sunny, nice fruit cocktails and amazing food around here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Honeymoon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches we've ever seen in front of the resort we stayed at and has a beautiful pier to take photos to save good memories, the water, not to mention excellent for warm bathing, even going in a month with a high level of sargassum, we had no problems as the The resort staff leaves everything clean early in the morning, what a beautiful beach!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: the best: the super white and fine sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, palm trees, very wide and long beach, ideal for walks along the sea. The only con is the sargassum, it is seasonal, but it is very ugly.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Playa Bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Any 4 and higher star rated resort in the playa Bavaro area is my favorite. We have been to 8 different resorts in the area. Our absolute favorite is Barcelo Bavaro Palace. The reason is that playa Bavaro is sheltered by an offshore Reef. The waters are calm and the beaches pure white sand. I especially go to resorts that have free catamaran rentals. The beach is about 10 miles wide and maybe 1 mile out. This makes the beach the most desirable in the Punta Cana area. Most of the beaches are lined with palm trees.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach full of Peddlers and Drug Sellers, full of seaweed and very dirty water which you wouldn't want to swim in

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The  wonderful food and the golden sandy beach and clear blue sea. Friendly staff lovely pool. Spotlessly clean and great rooms with comfy beds

reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water was nice and warm but there was so much seaweed it was a fight that I just didnt enjoy having....I spent the majority of my time waling the beach or in the pool
