Amazing entertainment- Kervin was great and Miguel was a great DJ  making sure all had a great time dancing for all ages. Had a blast!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The water is very hot but not transparent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Uninteresting beach, deckchairs are reserved for hotels.No shadows, the palm trees are for deckchairs.Dirty beaches, not clean, plastic cutlery, bags, and other waste.The sargassum is not collected and therefore has very strong odors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: TI resort great but not 5*
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The hotel's outdoor space is beautiful with lots of nature and animals, the themed restaurants are great. But you have to bookmark it on the hotel app as sometimes it doesn't work.Bath towels as well as shampoo and shower gel were often missing and you had to call to ask, the quality of the towels is also not at the level of a 5*.Otherwise, the beach (when there is no sargassum) is excellent and the hotel has lots of sun loungers along the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wide beach where you can sit while the children play in the waves and look for shells. The beach is less beautiful than advertised. Unfortunately, we found quite a few pieces of glass in the sand. It's nice to go before the sun goes down and have a drink while the kids play. In addition, there are many street vendors who constantly come to you with the same items. There are many beautiful places to spend an afternoon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Brown water with abundance of Sargassam.  Not what you envision.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The seaweed was not the worst of it.  The water was brown instead of the beautiful teal color we associate with the caribbean.  When we arrived on Wednesday July 26th the beach was covered with sargassam.  It smelled like human fecus.  The water up and down the beach resembled a brook.  The water was a yucky brown color.  Eventually, a small spot and I do mean small, cleared up about 50 yards from our resort.  It was a small path that lead to the barrier they hotel set up to prevent sargassam from taking over the beach.   When you climbed over it, the water improved 100% but it was a small spot.  In front of the Pearl, the water looked black.  No one was there.  I looked this up and it said it was due to sargassam and brown tide.  I can assure you the water was like a sewer treatment plant.  Attemps were made daily to remove seaweed from the sand.  I fear if this is not resoloved, it could destroy the livlihoods of many who depend on the resorts.  Check real time before you go.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft clean sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach is long with a large expanse of soft clean sand.  No evidence of seaweed.  Sea sports available and a pirate ship was available for cruises.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort was on Bavaro and though there was some seaweed, the waves are calm, the water is crystal blue a we enjoyed our days on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Love the beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I really enjoy the time on the beach being served drinks constantly each day was wonderful just relaxing

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean tropical paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love the clean, white sand beach and the warm water. The resorts alongside clean the seaweed too. But there are too many peddlers trying to sell you stuff so that is a bit annoying.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful 50th birthday experience !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I decided for my 50th birthday I wanted to do a trip rather than a party. I wanted to relax & have fun in paradise. My travel agent Candi Davis,(Candice DavisExecutive Travel ConsultantEasy Escapes Travel, Incc: 302-367-7545| o: 800-294-6643candice@easyescapestravel.comEasyEscapesTravel.com), gave me options for different resorts and Bavaro Beach checked off all boxes for an Adults only, amenity packed, full service all inclusive resort. From the time I checked in until I checked out, the Bavaro staff were always very friendly, gracious, and kind. They remembered my birthday by giving me birthday greetings, singing the birthday song, and a cake, fruit platter, and bottle of rum waiting in my room when I returned from excursion. I never felt unsafe or like a tourist. I was made to feel like a visiting relative with the treatment I received. Needless to say I thoroughly enjoyed my trip & will definitely be back. Thank you Candi for recommending it & Thank you Bavaro Beach for a magical 50th birthday experience that will always be cherished and remembered !!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful Caribbean beach, with golden sand and blue waters - it was a pleasure spending lazy days here. The waves could be quite rough but this added to the fun for us!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had a great time, Beautiful Resort and location, avoid the Restaurants at night, and stick to the buffet, they rush you and i understand they have a lot of reservations to fulfill, we had dinner reservations for six night and only did it for five, the at the buffet was better. The Sport Bar was Awesome next to the Casino, and the Disco was a lot fun,  the staff was great, wish they had places to eat outside near the pool or beach area , instead of having to walk inside to get something to eat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaria beach experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was amazingly awesome, love at first sight.  The sand insects don't bite me, they allowed me to enjoy the beach,.on the other hand they sand insects attacked my girlfriend and ate her alive, leaving her with  swollen feet, pain and huge bites marks.   My girlfriend walked on many beach all over and this is the first time she was eat by sand insects.    Now my girlfriend is afraid to go to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was amazing! Stayed at an all inclusive resort. Good food. Many activities to choose from.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An absolutely beautiful outlook from the beach over to the sea with lovely palm trees, very Caribbean. However, it was like the M6 on a Friday evening. So busy and full of beds that it was not pleasant lying there. We tended to use the pools of the hotels  instead as they were quieter.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lack Luster
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Marketing Of Bavaro Beach Is deceptive, Yes the sand is great, the length is sufficient. But that is where all bets are off as to if you will enjoy your space on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro Beach’s
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The clean beaches the staff very welcoming lots of parking great location really cool vendors and very respectful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful Beach to Visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro was outstanding, clean and the water was a perfect temperature for a March visit.   This was our second visit and we will return again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Windy beach surrounded with resorts
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach did not suit us, it is surrounded with resorts and hard to access if you are not a guest. Lots of locals trying to sell stuff, and they are really annoying. Lots of sea weed, very windy, and hard to swim in the ocean.  Outside the beach there are lots of restaurants, intensive traffic so be careful when walking around. Everything is very expensive in this area.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We would go again...maybe tomorrow!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife and I recently completed a week's vacation to "Be Live" all inclusive in Punta Cana/Bravaro.  The accommodations at Be Live included great food (better than most all-inclusives in D.R.) The resort is right on the beach with plenty of shade areas and loungers (but go reserve your loungers and palapa by 7:00a.m.!  After 9:a.m. they are hard to find!).  Each night the resort included 2 to 3 one hour long free entertainment shows and or live music.  This rates 4 star not 5, but at the affordable price of trip it was well worth it!  Arrange for the 1.5 hour Time Share presentation and say "no", and you still have the advantage of a 4 night/5 day resort package!  The beach is very swimmable, no waves or shore break, and great daily excursion options too.  This resort has both family areas, and adults only areas which made it very comfortable.  I took lots of good photos which I'd be happy to share DLDBOB@AOL.com

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go somewhere else!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Noisiest resort we have ever been to! All music was  played way beyond  acceptable volume and all coming from different areas at once! Not a place for non smokers as only restrictions in rooms and even that is not monitored! Not a place for persons with mobility issues! Beach was crowded with beach chairs cramped together in many rows. Again, noise and smoking an issue. Lots of seaweed and debris.  Housekeeping very poor. Bathrooms old and in need of repair. Very poor bed pillows and dirty floors and again… noise. Staff talk loudly and shout to each other starting at 6 am!Food okay, not great.  Dishes and cutlery often dirty. Service in main buffet slow. The entire property consists of several hotels that look very similar but access is decided by the colour of your bracelet. Very confusing and uexplained. Often felt discriminated. If you are looking to relax this is not the place!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful long beach with white soft sand, great for long walks.  we loved to sit on the beach and listen to the soft waves rolling in.  So calming and peaceful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach at Bávaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great Beach!  Super service at the bars on the beach.  Lot of pallas directly on the Beach.  10/10 holà!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy Place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach to walk along.  The vendors are aggressive and could be rude if you don't go into their store.  Don't take their first price and negotiate

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Busy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Masses of seaweed!Loads of sun-loungers.Not a beautiful beach unfortunately.Mainly water sports and loads of holiday makers and beach vendors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach life is good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Water was warm, golden sand and all only a stones throw away from our hotel.We walked along the waters edge for hours it felt like another world. Very clean, safe and areas to sit on hammocks or beds.Great location.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It was amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Kervens and chicken legs were amazing they thought us alot of dances, and they were very friendly. I love it here

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: i have been to Punta Cana 3 times and every time it has been a pleasure . This year we met  Roger on the beach who was selling tours . He usually is in front of Ocean blue and sand  or nearby . He sold us 2 tours and both were a lot of fun. one was an ATV adventure muddy but a hoot and the other was a snorkeling trip . In both cases  he made sure we were well taken care of . We screwed up on the ATV and missed the bus but he had  his cousin pick us up and get us there . And he was there to make sure the boat showed up . He was a caring person and stood behind his sales. the vendors were there but if you said you weren’t interested they left you alone. every day there was someone cleaning the beach more than once and we ended up tipping them because they work so hard.. we have always had a great time in Punta Cana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All beaches are great, the sand, the blue water, the sound of the waves, the sun. We spend most  of our mornings on the beach and the afternoons around the pools.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: very nice beach to visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Beach is very nice.  Lots of Palm trees and very beautiful.  Swimming is not the best as there is lots of sea weed and the water is murky but a nice beach to relax or walk around.  I prefer the softer sand and more open beaches that are found at Juan Dolio.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great resort - amazing experience.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything is pretty much as good as advertised. Nothing really to add. We had a great time and will come back if we can. The only annoying thing is the fact that many guests get up early in the morning to reserve a spot at the pool by placing "something" on the lounge/chair/bench. Only a few idiot guests are enough to trigger more and more guests to follow suit. Terrible habit, hard to kill.We only made one interesting observation, in all restaurants we visited and in the resort in general:  Nobody asks for "feedback" like "how do you like your food" etc....it seems they know why they avoid the question. I think with more feedback the restaurants and the resort overall could get better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful endless beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walk for miles and miles ! White and pink sand , very soft and sugary ! The beach seams endless, the water was warm and very few people trying to grab you to buy trinkets— they are around but not pushy!   Plenty of places to stop and get a drink or water or eats! Just beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful beach for a walk
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Grand Palladium Resort which had very soft, whitish sand and easy access to the ocean. Seaweed was minimal and cleaned up every morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach for walking.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love this beach and visit it every year.   The sand is like powder and going barefoot is a must.  There is seaweed to deal with though. And long stretches of all inclusives thus reducing the numbers of accessible restaurants and bars.   The weather is excellent.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach I have been on in 20 years.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Big, long white sand beach with 2 foot waves. Great to walk on for miles. In February, it had minimal seaweed. Everyone loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 5 star beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice wide sandy beach to walk. We did two 45 minutes walk every day. Enjoyed the ocean and the wave. Water was clear but when windy a little bit of weeds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach for walking and swimming.  There are waves but they are manageable, they are perfect to play in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love it and went for beach walks every day.  Water is also perfect and beach is kept clean  can't wait to go back

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Royal club Occidential Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow, this resort never lets us down. Hippolito, Wendy, Ruben and Nairobi and a few new servers Miguelina, Stacy and Johan ready and waiting for you. and let’s not forget the Chef Carlos Mattia . The food is the best and healthiest menu of all the resorts we’ve traveled to. nice to see Yeremy in the Oriental and Vladimir in the Steakhouse & a pleasure to see Jon Kelly who over sees all the restaurants. The beach is the best. no seaweed and crystal clear blue water. Our 1-bdrm ocean view is awesome! Thank you Aris. Willy Bruno is the best bartender here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a must see beach. Amazing beach. Local restaurants and beach bars. Lots of market shopping. Great place to spend a day or two.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Dreams in Punta Cana and loved it. Our walks at sunrise was the highlight of my days there! They clean the seaweed away by machine 2-3 times a day. Beautiful soft sand and flat. Great for jogging!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach memories
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful and staff were constantly cleaning. I was also impressed by the tourists in general who cleaned up after themselves!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excellent place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just perfection; the water is clear; white sand beach; lots of palm trees and great staff who is always happy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with many all-inclusive resorts for all price range. Best beach in Punta Cana area. Warm clear calm water and soft white sand. Slightly windy enough for sailing and other water sports. The only downside is the seaweeds during late summer months. Our favorite resort located in the best section of this beach is Barcelo Bavaro Palace.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girls trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach area was beautiful. The water is not  crystal clear, which came as a surprise. I had a great time and have a lot of memories.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! We were staying at the melia wellness adults only resort.  Our resort connected to the beach. Very peaceful and relaxing. I would recommend you take like half a day to sit at the beach and relax.   You will find lots of water based activities to make the day even better.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. Comfortable sunchairs. Very clean and in good conditions. Very pleasant beach resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is a place that everyone should see once in their lifetime and if possible a dozen or more!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: DO NOT GO TO NOVA BEACH CLUB RESTAURANT
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My friends at I went to the beach it was very beautiful. The boat ride was amazing!! However, that NOVA BEACH RESTAURANT and its workers are a thief!! Because we don’t speak Spanish, they tried to rob us when changing US Dollars! And charged my card twice for food I did not ate. Upon contacting the owner he was giving attitude that he charged what I ate (lies) I only ordered 1 burger which they charged $700 DOP then charge me $5,962 DOP for what I do not ate or know about. He stated that he’s always right. But sir, you are so wrong, from the day you were born!! Very dishonest and your burgers makes us sick to my stomach!!!! I STRONGLY DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!PSA: I ONLY RECEIVED ONE RECIPT WITH $700 DOP when I paid with my Visa card . They did not give me a receipt that said I ate $5,962 worth of food (receipt shown was what he sent me). We did not need to buy any drinks because the boat provided beverages for us!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beachy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great long , sandy beach lined with palm trees and the beautiful crashing waves of the Atlantic . The sea is too rough to snorkel in though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is beautiful.  The water is warm.  The waves are plentiful so swimming very far out is not possible but the views are spectacular.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful site
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach and an embarking site for a lot of water-based excursions. A lot of vendors, though... Cool beachfront bar.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not as expected
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not a clean beach. You will find cigarette buds everywhere on the beach. Also lots of seaweed and sargassum

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cool and Clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand feels so nice and cool.  It's clean, but there is way too much seaweed. Maybe December is high time for seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super soft sand!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach has some of the most wonderful sand in the world. However, Sargasso is washing up on shore here like it is throughout the Caribbean. The hotels keep their beaches pretty clear but stretches without hotels have a lot of Sargasso. Windier and wavier this visit then we remember in the past.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous waters, beautiful sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is gorgeous.  Nothing like kicking back with a drink in your hand and listening to the waves crash.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: While enjoying the lounge area on the beach, the frequent interruptions from merchandise sellers is annoying. The water and breeze is amazing, but I wished there was no seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Where did all the seweed come from ?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Last time we were here the beach was amazing. This trip the entire length of the beach was one big pilke of seaweed. We did enjoy the bavaro native market and found vendor #4 luis to be the most stocked best prices and luis and his son spoke perfect english

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Royalton Bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a beautiful resort with lots to do for kids, kids pool with slides and lazy river were popular with the kids. Beach was beautiful with lots of seating. We were there for a week family trip.We had an unfortunate start; our flight was 5 hours late. We were a group of 13 with 6 grandkids aged 10 months to 12, when we arrived, I told them we were diamond club but were still directed to the regular check-in where we waited for 20 minutes while the group in front checked in.  Once they verified, we were diamond club we were taken to the diamond club registration where we were treated like kings. There was a small buffet, we were offered drinks, and someone took our documents and went away to complete the paperwork while we had another drink. Our rooms were great, very large and comfortable. Buffet restaurants were great, we seemed to have some difficulty in getting an early reservation for the a la cart restaurants. I believe they are still rebuilding staff after COVID. Twice at dinner we were told they had no highchairs, I don't think the staff knew where to get them, because there were many children at the resort who would need one. Although we had trouble getting an early dinner reservation (we needed one for the younger kids) we were not always seated together and there were empty tables. Believe this was caused by a lack of staffing. The outdoor pools were all great, 2 with swim up bars, and 1 for the diamond club. Although the diamond club has access to different areas the other areas were great, and we used both. I would look at the price difference for the diamond club if I were to return..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sand flea bites
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Royalton Bavaro hotel, and accessed the beach via the resort (which many other hotels back on to). We took a walk along the strip for a 30 minute stroll, and although at first the beach seemed nice, we noticed there was a lot of seaweed and the sea was very choppy so we didn’t go swimming in it. The real issue however were the sand fleas. This isn’t something I’d ever heard of before, but later on that evening I realised I had 28 x red, itchy bites from my ankles to my knee caps. My friend however, didn’t have any bites (so some people must just be more susceptible). I’ve never experienced these types of bites on any beach before, but would advise that you take extra care as they’re extremely irritating to the point where it can affect your sleep. Our resort didn’t sell any insect repellent, and only had one tube of anti itch cream available to buy - therefore make sure you’re prepared and pack the right creams before you travel to Punta Cana.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach in the Cortecito area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stay at Playa Turquesa Ocean Club with it beautiful beach and 2 large pools.—wonderful area with great restaurants close by .The condos a very nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just spent 2 weeks lying on this beautiful beach. Walked along almost everyday, water is so warm too. Lots of seaweed but workers try to keep clean as best they can. Loved my stay here

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All Inclusive Hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stayed at sotogrande de cap cana a beautiful resort with a vast amount of cuisine selections ,service perfect and cordial as what u get in Dominican republic.Area of beach sea service and security excellent

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Birthday Celebration
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our experience was amazing!! The sunsets on the beach are priceless.The people were friendly, the water temp felt so good

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beutiful endless beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is white sand and blue clear waters A group of hotels sit along the beach you can walk endlessly along this beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Briliant
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great stay great place staff were good would go back hopefully with family next year till on year 23

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Our Fave in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent!!! Travelled with our adult sons and their friends. We travelled back, just the 2 of us. Food is fantastic. Staff is excellent!! The family side is great and perfect for a outing but then the privilege of traveling back to the adults side for peace. My only negative is the dolphin experience being right out front in the ocean. As a advocate of Dolphins long free and this is just a poor display of how awful these dolphins are treated. You can see when they are left to the small pens. Beyond that, everything g was excellent. Thank you!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Stunning beaches. We obviously had read how the beaches are and in real life they are so much better. Even photos don’t do the turquoise sea and sky any justice. It has to be seen to be believed and of course remembered. This is one of those situations where you need to quietly be and take it all in. We did, it was very special.Go if you can.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning -  just a shame about the captivity!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach - its absolutely stunning!Just so gutted that those disgusting,  tiny dolphin enclosures are allowed in the sea 😔 sourced from seaworld too according to our hotel!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unforgettable experience.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, blue water, aquarelle skies, great drinks, wonderful food.  The serenity of the scenery will perdure in your memories.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sargasm
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were at Iberostar Bavaro in August. The water was in brown color due to the huge amount of sargasm. Some people were still in the water since it was a natural phenomena and water is not dirty. The beach at our resort was cleaned by tractor everyday. The beach itself is wide and clean and beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wave action!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Though this beach is not very wide the swimming is great. There is a lot of wave action and soft sand. There are also many shells to find. Especially early in the morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but the vendors..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself was beautiful! The water was a great temperature and it was clean. We loved it for the short time we were there. But the vendors were aggressive and because of it, we limited our time there. They were consistently bombarding you when all we wanted was to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Knowing this we wouldn't have booked this place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were expecting one of the most amazing beach holidays ever, when we decided for the Carribean Punta Cana Grand Bavaro Princess Hotel. We spent almost 10k Euro to make the dream come true. When we arrived we saw it was almost impossible to swim in the Ocean because of thousands of tons of sea weed in the water and at the beach. We were told its a well known problem in the duration from July til November. The reality was: nobody was swimming in the Ocean; the pools were overcrowded and the water quality there was almost criminal. We are thinking to sue our travel agency for not informing us about this serious quality problem.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of a kind
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Everything . This place is just simply amazing. I have zero complaints Fermin was so sweet and friendly Sindy  was super sweet . I loved it and looking forward to my next stay there

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Destination Wedding
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beaches were beautiful but water was rough.  When you go to Punta Cana you just don't want to leave the white sand beaches, the servers by the beach and the great food.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really nice beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went on an excursion here and swam with sharks and went on speedboats at this amazing water area which was crystal clear

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Covered in seaweed and brown
reviewsWithKeywords.text: They told us they can not contain the seaweed for the last two years.  We had expected beautiful, clear water.  It was brown and nasty with seaweed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This amazing sandy beach was so beautiful. A couple of days we got a strong breeze, I loved it. Seaweed was blown in the last couple of days of our holiday, but it didn’t worry us. Most fantastic blues and turquoise sea and sky, I’ve ever seen, felt so lucky to be there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing Impressive Premium
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Shout out to maximo for an amazing concierge experience. The hotel grounds were beautiful and the staff was incredible!Only issue was the seaweed but this hotel will surpass expectations for the price point!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lots of waves and algae
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very windy so lots of waves and algae on the beach and in the water so we could not swim in the ocean; the beach is small also compared to Punta Cana

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing white sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing white sand and clear water near Lopesan Costa Bavaro hotel, to the left and right sides of the hotel near Barcelo Bavaro and Melia hotels tons of seaweed, impossible to even get in the water (just an unlucky period for them)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: never calm water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: if you like rougher seas rather than the calm tranquil Caribbean sea then this is the one for you, not my preference and a lot of sea weed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean it up!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is FULL of kelp and the beach rake does nothing to help the situation since it goes up and down the beach without the rake down. Besides kelp, the beach is dirty and needs a good grooming!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach Sand & Weather were perfect!!! The Melia beach resort has a private section which was a fantastic place to be at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: our hotel was in front of Bavaro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: beautiful/clean/sandy/lots of waves for fun - lots of sports/games on the beach/ people selling lots of goodiesdidn't see much seaweedVERY upset to see monkeys and parrots being used

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach - Lots of sargassum/algae
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful, but during our stay almost always with lots of sargassum/algae (and it seems to be not cleaned much, in the hotel we stayed -Occidental Punta Cana- they seem to clean 3x,4x/day, but it´s a difficult situation).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seaweed Problem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were told this was the best beach in Punta Cana but unfortunately we never went in. The Caribbean is experiencing a seaweed problem and it was definitely not under control. We traveled so far for the clear blue waters and white sand beaches of the Caribbean only to find we couldn't really want to access it from our hotel. Mountains of seaweed, brown murky water and too many party boats and fishing boats allowed to park on the horizon. We really wanted to see the vastness of the sea with beautiful blue water and white sandy beaches. The beach itself felt more like the brown beaches of Galveston Texas. IT was the only bad part of our entire holiday. For the water and sand you want - take a tour to Soana Island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quieter
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort was on this beach. It is a quieter spot as you walk both ways on the beach - due to the only adult resort we were at. It has nice sand and you can swim here. It is close to a little shop as well that sells touristy stuff, sunscreen, snacks, etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super Dario
reviewsWithKeywords.text: SUPER Dario ....an amazing server at the marketplace.. he made our stay that much more enjoyable.... Great job Dario 👏

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seaweed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not sure if it is the time of year or not but the seaweed was crazy, not a pleasant experience getting in the water.  Had to opted for the pool to cool off.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: seaweed infested pressure pot
reviewsWithKeywords.text: i am sure you can find some nice parts of this beach.  however in ou 7 days here and one long walk i can not say we found any redeeming properties.  it certainly is pretty from your hotel pool. but many of the hotels are warm down collapsing disasters. the beach is full of seaweed.  ans the boats ans just ugly.  go elsewhere

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Barcelo Bavaro Palace
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself was beautiful, plenty of chairs for everyone, the hotel was beautiful also with many amenities. The restaurants were very good but would not recommend the seafood restaurant Coral. The staff was helpful and very friendly. The ocean in front of the hotel was awful, so much seaweed and algae. We went in one time only. The crew did clean the beach every day but there is so much algae it is difficult to keep up with. Loved the resort and the people but the ocean was a definite disappointment.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Barcelo Bavaro Beach -Adults Only
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We had an amazing time at the Barcelo Bavaro Beach - Adults Only resort. The hotel was in pristine condition and the staff was super friendly.  It looks like it's been recently renovated as everything looked fabulous!They have beautiful facilities! From the pool area with  plenty of chaise lounges  to the 3 restaurants you'll  find there, everything was tremendous. The  staff is always attentive to your needs so that you can enjoy your stay to the max.  Our room was super spacious and had a beautiful sea view, our mini-fridge was stocked with beer, sodas, water, every day we were there!!! I was truly impressed by that. They give you a bottle of rum as a complimentary add-on. The food was ok, but the drinks were AWESOME. I was expecting "house spirits" but, no! They even have Jack Daniels, great vodka choices, etc. Now, bear in mind that the theater and bars are in the "open":  there are fans, not AC in those areas, so you'll be sweating like crazy. That's something they need to work on, put more fans for God's sake! A lot more! The only downside was having to go to their main hotel, the "Bavaro Palace" to go to the spa, the nice restaurants, are shops ( the adult-only where we were staying only had 3 restaurants and a gift shop). While in Bavaro Palace, brace yourself as there is no AIR CONDITIONING in the stores!!!! It was unbearable, really. I found it hard to breath trying to shop!  Even the restaurants have poor air conditioning system, I mean poor, you'll be sweating. That was really a bummer! Beware of the excursions: they tell you it's a whole day affair. Sure it is! But you spend 80% of the excursion traveling: first by bus, then a small boat, then a katamaran. When you arrive at the island (we went to Saona)  you barely have two hours left to spend.  We got there , got a massage, immediately after, went to get in line as it was buffet time (several excursion groups were there, so be patient. After that, we had maybe 15 minutes to spend in the water before it was time to go. It was a complete disappointment. On the way to the island, after the 40 minutes  on the bus, the tour guide says  we'd arrive at this hotel for a bit so that you could use the restroom and  have coffee and croissants and to boot and open bar. All lies, we walked through the hotel, got on the boat and that's when they gave us coffee and croissants. The "open bar" was cheap rum, period.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful 🌊🪸
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach/ ocean was beautiful. There was some seagrass but nothing that would make it not swimmable. You mainly just had to step over some to get to the ocean.We stayed at Riu Republica mostly everyday were yellow flags, the undertow was strong but still able to swim. I was surprised to not see many lifeguards at all. I saw one place that was so far down. Other resorts I have stayed at, the resort had their own lifeguards.  There are vendors walking up and down the beach selling everything. There are also police that patrol the beach. There are two men that walk up and down one with a huge bird and one with a monkey. They try and change you outrageous prices to take your pic with the animals. Always negotiate with them bc for $25 per animal is ridiculous 🤣. I know they're trying to make money, but one thing that bothered me was I never saw any water for them. And as everyone knows in the Dominican Republic it's hot 🥵 as hell. 😂 So hopefully they get water somewhere for them. The beach is what you make of it. Relax and don't sweat the seagrass. There are more important things to worry about in life.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Weeklong stay at beautiful beach resort!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed for a week at this beautiful resort. The beach was magnificent and the facilities is clean and well kept. The beaches were not crowded and with their location the waves were never a problem. We received assistance from Giancarlos Moreno with blue travel partner services and he was great! He set us up with a fantastic snorkeling trip and a great deep sea fishing trip.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect in most ways
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaria Beach Adults section was fantastic. Stunning beach with perfect weather every day. The staff is amazing and the room was beautiful. The only disappointment was that the food was not good. Just stick to the all inclusive cafeteria and keep it simple meaning fruits and veggies and fish. The restaurants were a disappointment. Food served cold and all of the soups were not good. Overall we had a great time and you will be pleased. Make sure you tip the servers at the pool each time they bring you a drink. I was amazed that guests were not doing this.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can walk long distances along this beach. A  lot of hotels are on the beach as you walk along but as long as you avoid salesmen (who don't come over if you walk along in the sea) you can do wonderful 2 hour walks up the beach and even reach isolated areas. Some areas have seaweed. Very clean lovely beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All in all very pleased
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really clean beach and locals are very welcoming.this is my 1st time coming to the Dominican and I have no complaints.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful white sandy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful white sandy beach but the sea was a disappointment because it wasn’t crystal clear or blue due to lots of seaweed everywhere. Maybe it’s the time of year for it .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful.  There was seaweed but it was cleaned everyday by hotel staff.  There were many boats anchored in the water, many of them trying to offer excursions from the beach.  Water was warm and clear.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very beautiful palm lined beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches at Bavaro are beautiful & allow one to take shelter from the sun under the palm trees. Lifeguards were on duty & a security guard was also in the area all day. The drawback this time of year was the seaweed which is prevalent throughout the Caribbean. Seaweed is a nuisance but the views made up for it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Commercial area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: full of street vendors who won't leave you alone, the beach is dirty and a lot of pickpockets, be careful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All Depends
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach can be fickle! It all depends on Sagassum seaweed that is becoming more prevalent as the ocean warms. The beach can be beautiful or a complete mess depending on this. The other bad thing are the vendors and hawkers always trying to sell you someting....anything. Legal or not. Its a pain in the ass.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach, super soft sand, hardly and shells. Great breeze, relaxing in the beach chairs. Waves were pretty big by the time we left - but ohhh the beautiful blue water! So clear - amazing!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach and flea market
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach flea market was ok. The pricing was much higher than the local flea markets and they weren’t willing to negotiate as much.They do have white Hennessy but wanted $120US (only place I’ve seen it since we’ve been here) The beach was nice. We took a tour with a local tour guide on the beach for $100US to swim with sting rays, sharks, observe the dolphins, and swim in the natural pool, they promised a snorkeling spot which we never went to.They did let my husband drive the small speed boat to the dolphin holding place just off the beach. They did have options for party boats, parasailing, and an expensive restaurant (NOVA Beach Club) that wasn’t good in my option.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach / just a bit of seaweed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful Beach--not too deep for the kids nor too wavey. Just enough waves in the late afternoon to have fun in the waves. The Beach is kept clean but could probably clean the seaweed more often. In April the water was warm. We really enjoyed the beach here and have been here 3 times with my family.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We needed this get away
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this place I go 3-4 times a year and I’m pleased most of the time. I will say eater sunday was a crowded noisy time to be on the beach in bavaro.  Already counting down the days til I get back there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Sands and water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was the highlight of the trip, beautiful sands, tropical breezes, access to bar and lots of lounge chairs and shade trees

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Babymoon vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My wife brought me to celebrate my birthday and babymoon. Joel Santana in the front desk was super cool and made us feel welcomed during our stay. We stayed in the adults only area of the hotel. The food in the Caribbean was great from breakfast to dinner. The beach was great, clean, little to no waves, the pool was good too. Security was great, they are cameras everywhere. The drinks at the bar was mostly cocktails and their top whiskey were black label so not a lot of variety there. We have been told Santa Fe was the best restaurant in Bavaro palace. The food there was ok. I honestly feel the Caribbean was the best restaurant in the hotel. Our room was good size wise, bed was huge, and in a good location close to the pool and beach. Animation was cool too, very entertaining, energetic, especially playing volleyball was fun. The bed in our room was extremely uncomfortable, seemed orthopedic catered for elderly people so every morning we would wake up with back pain. Cleaning staff were late cleaning our rooms two times during our stay they had to clean while we were there.  La brisa was like having leftovers from the Caribbean restaurant. The Chez gourmet was not good for us. Portion was small and taste was mediocre at best. Me and my wife had arrived two hours late to return the towel because we were getting spa massages in the palace. The spa was very good and relaxing by the way.I went back to area to return the towels but it was closed so I asked other staff where can I return the towels. I was informed I could also return the towels to front desk. The front desk Carlos I did not get his last name but he was extremely rude for no reason while I was returning our towels, he was more attentive to people working in the airlines and ignored me while I was first in line. From now on for any questions I had I would go to anyone but him because of this experience.During the trip I wish there was an area where people are allowed to smoke in the hotel. People were smoking in the bathroom, lobby, restaurants, beaches, and in the pool. It was a little annoying. Hopefully that changes. If you are a smoker then you would not mind but if you are not, you’re not going to like it. Overall it was a good experience, great vaca before our baby is born but I highly doubt I will come back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sands and tranquil turquoise waters
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sandy beach, Turquoise waters and vibrant energy at the beach. There are many excursions and activities including glass bottom boats, Para sailing, cruises

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Grand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Golf Course & Beautiful Beach & Pool Areas and service in these areas.Perfect Vacation, no problems getting to or from.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Third visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Having had enough of the lockdowns, COVID fatigue, and just needing a break, we headed to the DR for some R&R! The resort was clean, friendly staff, smooth check in process and a well equipped room. We enjoyed each of the buffets and had the best al a carte at the steak house. The beach was white sand, blue waters, and no seaweed as several reviews seem to complain about. This was my third stay at the Bavaro property and each time there was never a problem.Golfing at the Lakes course located on site was our main draw and the course was well maintained, the staff friendly. The buffet at Hoyo 19 was closed due to COVID restrictions but we did enjoy cocktails afterwards. Overall another great visit and I look forward to another visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely long beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: great long beach, really nice for long walks when we stayed at the Majestic Mirage. You do not often get uninterrupted stretch of nice sand for a few km's.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is awesome no rocks pure white fine sand, you are lying on a beach chair and staff will come from the bar pool are and offer you drinks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A stunning Caribbean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pristine white sands and turquoise sea. The sea is warm and crystal clear so snorkelling is absolutely brilliant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand beaches stretching for miles with coral-free access to the water.  Absolutely stunning!  Given the time of year, yes, there may be some grass washed up on the shore, but there are many workers cleaning the beaches every day.  The constant solicitation on the beach is annoying at first, but eventually the beauty of the beach will help you ignore them.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice very clean hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was in the adults only part of this complexvery large you need to use the little train to travel around the other hotels in the complexlots of different resturants  to choice fromThe 2 buffer ones in this part where very goodif you need a boat trip just go onto the beach turn left and walk to the pier and small villageSecurity is very goodCould not understand why the disco was closed as in the Casino it was crowdedcoco bongos was very busy so could not see the reasongood hotel for adults only

reviewsWithKeywords.title: It’s nice but not the nicest
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s nice but there are much nicer beaches. The water here is never calm. So if you are nervous in the water….there will always be lots of waves. Every morning was too rough to go in, but by noon it started to settle. No snorkeling here is it’s all sand and nothing to see with the waves constantly turning up the sand. Lots of resorts don’t take and clean up. A few do so just double check on the reviews. Locals trying to sell things are annoying. They start at 8 am and go until dinner time….everyday. You’d think after seeing you daily and asking you every single time the same question, they learn not to bother. Nope…wow😳 I prefer beaches in Aruba and grand cayman over this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To me the best beach in Dominican Republic. Amazing sand, great water, no seaweed. Always seems to have lots of people walking the beach. Love people watching.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Seavis yours and Ingrid takes me and my husband there in a private excursion.  The pristine beach, beautiful colors of the water, the soft sand…gorgeous!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach was where we started each day after the wonderful breakfast buffet.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach was beautiful, the seaweed was cleaned up each day and the servers + bar were always there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous beach with turquoise water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I entered by Catamaran and enjoyed snorkeling and rum in a fresh coconut! It was an experience of a lifetime. The water is clear and the sand is incredibly soft and fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Standard beach - but beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely pale sands, turquoise waters. Lots of sun loungers allocated to the neighbouring hotels. Has people  trying to sell you products and hair braids walking up and down beach.Water has  a fair bit of seaweed in it, not ideal for those scared of jellyfish!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach that stretches for miles.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nicest beaches in the world. You can walk for miles in either direction. The West end of Bavarro is secluded and pristine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! The water was so clear, and a beautiful blue. The sand was not rocky, would go again to this beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach with a lot of palm trees for shadow. The water is shallow and very warm, only sand on the bottom.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful sandy long clean beach and clear turquoise waters.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Powder golden sand which extends for miles against a clear turquoise blue sea, and backdrop of palm trees. Some seaweed in places. Lots of water sports and activities on offer, beach vendors are there but not too bothersome. It is quite windy, but to be fair it just takes the heat away from the sun making it bearable. Idyllic beach location, which is cleaned and debris cleared several times a day. Certainly one of my favourite beaches worldwide!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Blue water and Clean Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We chose Punta Cana because of the beaches and this didn't disappoint. Clear blue water, clean beaches and cool sand.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just gorgeous and relaxing. Sand and water we excellent. No public sellers. Wreathed was great the whole time. A constant breeze kept us cool in the sun.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely white sand beach with turquoise, warm sea. Plenty of sun beds and shade too.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was fairly quiet when we visited. May be busier in normal peak season. There are lots of sun beds (and plenty of beach sellers too! )

reviewsWithKeywords.title: DR best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: During our 2 weeks in DR we drove all around the island visiting beaches on south, north and here in Punta Cana on the east coast.By far the Bavaro beach is the best we've been. It's a postcard beach you see in ads with leaning palm trees, flour white fine sand and turquoise sea. Sea weed was present, but not that much and was cleaned regularly. Paradise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: great beach by barcelo bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: amazing views..seaweed under control ,not a lot, cleaned everyday at least at barcelo bavaro (february).. no people trying to sell you something ..beach secured by barcelo .... when you leave barcelo bavaro area some places people trying sell you something or give boat tour start show up... beach itself very beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro is the only beach we’ve been to in the DR, but it’s beautiful. Abundant clean white sand that is fairly level and continues well into the ocean.Mostly a string of all-inclusives along the beach, but the beach walkers were chill and there were few beach vendors to bother you.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful soft white sand and bright blue waters. Out front of Melia caribe. Nice volleyball court where we were.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best beach in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Sea weed aside, this is the best and most classic of all the beach Punta Cana has to offer. wide sandy beach, calm waves, and very little current perfect any swimmer abilities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: IS THIS PARADISE?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow, I have never been to a beach more beautiful than Bavaro Beach. The water was gatorade blue, yes I am not exaggerating. The sky was clear, the weather was perfect, no humidity, the sand was almost white, water was tolerable, just everything about Bavaro Beach was perfect for a January. AMAZING

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Most Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You can walk for miles! The sand is white the beach is clean and the water is sparkling. You can play in the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful area of Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Loved it here!  The sand is so white and soft, and the water clear!  We stayed at the Dreams Royal Beach, and highly recommend this resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Water is very rough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand is beautiful but you need to be a strong swimmer to go into the water because it is rough all of the time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: i wont be going back.  Staff needs to change their attitude.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beaches were horrible.  Full of sea grass.  Not well maintained.  Coral everywhere.  Food was good!  entertainment was goos but staff were unfriendly and did not properly mingle.  Women staff were the most unfriendly.  Rooms were okay nothing special.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice walks and runs, long beach, very safe, some shopping and water activities
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very busy with lots to do, water activities, excursions or just relaxing.  The water is nice and in some areas very shallow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water is so clear and to die for. Depending on the exact area your hotel is at, you have more sand or less.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: fantastic!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with lovely sand and easy access to the ocean. There was some seaweed but not much. The water was as warm as the air!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Beach of My Dreams
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had heard about beaches with super-soft sand, and now I know the myth is real.  I'm ruined for all other beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awful vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This place is less than desirable. The hotel and beach was dirty. The employees didn’t speak English. Not helpful in anyway. The food was awful. They had no idea what celiac was. We had diarrhea every single day we were there.  They really don’t like Americans. I would never travel to the DR again. Such a shame.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's beautiful and nice.  If you're looking for a beach for great photos and beautiful scene, this is the best spot on this side of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro Beach is Amazing!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is gorgeous! Even though it is the pacific ocean the water is turquoise like the carribean. The beach and water are white sand - so no rocks or coral to make it difficult to get into. The beach is soooooo long - and amazing to go for long walks. Depending on the wind - the wave are small to medium - so depending on where you enter the ocean it will be easier or more difficult to get into - but this allows for places that are fun to play in the ways or just to enjoy floating around or cooling off. Varadero beach in Cuba is similar - from what I can remember - it was at least 20 years ago. Long  - which sandy beach! There is a gentle slope for walking to which is amazing. I can't say enough about this beach. You can see huge waves breaking in the distance where the coral reef is - however I don't think that surfing is a big thing in the DR. There were kite surfers out most days though. No sharks cause of the reef around the entire island and also didn't see or hear anyone talk about any jellyfish either! Hope you get to see if someday - if you haven't already.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach to stroll along and cool down in the water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort plus quite a few others are based along this beach. It goes on for miles and is great to stroll along with your feet in the water. There are many others doing the same and this was our daily exercise. There’s also lots of water sports available.Swimming in the sea was very popular.All the sales people on the beach are extremely polite and friendly. They are all licensed, wearing the same colour polo shirts with their name and number on display. If you’re not interested, they immediately respect your wishes.My wife had 3 massages along the beach, set back a little behind the sign Kukua, who were very good and a third of the price charged at our hotel.There’s a lot of hotel security and tourist police patrolling the beach which always felt very safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worst resort I ever seen.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: 5 stars have to be 2 stars, staff don't like to work at all treat you as garbage. Food is terrible and the push you in paying to much for a little service.Never again I visite this brand.Please don't go to this resort iff you want a great holiday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a busy, but extremely beautiful beach.  Every day during our 2 week holiday we would walk for miles along this white sandy beach, backed by palm trees and many hotels. Beach is very clean but there is a seaweed problem which is attended to daily.  Sea is warm and easily accessible.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too rough.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Waves are extremely rough and the beach is very narrow. Annoying salesmen constantly badgering you to purchase their cheap knock-off products..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Walked on the Beach, beautiful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were located on Playa Arena de Gorda but I walked until I get to the Bavaro Beach it was a gorgeous beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, amazing vibes and food. Love the people and music. If you go try to book at Los Corales Beach, amazing area,secured, lot of restaurants,supermarkets, best area of all Bavaro👍🏼

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach at the riu complex
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We found the beach around the hotel beautiful butdid have seaweed even though it was cleaned everyday i also found the waves quite rough so only ventured into the water once

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Poor
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Never go in Bavaro and in Dominican republic ! Choose St.Martins, Barbados, Bermuda or other famous destinations because DR is crowded with poor people and they are thieves. I was robbed in front of my eyes, they took me all credit cards, all money in cash and police is unuseful. I decided to go only in very checked destinations. Only thing I can not deny - they are realy beautiful country. Many good people but all see in you just money. That is my case.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice white sand beach and warm tropical water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband loved going in the water from our Dreams Royal Beach resort.   The water was warm, the beach clean and the sand was soft on the feet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: BARCELO BAVARO PALACE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: CLEAN FUN GREAT RESORT, pools and ocean spotless would be number 1 place to go but the drinks sucked, the bartenders rude and could not understand English, this must be fixed, also the lunch staff were rude and also could barely understand english

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have just come back from  a week staying a resort on this Beach , lovely sandy beach lined with palm trees , blue  water with some big waves to play around in , yes there are vendors walking up and down but i found none of them aggressive in any way and a simple no did the trick , lots of Water sports available  as well !!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Seaweed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Way to much seaweed they should at least try and clean the beach in the morning…the seaweed is out of control and it washes up on shore

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach....too many vendors.  Can't walk 20 feet without someone trying to sell you something.  Most were okay with a 'no thanks' some were more aggressive, because of this, we only did one beach walk.  Had there been less vendors, we would have walked the beach daily.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More of a pool person than beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was nice !Red flag a couple days Nice white sand white caps far out. Lots of swimming area. No lifeguards when we walked the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Super Clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and shower areas are very well maintained! Always a lounge chair available, and life guards on duty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The overall experience was good.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The rooms were great, no complaints about the property (it was beautiful). My only complaint was that the food was not great. I am gluten free, dairy free and allergic to eggs and it was REALLY hard to find options that were not covered in sauces and difficult to know if those sauces had flours or thickeners. I did my best, but was surviving on lunch meat, lettuce and carrots the whole time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean  Beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Beach is beautiful and clean, perfect for watching the sunrise and relaxing, water is clear and warm

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Looking for a Punta Cana Chauffer?
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My husband is Dominican living in Punta Cana.  We are waiting for his visa to be processed to come live in the States.  We have been to many locations on Bavaro Beach.  It's beautiful with many establishments to eat and get chairs.  At different times of the year, there is lots of seaweed on the beach.  However, that's mother nature and once you hop over it the ocean is wonderful.  My husband, Freddy is driving for Uber and is the friendliest person (speaks great english) to get you around Punta Cana!  Text him on WhatsApp at 829-740-5528 for a personal chauffeur!   He used to be a butler at a resort, but since coronavirus business has been slow.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Girls Trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We love visiting Punta Cana. We were just there last week and the beach is terrible. The water is brown, gross and smells like sewer. There is no more beautiful blue sea. Can anyone enlighten me about this?

reviewsWithKeywords.title: best of beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we love this beach, much better than Cuba or Mex.we love the sand, the water, the people, even the palmeras :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worst vacation so far
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Before going to PuntaCana you sould know this. It will safe you time and money. You vacation could turn into s disaster in minutes

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beachside was absolutely beautiful with an amazing sunrise. Sunrise is around 6:30am and the view is stunning for photos. Depending on your resort there might be various ocean activities in the area. I highly recommend staying at the Grand Bavaro if you want to relax at this beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What a beautiful surprise!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beaches, amazing people, amazing EVERYTHING! I was with my wife for the first time in Dominican Republic with not that big expectations, but our holidays were among the bests of our life! Highly recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing water and beach service. Very clean and quiet! Have no complaints. One of the best beaches ever.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful, but beware sellers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We visited Bavaro Beach in September 2021. There were lots of seaweed, but they have trucks cleaning it.Beware the sellers! They will ask you to come with them, and try to sell you overpriced souvenirs, activities, and even drugs. The "shopping mall" they try to take you is crowded with other sellers and some threatening people. Don't go with them, tell you're not buying anything, and safely continue your beach walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dirty water, a lot of algs
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Dirty and smelly water, a lot of alg in it. Beach is very nice but you can't go to the sea... Very sad because I think they don't care so much about it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Average beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been to some awesome beaches and even if not covered in stinky seaweek Bavaro beach seems average. The beach is narrow, and the ocean is choppy but not enough to enjoy the waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too much seaweed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So beautiful but the seaweed kills the vibe. Lots of vendors also made it a little hard to relax.  Great for walks but not for swimming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Thrill ride!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We did the horse back riding and the buggies. We had sssooo much fun!! We rode the horses through a country side. The buggies was more of a thrill ride. Prepare to be full of mud and dirt. But it was one of the most fun memorable experiences I have shared with my husband and my Children. If you are into a thrilling day definitely go for it. You will love it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dominican Fun with the Family!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Pros: Beautiful grounds , easy to get around , good drinks , fun beach activities, variety of restaurants, our room had an upstairs loft which we loved. A lot to do at night: casino, arcade , bowling , shops , sports bar  and a dance club . Two water parks which my daughter loved. Cons: excessive seaweed( you can smell it from the pool) buffet is under staffed and we often sat there without utensils.  They did not have a poolside grill and we could not take food from the buffet to eat by our chairs by the pool . (I saw people bringing food out but I was told by the manager no ! )Air conditioning in the restaurants didn’t seem to work well . A few nights it was uncomfortable during dinner. Some of the staff were friendly others not too much! Covid tests ( go early ) it gets busy . It took us about 21/2 hours to finish everything. Overall I think it’s a very nice resort !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Only one word can save to describe this piece of paradise and that is beautiful. After almost 2 years of not taking a vacation, when we finally landed in the Dominican Republic and saw Bavaro Beach we almost cried, tropical paradise!!!The beach is lined with hotels and some are nicer than others, it can get crowded and noisy at different parts of the day at different times, but still, no complaints!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Escaped the Seaweed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Little disappointed with all the seaweed and some of the hotels you walk by on the beach don't seem to care cleaning it. We searched for some options and luckily found and post from Nancy xpo tours and contacted her. She arranged us a Saona Island tour with NO SEAWEED guarantee. Book through their web site XPO tour DR which went really smooth and next day we were on the most amazing beach I've ever seen.Thanks for the great day at Saona and please, hotels please clean your beach in front of the house.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach even with seaweeds
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went during seaweed season and even this time the beach is beautiful. The hotel had barriers that keep most of seaweed from reaching the protected beack and they cleaned the sand everymorning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I think the Bavaro Beach is the best beach in Punta Cana. White sand and blue water is what makes it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice enough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is supposed to be the most beautiful beach in Punta Cana. We thought it was ok. Mexico has much prettier beaches.  Water not as blue here.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Reality of Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach is not on the Caribbean Sea, it is on the Atlantic… there for there is seafood everywhere.  If you want truly want crystal clear waters visit the area of Bayahibe.  The sand in Bavaro is beautiful as long as you are not at the waters edge.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best place and best beach in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing resort even with pandemic regulations.  They try there best to serve you.  Food is amazing and rooms are super comfortable, spacious and super clean.  The Barcelo Palace rooms are Junior Suites all of them, with jacuzzi in the balcony.  The premium level are just the new buildings that are the same and some have very closed beach front.  Pool is huge and they clean it every single night. I payed $25 dollars for a Covid test that was never asked for.  The only thing they asked for was a form of the CDC that if you don’t have it they will provided it at the airport.Restaurants in the hotel are great, and the buffets are amazing.  They don’t serve lobsters anymore, :( but the always have fresh seafood available every day.The beach is kids friendly.  It doesn’t have waves much.  It is just a natural pool.  I personally love it.  During this horrible aglae season the resorts cleans the beach constantly. I have been going to this resort since 2008 and I have experience other places and other resorts, but like this one so far none.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Quiet and Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Mother Nature was/is not kind to this beach at times.  The seaweed is massive and a daily problem.  HOWEVER, the staff at the resort work tirelessly to clean it up; seems like a loosing battle but I thank them for their efforts.  The palm trees provide a lot of shade for those who are not sun worshippers.  Perfect choice for your time in the DR.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Vacation Ever
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The TRS TUQUESA IN PUNTA CANA, DRit’s by far exceeding the bar for service, their attention to detail, warm treatment and their food and beverages make it a must visit location. On the pool the attentions from Dolores, always taking care of keeping us well hydrated and always with the nicest surprises like fresh Mango and Pineapple, all just to make us feel at home. Felix in Reception was alert and ready to help and give us great and sound advice. At Capricio, David was great his attention to detail and leadership it’s obvious from the moment you are greeted at Capricio. The food was perfect and the service impeccable.Rhandy was so great and attentive from coordinating any possible detail. His knowledge about the country was so helpful and his guidance was always right on spot.I would comeback to the TRS at no time because it’s the place where they made my wife and me feel like home.Thanks for a great stay.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately there was a rare invasion of tons weeds coming to shore which made it very difficult to get to clear water to swim. They were over a foot deep on most of the shore!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beqch, destroyed by too many resorts
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with white sand and turqioise water. There is a lot of hotels along the beach. Bavaro beach is supposed one of the most beaufitul beach not only in the Dominicana Republic but also in the world.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not practicable at my hotel
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Before I travel there I read that is the most beautiful beach on the island, so, probably I had big expectations. I was disappointed because the beach was full with vegetation and the personnel was not able to clean it because the sea bring everyday other and other. I swim once in 7 days .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro Beach Is The Real Deal
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Cana means sugar cane in Dominican.  Bavaro Beach is 17 Km or so from Punta Cana, and it is the most famous beach in the area- and for good reason.  The texture of the sand is fine and granular.   It is cuppy when you walk on dry sand, but it is firm and does not "give" when wet, so you can easily walk into and out of the mild surf without having the sand sucked out from under your feet.  You can also take nice strolls along the beach due to the sand's firmness.  Bonus: The mild breeze keeps you from sweating when laying out on a beach deck chair.  We are staying at the Occidental Punta Cana (excellent-see separate review) and there are a number of other All Inclusives in the area.  This is a great beach to enjoy and relax on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were looking forward to seeing this beach due to the reviews and information in blogs etc.  I think the people that give it five stars haven't seen a five star beach in their lives! Do t believe what you see on Instagram. I to can take Instagram worthy pictures, but in reality the beach is full of seaweed. I mean mountains of it! Some hotels try daily to remove it with a JCB. Then you have the fumes coming from that. Hotel resorts have taken over the beach. They try to stop you walking passed. But remember every beach in Dominican Republic is public. Just tell them that, it soon shuts them up. You can walk all along it as long as you don't use their sunbeds etc. Then you have the hawkers. Constantly harassing you to buy something or go on a tour.   We could only lay for 40 minutes to an hour before we had enough. It definitely wasn't the dream beach we were expecting, so very disappointing. Bayahibe beaches are well nicer with less hassle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach  was beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was hard to get to water a couple times because of seaweed. It was beautiful. I did love the waves. Love it!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach Holiday

reviewsWithKeywords.title: First but not last visit to Hyatt Ziva!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The Hyatt Cap Cana Ziva and Zolara are so beautiful!  The rooms are lovely. Our 1 bedroom suite was very large with a huge master bedroom and bathroom. There are many restaurants to choose from and we had someone asking us if we needed a drink every time our glass was empty. reviewsWithKeywords.title: We have been victim of an organized robbery in this Resort. Don't make the same mistake !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When we arrived the safe wasn't working. We immediately asked reception to fix it but they never came, and we have been robbed two days later.We immediately called security, who denied receiving calls from us regarding the safe and accused us of lying about the robbery. The Resort didn't show any understanding towards us. Which is unacceptable for a hotel of this standard.The boss and the head of security were determined to put the blame on us and deny all responsibility. They then asked us to leave the establishment which placed us in a precarious situation, in the street, without money or internet connection.In total, 4 days of vacation were wasted, including those of friends we had met during our stay who were arrested for several hours, in addition to all the valuable things we lost. Our vacation was a failure, which is the saddest part of this story.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: What you can do as you walk Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I enjoy walking the beach for several reasons. One is to see all the resorts long our walk. Seeing how the ocean changes in color and in calm water to pretty nice waves. Being able to walk into the ocean as you walk along. Hearing a variety of languages from other walkers as the walk past and chat with their fellow walker. People from all over the world are at Bavaro Beach. So different in many ways, yet the same ... enjoying the sun and the surf of this beautiful beach. The joy of just being able to walk for a couple of miles or more if you choose and then being able to turn around and retrace your steps to your home resort. There are even several small restaurants where you could stop and get a drink or something to eat. Shops to purchase some trinkets to take back home as a remembrance of your trip to Bavaro Beach. If you are an early riser you could go down to Bavaro beach and watch the sun rise. I do this every chance I get. I take pictures of this quiet time when a new day begins on Bavaro Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We have been to Bavaro Beach, Punta Cana several times over the last 4 years.  We have stayed at Bahia Principe Ambar, Occidental Puna Cana and Bavaro Beach Resort and walked about a mile and a half in both directions from the resorts.  It is one of the nicest beaches we have found.  Some times of the year it has a lot of sargassum seaweed.  Last year, it had some severe storms and a lot of the beach and Palm Trees were washed away but the beach seems to be coming back.  Most of the Resorts have not reopened so the beach is not raked so it is not as nice for walking but you can walk for miles if you want.DR has changed it's requirements for tourists.  You do not need to get a COVID-19 test before arriving.  You must fill out a health questionnaire and they will do random testing of  passengers before immigration.  The resorts are doing everything they can to prevent the spread of all infectious diseases.   If you are afraid of getting sick, hide in your basement.  If you want to live go on vacation.
