Slightly hassled by locals trying to get you to buy things, bit not too badly. They left you alone after a while. Shame as the water looked lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Caribbean at its finest!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is special...it was the first place I experienced the Caribbean sea and the pristine beaches that make it the paradise that it is. My first experience was that of a jet lagged tourist awake at 5am having only arrived to the Dominican Republic 7 hours before I was sat in bed, eyes wide open when I seen the sky turning to lighter shade of blue.I knew the likelihood of actually getting back to sleep was not going to happen, so instead threw on some clothes and strolled down stairs and onto the beach. It was quiet, cool and serene. Yes at that time of the morning there is some seaweed, but there are also teams clearing it with rakes ready for the busy day ahead.Strolling along the sand, it was already warm to the touch, scrunching between my toes it was soft and not grainy and rocky like you get in the Uk. I sat perched on the edge of a sun lounger and watched as a couple of other people walked along the waters edge and the maintenance teams cleared the seaweed.I sat and watched out to the sea whilst the warm breeze swept across my face and the sky turned from the light blue tone to a warm pink. After a few minutes the sun broke the horizon and glided across the rolling waves braking on the shore. It was relaxing and peaceful and a moment of bliss.Returning to the beach later in the day around 11am it was clear the quiet and peaceful time I had earlier that day was not going to be the case but instead the beach had transformed into a bright, vibrant and energetic place to be. Music playing, people sipping cocktails and swimmers galore it was a place to enjoy.Occasionally there are the odd sellers walking the shoreline offering cigars, photo's with animals but not often enough to become irritating and they were quick to move on if you were uninterested in their offering.This beach is the one to be at, I was very fortunate and was staying at a resort on this beach and as such enjoyed it at all times of day in its quietest and most energetic forms!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place I suggest, great people. And great activities, amazing Buffet's. The workers were nice and we all got what we paid for I would definitely go back there again!👍🤜🤛👏👌

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bávaro Palace Deluxe (paradise)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: My family and friends have been there a couple of times, lovely place, good food, great entertainment during the day and night shows are awesome. The staff will do anything to make you feel at home. Hotel rooms are very spacious, excellent food and room service. Bávaro Palace has the pirates pool with artificial waves, we love it. Great place for couples or a family vacation. It has around 7 restaurants my favourite one is The Japanese. Come to Dominican Republic and enjoy the weather, beach, good food and great people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach was at our resort.  We had a section just for us with palm tree covers and lounge chairs.  The water is an amazing blue.  The beach is lined with palm trees.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unsurpassed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Incredibly beautiful. Turquoise water. Tides make the gold beach grow or shrink twice daily. Palm tree forests hide the buildings of the inland resorts. While sunbathing, walking, swimming in the ocean or sailing you may believe it is totally wild and natural all along the shore. Still very clean despite big crowds of vacationers sunbathing or walking along the waterfront. Cleaned daily by motorized teams. Spectacular sunrises, different every morning. Warm water all year around, swimming possible even in winter. Nice warm breeze eases strong insolation, occasional clouds are irrelevant. Make sure to wear sunscreen, hats  and other protrective clothes; many careless people with serious burns can be seen around!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best bar none
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Been to Bavaro 4 times now. Bavaro is one of the most beautiful white coral sand beaches in the world. You can walk it for hours it’s so long. Large sections are very wide so lots of room. There are a few small sections that have washed out from storms but they are isolated. Surf is not super rough due to the reef but it IS an ocean fills so there are always waves. Reef keeps sharks etc out so it’s very safe for swimming. Not many weeds and most resorts do constantly take what does wash up. Yes there are sellers on the beach in a couple small clusters of shanty style shops and they will approach you but they are not rude, just politely decline and keep walking and they will leave you alone. Once past the 500ft of shops it’s clear again for miles.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach I've Ever Been On
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our resort was actually on Arena Gorda Beach, but the entire strip is awesome - very clean, and the access to the water is safe - almost entirely sand not rocks.  You can walk for absolutely miles and miles if you want to.  Loved it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Even better the second time around
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This time at TRS Turquesa was a fantastic 11 days of relaxation and service by a wonderful staff! It's difficult to share the most efficient butlers, but Randal and Jose definitely were our favorites. Jose spent an hour trying to find us a decent clicker for the TV... and always did things with a warm, wide smile! While there are a number of great restaurants available, we usually went to Helios... because the food was fresh, plentiful, and delicious; the buffet had too many dishes to count. Also was wonderful to see Jesus...  one of our favorite waiters.  Also love the 2 Hectors, Anito, and Wilvin. Can't forget our man Nilson - truly and "excellente" man! We loved the time on the beach and the drinks like Miami Vice that our server brought. Snooze, drink, have lunch on the beach...  someone has to do it!!!  The room was beautiful and spotless; the fridge was filled daily.Service was extraordinary; too bad it had to end. BUT: next year 2 weeks!  Can't wait

No trash on the beach very clean.  Not a lot of shells or annoying seagulls.  Great walking beach.  Some licensed ‘hawkers’ walking the beach but most were respectful and not a bother with a simple no.

Only thing to consider is the constant bother from locals trying to get you to stop into their “shopping centers”.  Just say no and keep walking ... they eventually give up !

reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach stretches on for several kilometers and is a beautiful walk. Lots of people are there walking the beach and enjoying the sand. Walk early in the morning to catch a beautiful sun rise and a less crowded beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Does not disappoint

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This has to be the most beautiful beach I have ever seen!!!  Whitest sands and blue waters....   You can walk down the beach forever and enjoy the sights of the Atlantic Ocean!  It's a must see in Punta Cana!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach and water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches! Water is clear and clean, an amazing place. We stayed at the Bahia Principe Grand Punta Cana. Amazing staff and beach.This all being said...The beach is flooded with mobile vendors, tour salesmen and ‘pay for play’ operators of parasailing, snorkelling etc.  Add in that there are multiple helicopters flying overhead constantly, I did not find the beach experience ‘relaxing’, but if you’re interested in getting your picture taken with parrots, monkeys and iguanas, you’ll be fine.FYI....EVERYTHING is negotiable. We asked about a parasailing trip for our family, started out at $90us per person, settled on $35 per, and I’m confident we could have gotten lower, but I felt dirty and greasy after the day, simply from all the real making and constantly being asked to buy something.My opinion only, I just didn’t like the constant barrage while trying to relax.Beautiful beach and water though, amazing, and I could tolerate just about anything to go see the sunrise each morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Purchased a day pass for the Barcelo Bavaro Beach Resort Hotel.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Purchased a day pass at the Barcelo Bavaro Beach Resort.  Be sure you tell the driver you are going to the resort.  A day pass will include private beach access and the resort is all inclusive.  You do not need towels, they will provide them. You will need a driver's license as you will have to pay at the security gate and they will put a band around your wrist. Drinks and food are included. My wife did not have her license but it was not a problem since I had mine.  Security guard was very friendly.  This is probably the largest buffet I have ever been too.  It was spread through several large rooms and the food is high quality.  The beach is beautiful.  There are a lot of people, but with the palm trees, sitting just off the water with the bar near by is fine.  This is well worth spending the day there if you are in port on a cruise like we were.  We were thinking about going back there for a week, but a couple with us had been to the Bavaro Beach Resort near Playa Del Carmen was much better.  Still when in Dominican Republic this is a great place

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Vacation
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach is very clean and you walk anywhere in bare feet as it is mostly crushed coral. My only complaint is with trip advisor who ridiculously won't  allow you to write what you want to say so I probably won't do a review again

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach.....but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is exactly the turquoise waters one would expect,...of you’ve ever seen a pic of the DR. The issue is the resorts line the strip of beach...so if you like people watching and herds then great! I would check out Juanillo Beach in Cap Cana! #8 in the top 25 Caribbean beaches! It’s quiet, and for those who like the sand clothes sunbathing, it is quiet enough to do so!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: one of the best unique beach with different types of waves few feet apart
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One the best unique beach of earth.This is beach where one experience meeting of Atlantic ocean and Carribean Sea. Its an awesome to experience this. As one walks on Bavaro beach from Barcelo resort up north to Secrets resort. Along the way one can observe and enjoy how waves are very less near Barcelo resort area with more carribean feel and how waves pick up a little around Lopesan resort area and more waves near Melia resort area and after that if one walks more north one can feel extremely high waves reflecting Atlantic ocean. This is one of the most unique thing one can experience only on Bavaro beach. depending on ones mood and requirement of waves, one can enjoy that part of beach suited to them as some may like less waves, some may like medium waves, some may be high waves typical to Atlantic ocean. I would confidently say Bavaro beach is one of the top best beaches of earth. The sand is sooo soft. walking on sand with bare feet feels soooo good. I would highly recommend Bavaro beach to every one.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a huge beach outside a number of hotels and it is kept lovely and clean, their are hundreds of sun-beds and palm trees too get shade. The sea was a little choppy but great for jumping the waves. Enjoy

reviewsWithKeywords.title: peacefully beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we stayed on bavaro beach...always clean and beautiful and i hate to see the erosion happening...what an amazing area

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Adults only beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: TRS Adults only beach is beautiful and has many covered areas as well as sunbathing areas. The women can go topless. If you are not staying at TRS rooms you are not allowed to use this area. You know this by the colored bands that you wear. There is 1-2 guards at each end of the Palladium property and some walk  throughout the beach area. I always felt safe. You can walk for miles on the white sand beach. Make sure to bring a hat to protect yourself from the sun when walking. The sun can be very intense. Waiters come around for drink orders on the TRS beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach is beautiful....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To add to your travel bucket list
reviewsWithKeywords.text: According to UNESCO, Bavaro is nothing other than one of the three most beautiful beaches in the world. Shining from the top of its prestigious podium, Bavaro Beach includes 40 kilometers of soft white sand and postcard views.We went for one week at Majestic Elegance, so we only enjoyed a small part of its length, taking daily leisure walks. Surprisingly, the beach vendors are not aggressive, and they take “No, thanks” as an answer. Don’t be shy to apply high factor sunscreen, and watch your step when is windy. In addition, if you have a disability, the waves may surprise you, watch carefully once in a narrow portion. Enjoy the safe and long stretch of luxury resorts.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is gorgeous with little bars and restaurants along the way. There is some seaweed but all in all, very clean and safe.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Beach for Walking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach was clean. Shallow and easy to walk in and wade.  Some beach vendors would approach but not overly aggressive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is actually amazing and clean but be aware of hustlers on the beach. We actually loved the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: All Inclusive

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beaches, get a spot at a resort or bar

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Speed Boat Rentals on Bavaro Beach Update
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Last year I was asked a question about boat rentals on Bavaro Beach.  I went back to the place rental boats are located.  In last years review I posted a very negative review.  The rental boats were trash, beaten hard and put to bed wet.  I was surprised when this October I was in the area and I saw that the owner must have seen my review.  He purchased 6 or 7 new boats. They told me they were built in Canada. I didn't take pictures showing the new boats.  But don't to excited.  They look wonderful from a distance but when you get closer you see they are starting to look beaten.  They sit just off shore all day long in the surf which is hard on the boats.  The people who rent them run them hard and the surf beats them up a lot. Don't get me wrong, these boats are 80% better than the boats they replaced but in the few months between when purchased and October they show wear and tear. The outboard motors are new and they are fast.  If you are going to rent one look them over before paying and pick one that is in better shape.  It was good to see they upgraded their fleet of rental boats.  I watched them launch the boats and the way they do it works for them but I would never use their method. They have a wood trailer and the put half of the boat on the trailer and a half dozen men will run it into the surf.  At the end of the day they drive the boats up onto the beach at high speeds.  I know that sand is not rock but constant running up onto a sand beach each night has to cause minor damage after a couple of years

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Punta Cana As a Backpacker
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I went to Punta Cana from Sousa during a backpacking trip through the DR. Once I arrived, I discovered that the public transportation in Punta Cana didn’t turn out to be terribly complicated as $40 DPO (.75 cents) got me anywhere I wanted to go in the regions surprisingly efficient public transportation system. My first run was a little rocky as I attempted to go to the beach and ended up at an outlet mall. However, once I got familiar with the area, I was able to go about wherever and whenever I wanted. Although the hotel wasn’t terribly impressive, the neighborhood that it was in, Fruisa, had pretty much everything I needed. There were two gyms, an internet café, and several ATM’s within walking distance to my hotel. There were also several juice and empanada stand within a two-block radius. Had it been closer to the beach, it would have been an area where I could see myself staying long term. I did finally make it to Playa Cortecito, one of the main beaches in Punta Cana. While it did have white sand beaches and aqua blue water, 95% of the beach was either closed off to the resorts or had motorboats zipping through the water. There was really no place to lay a towel down without being hassled by a security guard or an excursion salesman. However, I did eventually manage to find a bar where I bought a non-alcoholic Pina Colada for $200 DPO ($4 USD) which secured my access to one of the restaurants beach chairs. I ended up staying at the beach for a few hours before calling it a day. In between relaxing at the beach, I continued to do extensive work on the travel website which is getting more detailed and refined by the day.To say I survived the three days in the outskirts of Bavaro would be overexaggerating, nevertheless I was glad to finally be able to move out of the Hotel 2 Bavaro to the White Sands Bed and Breakfast closer to beach. I left the hotel yesterday at 11:30 AM. I hate traveling with my backpack because it automatically identifies me as a tourist and puts a target on my back for locals to hassle me or try to swindle me out of my money. I would face this problem not even 5 minutes after I left the hotel as I stopped to get lunch at the local empanada stand. I went to same place that I had been frequenting the last few days where the empanadas cost $20 DPO (.40 cents) a piece. I ordered two and gave the guy a $50 DPO bill. With my empanadas in hand. I sat there for about three minutes and waited for my change of $10 DPO (.20 cents). When it became obvious that he wasn’t going to give it to me I called him out on it. Even though there was a sign that clearly stated the prices, he (and his mother) tried to claim that there was a “tax” on the purchase. I might have believed him had I not come to the same stand at least five times in the last two days. I told him there was no tax and asked if $10 DPO (.20 cents) was worth getting the police involved. At that point he knew he was wrong and went to give me my change. I let him keep it because it was never about the money, it was about the principle and I had made my point. I caught the local bus from the central plaza to my new hotel. However, halfway through the drive, the bus pulled over and we were told to get off. It turns out that the bus caught a flat tire, and I would have to wait for the next one. As a result, I stood for about half an hour on the side of the road with my big touristy backpack. After turning down every moto driver in the city, the next bus finally arrived. I got to the stop and knew I was in the right place when I had to help 2 girls communicate with a moto driver because they didn’t speak Spanish. I walked about 800 meters when I arrived at the hotel building. I walked into a lobby and told the lady that I had a reservation. She was adamant that I didn’t and when I showed her the receipt, she said that was for the OTHER hotel located in the same building. After trying the “other” hotel, I found out that the building actually had four hotels in it and I didn’t find my hotel until the last stop. Despite the difficult in finding it, the owners seemed to be fairly nice people. The husband was an American white guy that spoke perfect English while the wife was Hispanic (not sure if she was Dominican). They actually gave me an “upgraded” room with a bigger bed. After settling into my temporary home, I spent the next few hours working on my website. The hotel was fairly close to the beach and while there was a nice comedor with cheap food, the beach itself was designed for tourist groups and there weren’t many chairs for lounging or relaxing. All in all, while I did get a more authentic experience than being in a resort, there are much better beaches in the Dominican Republic that are less touristy and corporate

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Just beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was our first visit to the Dominican Republic and at the the Bavaro area. Reading some of the reviews on here we were wondering if we had made a mistake, especially about the seaweed. All I can say is we didn’t experience any real problems with the seaweed at all. There seaweed did tend to drift in a little but nowhere enough to bother us. Yes, there is a constant clear up operation in action from the locals with tractors but we thought this to be a positive thing. They take pride in their beach and do everything they possibly can to maintain it. I don’t understand why people have a fault with it. The sales people on the beach can get a bit tiresome and repetitive but we found none of them to be aggressive or challenging. They simply took no for an answer and moved on. We are looking at returning back to the Dominican next year and we will be definitely staying in the Bavaro beach region. The beach is stunningly beautiful and exceeded our expectations. I just wish I hadn’t taken so much notice of some of the petty comments on here. Please note the general amount of seaweed we encountered on our stay in my photos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous...but it also depends what youre looking for....
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We took two tours to Bavaro, one to snorkel and the other to para sail...cant recall the tour company but I found them through concierge at Excellance El Carmen ( great staff, felt safe, and very reasonable prices, especially for the memories made!!) So we left our very quiet resort area and headed to the main beaches of Punta Cana and Bavaro. They are gorgeous, white sand, crystal clear water , small waves and ALOT less seaweed than on the Atlantic bay our resort was on...however...it is crowded, screaming kids, drunk tourists wearing thongs they have no ...and i do mean NO BUSINESS wearing any where near kids or anyone with eyes. There were alot of pushy vendors, which understandably are trying to make a living, but we were warned off by our captain and guides, suggesting that they might not be the most upstanding citizens to exchange cash with. As you travel from one location to another , You will find it impossible not to notice how lovely and kept the tourist areas are in comparison to the abject poverty that is a majority of the area.  Its a wonderful , beautiful, busy area but it seemed counterproductive to relaxation...so..if you're looking to party, family style and people watch...great place...if you're looking for quiet relaxation...not so much...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice beach but sad to see so much animal abuse
reviewsWithKeywords.text: bavaro beach is very nice. there has been sargasso just like in other  parts of the Caribbean but people are trying their best to  clean it everyday. the saddest part of this beach is a group of guys who seem to work for a company that exploits animals such as monkeys, iguanas and birds. these guys make these animals be in the sun all day jumping from perspn to person and allowing everybody to take multiple pictures which  ultimately leave the animals blind. in several occasions i saw the monkey and the birds screaming when the workers pucked them to force them to do what they wanted. Please, think thats this "cute animals" are actual living beings and are not toys. while people keep taking pictures with them, this type of  bussoness will never stop amd everytime more animals will be forced into labor with chains on their necks. this beach would have been a much nicer place without any of this abuse.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful resort, nice people, okay rooms
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Apple Vacations dropped the ball on our late check in. By the time we got to our room, all the places to eat were shutting down and preparing for dinner. Our room's air conditioner broke and we spent the whole first night sweating in our room. They sent someone 2x at 11PM and 1AM and it was still broken. I complained the next day and demanded a new room. They upgraded us and we were satisfied, albeit losing a day of our vacation. The food was take it or leave it, with the afternoon snack bars the best options. The Italian restaurant was very good. The place is beautiful and the people are very nice and hospitable. The servers and maid services were just fine and the rooms were clean. The pool bars are fun but a younger drunk crowd was a little too much for our tastes. Oh and you can't get a good beer, only that El Presidente stuff, which tastes like tiger piss I'd imagine. And you really can't get good booze, I had to settle for Jim Beam instead of any good bourbon.All in all though, we had fun, a beautiful resort with friendly staff,good breakfast and awesome views. Tips: Don't spend too much time with your hosts, all they want is to make you spend. If something is not up to your liking, let them know but don't be the angry American. If you leave the resort on the beach side, wear your headphones, sunglasses and a hat to shield you from the relentless barrage of natives begging you every two seconds to buy their products.And if you do,haggle until you get the price you want

A little seaweed on some days but nothing terrible (nothing like the situation in Mexico) Bavaro is now one of my favorite beaches. I highly recommend and will visit again hopefully next year :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Royal Bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches were very clean, no pollution or trash and I especially admired the resorts not providing straws to keep the wildlife safe. I also loved that they only utilized plastic drinking cups so that glass would not hurt anyone if it were to break on any of the surfaces near the beach. The resort staff did an amazing job cleaning up after thoughtless patrons and keeping the lounge furniture nice and neat. They also did a great job keeping the seaweed from building up too much on the shore. Understandably though it’s hard to control nature but the water was warm so you can’t complain about seaweed when the beach and ocean were so beautiful. We had one person come up to us to partake in a water adventure but the solicitation on the beaches were not bad at all. We walked them quite often and were never asked anything or bothered. The armed patrolmen made you feel safe, but we had no problems at all even walking close to evening hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: White soft sand, beautiful sea.  It's fabulous with plenty of water sports, well worth a visit.Even when its coudy its still gloriously warm.  Plenty of sun beds and the Riu Hotels dotted along.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: nice day at the beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we had  great time here. its relatively clean and not too far. we saw some kids activities and some shops. but didn't really explore any shops. they didn't seem right. jet ski was a lot of fun too. great day at the beach!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and Relaxing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, lots of activities for the kids.  Hagglers selling junk, but not to bad. Beautiful light blue ocean

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 10 Km of Heaven
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very clean beach 10 km long.  Take some water with you if you plan to travel off the resort as you can't get it anywhere else

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is just lovely the sand is so white and  the sea blue and turquoise with parasailing and more beach activity’s for a fee .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is amazing, this is the happening place to be, Bavaro knows how to party. The beach is very calm, relaxing and beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Rather busy but lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is powder soft sand and the sea, on a calm day, is crystal clear.  No rocks to hinder getting into the sea. Take some bread and watch the fish gather.  Bliss.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and clean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful turquiose waters, the beach and sand is fine. Beautiful palms everywhere. You will not be disappointed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No shells
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful wide beach with sand as soft as new carpet. Only disappointment is no shells to hunt for; not even any pieces of shells. Lots of seaweed when we were there but still beautiful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Clean beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our first trip to DR and this beach was very well manicured.  After reading plenty of reviews about the Punta Cana beaches being loaded with seaweed, I read this beach was different.  We were not disappointed!  Gorgeous white sand and minimal seaweed on the beach.  Workers were diligently clearing each day to rake away the seaweed so guests could enjoy the beautiful soft sandy beach.  We would definitely visit here again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water at the beach was very nice & warm. The sand was so white and fine. The best part about the beach is that it’s very clean! I loved it! Let’s not mention the beautiful Caribbean sunset!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Majestic Elegance, Bavaro Beach, Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! A bit cloudy around May 19th-25th, rained a couple of times but it didn’t last long. Plenty of lounge chairs and cabanas. Not crowded at all during this time of year at the Majestic Elegance. Sun rises at 6am! Noon-2 seems to be the sunniest time at the beach. Nice long walks and visited other resorts. We 💙 Bavaro beach. Our 3rd time back in Punta Cana 💦💙⛱ Always a good time! ~Sheila & Justin~

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Relaxing Beachfront
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Walked the beach and relaxed a few hours a couple of days while in Punta Cana. The weather was perfect both days, enjoyed the beauty of it all. Just say “no thanks” to the beach peddlers; the only downfall to the best day at the beach one could have.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not crystal blue
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Although it looks so from pictures, the water isn’t crystal clear and blue, although still very beautiful. There is a huge seaweed problem but the sand is combed and the seaweed removed quite early in the morning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful with white sand. You can walk the beach a long ways either direction. There are shops and restaurants nearby as well.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean white sand beach crystal waters great swim warm water loved every minute of it, I am not really a every day beach person but I spent a lot of my days there lots of seating and cabanas.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great soft sand and beautiful water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro is my favorite beach in Dominica Republic. The Atlantic side is calm and the beaches are wide with lots of area to walk and swim. It can get busy but never overcrowed. Great place to people watch. there are beach venders but they are not overly agressive and juat trying to survive too. Seaweed anc be a bit of a problem but many of the resorts pick up seaweed daily and I noticed some have their own tractors to remove it. I wish they had more professional massage place like Mexico where it is $30 an hour for a message by a trained professional.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Took my breath away
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a beautiful place to remember why you’re in love, and to fall in love all over again... not just with others, but with yourself. We stayed at a hotel, less than 2 minutes walk to the oceans edge, and watched the sun set, and rise. Lovely, temperate water, always a perfect turquoise blue, and soft white sand. A little piece of paradise.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Graduation/anniversary celebration
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful clean beach. Staff worked very hard to keep seaweed down. Disappointed the ocean trampoline was down for service. That's why we picked this particular resort ,Dreams Palm Beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: White sand and soft waves
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand is beautiful and mostly clean.  There is a fair amount of seaweed that washed up each night but the resorts keep it cleaned up.  The water is beautiful and the waves are minimal.  Lots of beautiful palm trees line the beach and the sun rises over the ocean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach, very clean!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very clean and lovely.  We always make sure that we are on this side of the island when we stay just for the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful White Sands!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach is one of the prettiest beaches I have visited, however there can be a bit of seaweed during the peak season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I could lay on the beach all day. No seaweed and plenty of chairs to layout on.The waiters service on the beach was awesome. The breeze was perfect one of the best beaches I have been on.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Clean sand and gorgeous views!Just stay clear of the peddlers that want to charge $50 to take photos with their monkeys, lizards, exotic birds.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach.  Workers clean it every day for sea weed and debris. Beautiful sight of the ocean which is so nice to swim and play in.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is so nice.  The sand is soft, and not hot like other beaches I've walked on. The water is warm and relaxing. Vendors stroll along the beach selling local crafts and jewelry. I like that option.. saved me time from walking into town and being able to buy things right from my spot on the beach. There is some seaweed, but not like the kind that wraps around your legs, this kind just swept by to the shore.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Week in PC
reviewsWithKeywords.text: great clean, walkable beach. water was very warm and just the right amount of waves. it does get shoulder deep pretty quick.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect sand, clear water!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach - whether to sit or take a stroll, it is relaxing! There are vendors throughout the shore to sell various items, if you so desire.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Bavaro
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches anywhere. With soft white powdery sand and turquoise water, what more could you ask for? There's also ample palm trees for shade if the sun gets too hot. You can't go wrong in choosing to spend time on Bavaro Beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach ever!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I been to several beaches including Montego Bay Jamaica and this beach by far out ranks them all. They water is so clear and still and the sand is so fine it didn’t even bother my daughter who hates beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: epic photos and sunset
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am a true beach lover and boy oh boy the beauty of this beach was spectacular. very clean beach except for the washed up seaweeds. lovely views, many activities on the beach, lovely shade area if you like and refreshing cool Caribbean breeze. Take my advice and wait for the wonderful sunset you could ever see. trust me. water had strong currents so be careful. besides that its beautiful and enjoy. thank me later

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not a beach lover
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not a beach person but the beach is a nice refreshing place to relax. Tons of seaweed that washes up on the sand but to be expected. Watched the sunrise one morning. Nice blue water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bahia Principe Amber in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Can’t finds a better all inclusive in the Caribbean!The rooms , staff and restaurants are fabulous.Can’t say enough about this resort🏝

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, bright blue waters, soft white sand, goes on for miles, never feels too crowded. Loved it

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Awesome Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sand, warm water and miles of beautiful beach for romantic walksThe water was as warm as a pool. The beach was actually pretty clean of sea weed

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Miles of white sand and blue ocean. There is the issue with seaweed but you'll find that all over the Caribbean.Lots of vendors along the beach but they'll leave you alone if you ask them to.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dolphin swim
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent a whole morning with the offshore dolphin aquarium, were we learned of the dolphins and swam with them tickled them and kissed them bye bye, then over to the nursery shark pool for a snorkel with the rays and sharks, fantastic staff, great team of trainers and well worth the visit

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Excelente Lugar
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An excellent place to spend the holidays or for a trip in itself a place and pleasant to take the family or the companion

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Kittiwat Lertpenmaeta
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach in Punta Cana. Very clean, sand is beautiful and white. The water is clean and crystal clear. It is located near many large all inclusive resorts in Dominican Republic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Anniversary Trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: went to the beach as part of an excursion. Beach was not clean and locals were very aggressive with solicitation

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Gorgeous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We walked about two miles each way.  One way was full ofresorts and the other had undeveloped land. Sunrise is at 6:00 I highly recommend going!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunningly beautiful beach/ CONSTANT undending stream of vendors
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach marred only by the fact that you cannot get a minutes rest due to the constant stream of vendors plying their wares.  "No thank you" doesn't deter them, they come back again and again and again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft Sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not the widest beach I've ever been on , but one of the cleanest for certain. Lovely soft sand with the occasional bit of Coral. No problems with hawkers as they move on if you say no thanks. We walked in both directions from where we were located and not too much seaweed present end of April / start of May. Lovely beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beaches were pretty with wonderful light colored sand.   Great Caribbean locale.  Xoxoxo.  Would return.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Could be nice ...too many solicators !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice beach but too many vendors ... a lot of seaweed ...expected it to be better more relaxing and beautiful ...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely a must go and see! This is probably one of my top beaches I love everything this beach has to offer. I know the seaweed at time is a bit much but your at the ocean its not like you can control this

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft Sand Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Every time when I travel to Punta Cana, I select a hotel that is located on the Bavaro beach. Beautiful, bright and soft sand, nice and usually calm waters, not good for surfing but great for everything else (paddle boarding, water bikes, kayaking and so on), and that extensive walkable stretches of beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Dirty beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Did not like the beach that much because it was dirty. Some areas were clean but most of them were dirty and smell disgusting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wow!!! Wow!!! Sensational Speechless just amazing if you visiting Dominican Republic is a must!!!!!White sand,clear waters!!!I highly recommended!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Resort
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The resort was spotless, the staff was amazing, and the fact that you could go from resort to resort to try different buffets and bars was great. We went adults only and couldn't have been happier. Beach was beautiful and clean as well. Would definitely recommend.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Depends on the time of year
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Love my sea water but Bavaro can have challenges depending on the time of year.  Some parts of the beach experience a lot of sea weed where others do not.  In early spring the Rip Tides and high waves are there making it hard to enjoy but Dec-March is a perfect time to enjoy the beautiful beaches and almost clear waters.  Never found the waters like parts of Cuba or Barbados that are crystal clear but overall a beautiful place.  I have seen on average 2 weddings per day on the beaches here and this is only at 1 resort.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Entertainment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Solani is a great entertainment manager. She makes every day so much fun!Very kind and helpful!Thank you so much!As for the hotel - its amazing!It has so much to do: restaurants, shoping, evening shows, very good customer service!I strongly recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to visit Dominican Republic.🌴

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Impressive premium resort and spa
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Trip of a lifetime- I have never met such amazing and friendly people The weather was perfect and the beaches are well cared for

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro Beach was impeccably clean and well maintained. All the employees were extremely kind and caring. My forst time
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful service, all inclusive means ALL inclusive- even minibar! Wonderfully maintained beach, great cuisine, versatile activities and friendly faces. I liked the adults only feature too.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Like something from the TV
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the IBEROSTAR hotel, the beach front was amazing... clear blue seas, spotless beach.  Depending on the waves, the beach varied from gently sloping to gently sloping 10 1.5 M the dropping off to more 2 M.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: beautiful beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heaven on Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavero Beach has some of the most breathtaking views I have ever seen. The water is so warm and inviting. Clear and turquoise waters as far as the eye can see. Very clean beach. The sand is like powder. Very comfortable for walking. You can walk for miles and miles and not be disappointed. Lots of opportunity for water sports. Parasailing, kayaking, paddle boarding, boating, snorkeling...you name it! My most favourite beach that I have visited. Will definitely be back. See you soon.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: stunning beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Bavaro beach is absolutely gorgeous. Crystal blue water and very small waves make it perfect for even families with small children. The constant gentle breezes make it comfortable in 85+ degree heat. The sand is fine and there are no rocks anywhere. The gentle waves make for a very wide and gradual slope.One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Secrets Royal Beach Preferred Club
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On arrival you hear “Welcome Home”, champagne served, and top-service. Like arriving in Paradise. Massive pool-beach porch, Like a week of total Calm. Food not far, not spicy, weather in April was 83 daytime, 73 night, nice breeze, white sugar sand beaches. Can’t be beat. A definite return site for sure.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: 6 times 2 plus one
reviewsWithKeywords.text: we have been visiting the carribean to differant spots for over 25 years,and we have found bavaro beach to be one of the best there is ,soft white powder sand very calm waters,and the beach is almost flat which means its very good for long walks as it won.t make your back sore and its a beautiful long beach,strewn with lots of palms along the way,beauty in paradise

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a very beautiful beach, clear water and white sand.. a great place to relax and enjoy the nice weather of the DR!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Bavaro beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Heaven on earth! Amazing, although were was alot of seaweed, but the water was warm and the beach was white sandy warmth and goodness 😁

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Sunrise.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were here for our nieces wedding but managed to watch the sun rise a couple mornings, which was beautiful.  The beach was very clean and you could always find a lounge chair either in the sun or in the shade. We were never bothered by people selling things which was really nice.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful excursion
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Awesome trip snorkeling was out of this world. Loved the dine buggies. Party cove was awesome. Drinks were great

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Soft sand and warm water.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you like soft sand between your toes and warm ocean water, then this is the place for you! Try it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spring Break
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful blue waters. White sandy beach. Lots of water activities to do. Lots of seaweed in water and on beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The family and I explored the beach just off of the property of the Royalton. Beautiful sand, not too crowded, and not a vendor in site trying to sell us anything. We happened to be there as a wedding was happening. And it was a very pretty site.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great Beach, Regularly Cleaned.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really nice beach, clean and tidy, entry to sea good, can have good walks along, not much shade as not many palm trees at the waters edge, but good shade just off the beach, we spent a lot of time on the beach, good swimming.Recommended.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely clean beach. A few vendors but they ask you once and then leave you alone. There were a few shops at one end

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spring break in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is an excellent resort for couples and families. Lots of activities, good restaurants and a lovely long beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Barcelo brava palace
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Just got back. Beautiful place and the beach was awesome. Spent 7 days in the sun and on the beach with my wife, 16 daughter and 14 year old son.  The water is calm and beautiful we swam non stop. There is no snorkeling so don’t try. Seaweed in not bad a all but there is patches of grass in parts. Sand is white and soft it’s  Paradise. Be carful sun is hot hot hot as in all islands. Trade breeze is a life saver. Things to know if you have teens and want them to stay young! Topless women and thong back bottoms are on the beach! 10% of the absolutely beautiful women are topless daily! Not the locals but the tourist.  My 14 year old son grew up a lot this week. We saw 4-5 lady’s daily with no tops and at least one person (men and women) per day changing at the beach generally with a robe or towel hardy covering themselves. Seem stupid to me because bathrooms are 12’ away.  Tuesday we had a stunning beauty that was sitting 5’ from us drop her bottoms bend over and put a dry pair of shorts on. This was a full and clear shot directly in-front of us. By the time shock value wore off and I looked at my son it was to late! That poor kid ended up sun bathing his back for an hour, if you know what I mean. She turned around and faced us and took her top off and put a shirt on. She just smiled and walked off. This is not that weird I saw things like this all week just not at that distance.   My daughter was not kept from the naked body either. Men in short shorts with their junk falling out were daily. We had a guy 10 chairs away fast asleep one day with his legs up and his full penis out had fallen out of shorts. He had a dozen lady’s infront of him taking pictures and videoing. I wanted to tell him but didn’t, he made Some Interesting home movies I’m sure hahaha. Beach chairs are gone by 9:30. I throw my towels done every day at 8:30 and went to breakfast. We had no issues. The local market on the beach in not for the faint at heart. It’s overwhelming for sure. Lots of aggressive vendors. But as long as you expect it it’s fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You will not regret visiting Bavaro Beach.  The white sand and aquamarine and turquoise colored water will leave you breathless. It's a safe, and clean beach and a few spots that offer various water related activities.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Water was MAGNIFICIENT
reviewsWithKeywords.text: this was a beach we stopped at during our boogie ride. absolutely beautiful. The history behind the beach and location was so enlightening and interesting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What we like most is the beautiful wind sands, little shops on the beach and is so calm - a must to walk each day for a great, relaxing time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice stay at the Royalton
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at this hotel for 7 nights in January (sorry for the late review). We had an awesome time. It was our second stay at a Royalton (we stayed at the Cancun one before). The hotel is very clean, very modern and well situated on the Bavaro Beach strip. We had a few issues - not really affecting our 5 star rating - but wanted to share. We were assigned a room that was an adjoining room (but we were not travelling with another party). I am not sure if that is the reason we could hear every single noise from the other room (as the connecting door may have affected the room soundproofing) but it was awful. The room next door housed 5 people, which at least 2 were children (1 a baby) and we could hear the baby crying at all hours of the day and or night. We could hear coughing, talking,etc. It was quite annyoning and we eventually asked to be moved. The staff was willing to switch our room. We have never been to a hotel where noise was an issue. We were on the 2nd floor... and we could hear noises coming from the 3rf floor (floor above us). It sounded like they were moving furniture or moving/dragging stuff on the floor. Not sure if this is a poor construction issue or an issue of guests being disruptive and or excessively noisy.  The 2nd issue we had was the kids. There were kids EVERYWHERE. By everywhere - I mean, we were tripping on them at the buffet restaurant, tripping over them at the nightly bar/disco area YES !!  At the infinity pool (not the kids pools) kids were crawling everywhere. I thought that by having a very nice children’s pool, a lazy river and a shaded wading pool that we could at least get some peace and quiet at the infitinity pool. NOPE !  I am not sure if this is a hotel that caters to children, but we have never been to a hotel where there were kids everywhere at all times. We sat at a late dinner at the Italian restaurant and a father was singing a lullabuy to his baby, rocking its stroller (at 10pm!).   The food was very good. The buffet was very ordinary. Good variation and ok selection. We’ve just had better buffets at different hotels. The a la carte restaurants here though were all above average and all excellent. We had excellent steak at Hunters (and we never get steak down south for obvious reasons but this was recommended to us and it was delicious). We went to the Italian restaurant twice because it was that good ! The Martini Mix bar was excellent. Great selection of martinis and the staff were so nice and friendly ! A big shout out to Miguel Angel (makes the BEST Peach and mango martinis!) and Osivis Cabrera. Best service ever !!! All in all, we would recommend. The hotel is extremely clean, nice decor, nice beach, nice staff, good food and drinks. Don’t hesitate to book !PS we also visited the other Royalton Punta Cana. It seemed a bit larger, nicer and had more boutique options inside the main area. If having to choose between both of these I would probaby go to the Royalton Punta Cana - but that one seems to be more expensive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Place to Relax
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very peaceful and relaxing place to visit in the springtime.  The ocean was lovely and food was so good.  Just a pleasant place to travel to for a relaxing treat.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very clean, soft sand beach. Water was clear. Stuff was only strong 1 out 6 days.  Best beach  I've seen in awhile.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Forget it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Went there as part of a day trip only to find 2 dozen local residents on it as well as 2 traders trying to sell you gifts and the beach was full of rubbish. And apparently this is the local beach for the locals. Annoyingly you'll also see a lot of people walking around with either a monkey or a parrot tied to a string and asking of you want to take a photo with them. Not only do the animals look distressed but then they try to charge you $100 US dollars. Funnily enough I was well pleased when a Canadian couple got into an argument about this and ended up paying $40 to them!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach but Rought Surf
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous for a romantic walk at sunrise or sunset but getting in the water was impossible the entire week we were there in February. There were excursion boats on the sand so maybe the surf isn't always so rough but we saw red flag warnings every day we were there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mother and daughter
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is a beautiful place and wonderful staff ! Are Butler Jenfry is a wonderful guy who can do anything for you ! he is very kind and,  can’t forget Marcos the awesome pool server guy attended to refreshments with a smile on his face , this place is very peaceful and serene! Would recommend this place in a minute

reviewsWithKeywords.title: bavaro beach at iberostar
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This was my second time to bavaro beach because it is so beautiful. The sand is silky, the water is beautiful and clean and you can walk forever down the beach. I’ll be back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lush Sand on Bavaro Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water is clear at your feet and the shades of blue and green in the ocean is beautiful to see. We saw a little red algae but not much and many resorts were maintaining the beach line. The ocean waves were nice to see because many islands are building breakers to to keep the waves low and still. So we enjoyed the rolling ocean waves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach in Punta Cana
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is the most sandy beach in Punta Cana.  Lots of other beaches but this is the softest and biggest all sand beach.  Great for family.  All the resorts here are first rate (Barcelo Bavaro as an example).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overall great beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a very nice and clean beach. You share it with multiple resorts, a lot of it with Grand Bahia resorts, so expect a lot of people. If you are looking for a secluded beach, this is not the beach for you. There were no sand flies or sand fleas while I visited during the March, 2019. Only thing that bothered me was the amount of seaweed in the water (I just didn't like slimy feel when it clung to my body).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sandy beach you can walk a long way lots of hotels lining the way. Boat trips available

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Calm relaxing and amazing color and plenty to do . Great place for a walk and to rest  clean and amazing white sand

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach but..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Our beach was lovely but most mornings it was covered in seaweed! Our hotel was good and would be cleaning it up all day but this meant it was floating in the sea and wasn’t crystal clear like the pictures, lovely beach though!! reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best Beach!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This is one of if not the best beach I have been to. I spent a day here but wish I was there more. The atmosphere, sand, people and water was amazing.  The water is blue and green in parts. There were catamaran tours, speed boats. parasailing and more right when you walk up. reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great area
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spent quite a bit of time here, and enjoyed the atmosphere, sand and water. Gets hot!  A lot of room, and not a lot of "sales" pitch traffic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand was so soft, the water was beautiful, the view! Paradise. Locals do try to sell you cigars and things like that but they were not forceful when you say no. When we got there a lot of seaweed had come up on the beach but they were bagging it up so people did not have to swim in it! Most beautiful beach I have ever seen!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Warmest and Bluest Waters I have ever seen
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As we were looking for a place to go on our girls' getaway, we tried to find a place where we could fly non-stop and where the beaches and water would be blue. We got a lot of advice and they all said, if you are going to the DR, YOU MUST STAY ON BAVARO BEACH. So, we made reservations at a hotel on Bavaro Beach. I can tell you that we did not spend too much time in the pools. The sand is as soft as powdered sugar...having had been to many Caribbean locations and beaches, I can honestly say that I have never felt sand this soft in my life. Not only soft, but clean and white. The ocean was as blue as I have ever seen it...maybe close to the Bahamas, but still absolutely gorgeous. No matter how deep you go, you can see clear to the bottom, which is white sand. There are some little reefs, if you want to snorkel and see fish. We swam out to a beautiful sand bar  and enjoyed sitting out there in the beauty of it all. We went parasailing and kayaking....the water was incredible. On another note, we didn't have any one hassling us on the beach to buy things. I have always had this experience at other beaches at resorts and islands previously visited. It was nice and quiet....going for a walk without feeling hassled and safe was also awesome. We will come back here again and again, FOR SURE.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach around..goes on for MILES!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So glad we booked a resort on this beach! You could walk for miles and swim anywhere along it..just beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The beach is beautiful!

reviewsWithKeywords.text: Excellent adults only resort.  Nicest I have ever stayed in. The swim up room we had was luxurious. The all inclusive restaurants were top notch. The help and visitors so friendly. Rooms and property very clean.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great beach, shame about the rough sea !!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were staying at the RIU Republican in bavaro for two weeks. We are beach & sea lovers. The white sand beach is a great beach, that you can take long walks in either direction. Every hotel has its own section of beach & you know when you come to the public beach as there marked out of bounds. I use to walk out of bounds all the time, it’s perfectly safe, but the rubbish at the back of the beach is chronic to say the least. The hotel beaches are cleaned every morning, the out of bound ones are never cleaned, which is a shame for locals who like to go to the beach. The other draw back was the sea, it was very rough to say the least. Global warming winds have not helped the waves in this part of DR & there’s the tropical storms that hit the Caribbean. September is the worst month of the year for storms in the Caribbean. We had none in late June & early July. It rained a few times but mainly at night time & it’s  always warm with or with out sunshine. One warning about the sand, from mid day onwards it can get boiling hot depending on the amount of sun, so it’s hot on most days. The wet season is May to November, but it’s not a monsoon, it can rain for 10 mins then the sun is back out. Plus quite a lot of rain is in the evening, which is ideal. If your a Brit TuI only fly to punta Cana now, which is a shame as the sea & beach in puerto plata are outstanding. Plus starting from May 19 TUI are putting all exit taxes in the Caribbean on the ticket price. So that’s when my next Caribbean holiday will be, where depends on the best deal !!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Perfect beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the nicest beaches we've ever visited. Warm ocean waters which were calm & easy to swim in. Beautiful sand - clean, pure, soft. Lots of open space - it's a huge beach with plenty of places to hang out.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach but a bit more hectic than I prefer
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful white sand beach. A little more crowded than I generally go for (Anguilla's more my style), with a steady flow of locals hawking cigars, pareos, jewelry and other items. The water is warm, with heavy seaweed in certain spots. Seaweed is raked off some parts of the beach with regularity (but why did they do it in the middle of the afternoon right in front of my lounge chair every day?). Also a lot of activity in the water close to shore-- parasailing, booze cruises, etc.

reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love to walk on beaches and Bavaro Beach is one of my favorites.  It has hard packed, clean, and level sand and weare able to walk in either direction for miles.  While there are some solicitors trying to get you to shop or purchase trips, once we told them we were not interested, they pretty much left us alone the rest of the week.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: snuba diving
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Have done many excursions in the Dominican in the past but wanted to try snuba diving.The excursion I would give a minus on the snorkeling site and snuba site not much to see.Speedboats were driven at ridiculous speed.I have a boating licence and own a boat .People were being very dangerous.10 thumbs up to them tho they were very honest.My hubby lost his GoPro camera and their camera guy found it. I spotted it as they were bringing in the equipment and we gave him a generous tip had we had more then 25$ on us we would have given him more.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ANDRADE FAMILY !!!! INDIANA
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is really good, really fine sand really beautiful water color but just a little bit more cleanup for washed up seaweed on the beach would be great. The weather is excellent and 5 star waiter service for AMBIOTRIX. Excellent and very efficient person, when we had an issue with not being able to find an umbrella he took it upon himself and volunteered to bring us one with a smile on his face.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definitely use again  4.5*
reviewsWithKeywords.text: First time to Punta Cana, Barcelo guest for last 6 years, mainly in Mexico.  Rooms were nice sized, ours well kept.  To my surprise, no liquor in the mini fridge here, and beer stocked every other day, unlike Playa Del Carmen.  Beaches are Beautiful,  Pool was nice, clean, STAFF VERY FRIENDLY.  Had a slightly harder time communicating but that is on me, I know very few phrases in Spanish, they were definitely more bilingual than I.  Buffet's were good, more variety every other night even would be good.  Restaurants were all very good to me, some I liked better than others.  I will return during non-spring break month and suspect 5 stars will be a non-issue.  oh yah, check in and check out, a breeze, unlike Mexico which can become very time consuming, at least in my experience.  Only reason for not giving a 5 star is the food, which is a tough one I know when trying to satisfy so many different nationalities and taste buds.  Beaches are beautiful......oh yah, may have said that already :)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This place is nice if you want a vacation completely shut off from the country you are visiting.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: White sands, white waves breaking, and a whole lot of fat white people. This really isn't the beach for people interested in discovering more about the Dominican Republic.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed at the Royalton Bavaro where the beach was well kept, but still had daily the accumulation of seaweed. We walked to the other Royalton and depending on the other hotels the beach was cleared or covered in seaweed, Water was warm and relatively clear.Nice beach but the seaweed is becoming an issue

reviews.title: Extreme Seaweed on the Beach
reviews.text: Staying at Occidental Punta Cana right now. (January 23, 2026) Bavaro Beach is as wonderful as ever, EXCEPT that this year the seaweed buildup is the worst that I have wver seen. It is a foot high on the beach here every day. The ocean is full of it to the point that swimming is not possible without getting weed all over you. If seaweed on the beach is something that bothers you, I’d recommend the Caribbean side beaches at Bayahibe at the moment. They do their best at removing it here at Bavaro. The rake machine went down the beach at 7 am yesterday and by 10:30 am the beach was full of weed again.

reviews.title: Saona Island
reviews.text: We were not able to make this excursion because the driver is never present to take us there, fortunately we were refunded without problem. It's a shame because it's not a vacation that we may not be able to take anymore. TripAdvisor had nothing to do with this.

reviews.title: The island is beautiful but the things around it overshadowed the experience
reviews.text: I want to share my experience. To begin with, I had a very good day visiting Saona Island. Now I would like to talk about the problematic points.First, the morning driver picks you up at 7:45 a.m. to take you to a meeting point, but the actual departure is only around 9:30/10 a.m.Once I arrived in Bayahibe, a man who introduced himself as the owner touched me to pull up my dress because, according to him, my chest was showing too much. I did not feel any malicious intent, but it was clearly inappropriate and unacceptable.Then, there was an incident on the way back. On the way there, the driver picked me up at the correct address, but on the way back, the new driver, Alfri, tried twice to drop me off at the wrong location. He seemed annoyed and was mocking me. Other passengers in the car, concerned for my safety, told me not to speak to him because they were getting off and I would be the last one remaining. Once everyone had left, he calmed down and started making jokes about the fact that he was “Moreno” and I was “negrita,” “very black black black.” In my country, this would be considered colorism.I wanted to share my experience because you will have single women booking with you, and it is important that they feel safe and comfortable with the behavior of your team.I contacted customer service (Andy) to ask for the owner’s contact information so I could share my experience directly, but he refused to provide any contact.

reviews.title: From Kenya to Punta Cana: An Incredible Experience!
reviews.text: My first time in Punta Cana, and wow — what an unforgettable experience!We stayed in nearby apartments just a short walk from the beach, and everything about the stay was fantastic. Even with the language barrier, Google Translate made communication easy and added to the fun of the experience.The food was absolutely delicious, the drinks were flowing and refreshing, and the overall vibe was warm, welcoming, and full of life. I’m from Kenya, and it was a pleasant surprise to meet people from Haiti who knew about Kenya because of our peacekeeping mission there — such a small world moment that made the trip even more special.I would go back in a heartbeat. Punta Cana is vibrant, beautiful, and full of great people. Highly recommended — this is a must-visit destination! 🌴✨

reviews.title: mix of calm sailing and glimpses of marine life

reviews.title: Photo opportunities

We also tried some a la carte restaurants and everything was delicious.The room was comfortable, clean, and had an incredible view. The whole atmosphere is one of total tranquility and enjoyment.I recommend this place 100%, whether for a romantic getaway or a family vacation. We will definitely be back!

reviews.title: A Mixed Bag: 3-Star Experience at a Supposed 5-Star Resort
reviews.text: My stay at this resort from May 17th to May 20th was a combination of enjoyment and significant letdowns. I'm rating it 3 stars because, for a resort that markets itself as 5-star and charges accordingly, it failed to deliver on many fronts.Arrival & Room:Upon arriving at the Babaro Beach front desk, we were met with an uncomfortable 28°C (approx. 82°F) temperature due to poor air conditioning and ventilation – it felt like we were baking.The rooms are very dated and in clear need of refurbishment.Pros: The TV had hundreds of channels, and the complimentary minibar with drinks was a welcome touch. Thankfully, the A/C and ceiling fans in the room worked well.Cons: The room's condition was poor: peeling paint, worn-out doors, dirty light switches, and a persistent, unpleasant smell reminiscent of drains.Resort Grounds & Amenities:Views & Beach: The views are nice, though not exceptional compared to other Caribbean resorts. The beach, a bay with crystal-clear water, is beautiful and rich with marine life. Some seaweed was present, but this is a natural process and not a negative in my view. However, shaded spots were scarce; you either had to arrive very early or wait until around 5 PM for the sun to lessen.Pool & Bar (Babaro Beach): The Babaro Beach pool was a solid 8/10. Though the jacuzzi area was small, the main pool was large, well-maintained, and enjoyable. The absolute standout was the open bar – it was incredible! The bartenders were 10/10, exceeding all expectations with their service and friendliness.Major Disappointments:Organization & Logistics: A major source of frustration was the poor organization of events, dining, and access to facilities.Gym: Guests from the adults-only Babaro Beach section had to walk 15 minutes in 30°C+ (86°F+) heat to reach the gym. The gym itself was poorly equipped, with only three small lockers and, shockingly, just one bathroom.Dining: Reaching the à la carte restaurants at the Babaro Palace meant another 20-minute walk in the sun. The shuttle service offered (a 5-minute ride) often had a 15-minute wait time, which was ridiculous.Food Quality: The buffet food quality was generally low.Casino: My father and I went to the casino hoping for some fun, but more than half the machines were broken. Worse, the dealers at the roulette and blackjack tables had terrible, unwelcoming attitudes, lacking any charisma or effort to make guests feel comfortable. The service was appalling.Disco: The disco was just okay – a bit small. Compared to everything else, it seemed fine at the time, but in reality, it wasn't impressive.Overall:Three days at this resort felt like more than enough. Staying longer would have likely meant either confining myself to the subpar room or risking illness from the food. This resort has potential, but it urgently needs to address its maintenance, organizational issues, and staff training in certain areas to justify its 5-star claim and pricing.

reviews.title: Good white-sand beach, firm footing, no pebbles/stones.
reviews.text: Okay, I am specifically reviewing the area from the south-east end at Barcelo Bavaro up to Huracan Beach Club (which I will call the north-west end).  There are a ton of nice-looking beach-front properties along this area — I stayed at Barcelo Bavaro Palace at the south-east end.  The beach starts narrow at the south-east and gently widens out the further north-west you get, but the beach was not crowded.  In general, the beaches are near-white sand, and fairly easy to walk on, it seeming to compact to a firm footing.  Practically no pebbles or stones to speak of.  When I did a 2-mile hike along the beach, the going was easy, although I preferred my beach sneakers on for the cushioning — plenty of folks go barefoot though.  The water is warm and calm, partly due to a lot of hotels/resorts putting out wave-calming bouys/nets.  The amount of seaweed varies, and at the south-east it is at its least, and gets heavier towards the north-west, to the point where in a couple of places they are actively harvesting seaweed washed up on the beach.  Fresh seaweed is fine, but the stuff drying out can harbour a bunch of little insects, so be careful.  I did get bitten on the ankles a couple of times in the shallows, but it seems I was in the minority, and there were plenty of unblemished folks out there.  The further north-west you go, the more “sales people” you will encounter — none of them too pushy, but they are trying to sell anything, from fishing trips and speedboat rides, to cigars and “other smoke-ables”, to photo opportunities with parrots and lizards.  For your own entertainment, if you have a tiny bit of bread, you can crumble it up into the shallows, and tiny almost invisible little silver fish will appear frenzied for the food.  Other wildlife included pelicans, a ray I saw from the waters edge, some sort of birds of prey soaring majestically, and probably some mollusks — I saw evidence of their holes, but refused to dig them up from their homes to find out.  Most of the resorts have shade of some sort — the Barcelo has largely palm trees, and the further north-west you go, they rely more on cabana-type shelters.  The sun can be fierce, so remember to top up on sunscreen and take bottled water with you.  Yes, you can run along the beach, but not many folk were — it’s hot, and nice to enjoy at “island-pace” stroll speed.

Besides hotels security like Vista Sol can kick you out as if you’re homeless or illegal here even you stay here forever and come to sit at same places, but today you can and tomorrow you can’t sit. So you buy or rent a home but even the beach is for public but hotels treat ppl as if it’s their place and we should be very careful where to step, where to be so brave and spoiled to sit (with security breathing to your back just in case you cross invisible line). reviews.title: one of the most popular shorelines in Punta Cana
reviews.text: It is Punta Cana’s main beach and is one of the largest and most popular beaches in the area. The town of Bavaro is lined with small shops and dotted with luxurious all-inclusive resorts. No trip to Punta Cana would be complete without some time spent on its gorgeous beaches. Playa Bávaro.It is one of the most popular shorelines in Punta Cana, with its powdery sands, swaying palm trees, blue waters, and a bevy of amenities, including water sports rentals, dining options, and nearby accommodations. there is so much confusion about where it starts/ends, and entrance to public beaches as 80% of beach areas are occupied by resorts. The beach stretches for 12 miles between Macao and Cabeza de Toro, but keep in mind that there are just four public access points at Corales, El Cortecito, Jellyfish, and Bibi Jagua.Bavaro Beach has several subsections that all have their name. However, they are all connected and you can explore them walking consecutively. El Cortecito and Corales are two of these stretches and are very convenient The clear waters off Bavaro Beach make it ideal for snorkeling, and many hotels on the strip include snorkeling equipment during your stay.don’t imagine it to be a crowded beach. There is always something going on, people are enjoying their beach walks and locals are sitting in the sand, but as the beach is extremely long and wide, you always have more than enough space, and it NEVER feels crowded.

reviews.title: The end of a dream
reviews.text: As regular customers of this complex, we have had the chance to spend privileged holidays for around twenty years.The passage of COVID and a change of direction changed everything.We were a little unpleasantly surprised last year, our last stay was sad, without any listening.This hotel remains of honest quality, nothing more, and this is largely due to its unique beach.For the rest, it has become completely standard, you don't get what you pay for, without more, it's no longer palace, it's a quality comparable to that of a classic cruise ship, especially for the food which has become very ordinary .No need to take the premium service, apart from the billing, there is no significant difference. (see the photo of the view from the premium suite that we had for a week).It's a shame, this hotel was a dream place for twenty years.

The rest of the days are very very slow and it is only from 10pm to 11pm. A lot of Sargassum in January, although they clean every day. A big disappointment is that if you go by train to the Palace, at least in the first week of January all the shows were children's. In short, I had a good time and the hotel is good but the money we paid to go these days is not worth it, they have gone too far. The rooms are very large but very old, without the possibility of regulating the air well and with humidity. Very important, the spectacular New Year's Eve dinner, I admit that that alone makes the price higher this week

reviews.title: Contracted Salmonella
reviews.text: Enjoyed the first few days. Contracted Salmonella on day 4 and spent the next 48 hours in room and last 4 days within 50 meters of a toilet.  Communication with staff was poor, some more helpful than others. We were in Adults only and Premium which seemed to cause some confusion at check in and things poorly explained. Had to complain about rowdy neighbours on 2 occasions, lots of young Americans(18/19 years olds). Cleaning staff were helpful brought in extra toilet roll. Food generally was OK. Steaks were good, rest of the restaurant and buffet food was mediocre. Beach was good, but quite a lot of seaweed which they tried to take away every day. As soon as you walk off the private beech you do get surrounded by hawkers, there are big signs to let you know this and also the sea weed has not been swept up. Beach is Easterly facing which is a pain as you are having to move sun bed every 45 minutes. I would not go back to this hotel or island again.
