reviews.title: Brown water with abundance of Sargassam.  Not what you envision.
reviews.text: The seaweed was not the worst of it.  The water was brown instead of the beautiful teal color we associate with the caribbean.  When we arrived on Wednesday July 26th the beach was covered with sargassam.  It smelled like human fecus.  The water up and down the beach resembled a brook.  The water was a yucky brown color.  Eventually, a small spot and I do mean small, cleared up about 50 yards from our resort.  It was a small path that lead to the barrier they hotel set up to prevent sargassam from taking over the beach.   When you climbed over it, the water improved 100% but it was a small spot.  In front of the Pearl, the water looked black.  No one was there.  I looked this up and it said it was due to sargassam and brown tide.  I can assure you the water was like a sewer treatment plant.  Attemps were made daily to remove seaweed from the sand.  I fear if this is not resoloved, it could destroy the livlihoods of many who depend on the resorts.  Check real time before you go.

reviews.title: Beautiful 50th birthday experience !
reviews.text: I decided for my 50th birthday I wanted to do a trip rather than a party. I wanted to relax & have fun in paradise. My travel agent Candi Davis,(Candice DavisExecutive Travel ConsultantEasy Escapes Travel, Incc: 302-367-7545| o: 800-294-6643candice@easyescapestravel.comEasyEscapesTravel.com), gave me options for different resorts and Bavaro Beach checked off all boxes for an Adults only, amenity packed, full service all inclusive resort. From the time I checked in until I checked out, the Bavaro staff were always very friendly, gracious, and kind. They remembered my birthday by giving me birthday greetings, singing the birthday song, and a cake, fruit platter, and bottle of rum waiting in my room when I returned from excursion. I never felt unsafe or like a tourist. I was made to feel like a visiting relative with the treatment I received. Needless to say I thoroughly enjoyed my trip & will definitely be back. Thank you Candi for recommending it & Thank you Bavaro Beach for a magical 50th birthday experience that will always be cherished and remembered !!!

reviews.title: Windy beach surrounded with resorts
reviews.text: Bavaro beach did not suit us, it is surrounded with resorts and hard to access if you are not a guest. Lots of locals trying to sell stuff, and they are really annoying. reviews.title: We would go again...maybe tomorrow!
reviews.text: My wife and I recently completed a week's vacation to "Be Live" all inclusive in Punta Cana/Bravaro.  The accommodations at Be Live included great food (better than most all-inclusives in D.R.) The resort is right on the beach with plenty of shade areas and loungers (but go reserve your loungers and palapa by 7:00a.m.!  After 9:a.m. they are hard to find!).  Each night the resort included 2 to 3 one hour long free entertainment shows and or live music.  This rates 4 star not 5, but at the affordable price of trip it was well worth it!  Arrange for the 1.5 hour Time Share presentation and say "no", and you still have the advantage of a 4 night/5 day resort package!  The beach is very swimmable, no waves or shore break, and great daily excursion options too.  This resort has both family areas, and adults only areas which made it very comfortable.  I took lots of good photos which I'd be happy to share DLDBOB@AOL.com

reviews.title: Bavaro Beach

reviews.title: Go somewhere else!
reviews.text: Noisiest resort we have ever been to! All music was  played way beyond  acceptable volume and all coming from different areas at once! Not a place for non smokers as only restrictions in rooms and even that is not monitored! Not a place for persons with mobility issues! Beach was crowded with beach chairs cramped together in many rows. Again, noise and smoking an issue. Lots of seaweed and debris.  Housekeeping very poor. Bathrooms old and in need of repair. Very poor bed pillows and dirty floors and again… noise. Staff talk loudly and shout to each other starting at 6 am!Food okay, not great.  Dishes and cutlery often dirty. Service in main buffet slow. The entire property consists of several hotels that look very similar but access is decided by the colour of your bracelet. Very confusing and uexplained. Often felt discriminated. If you are looking to relax this is not the place!

Also arrange a surprise bday cake for my husband. We can’t really say anything bad about this resort. This our 6th time at resort. What brings us back are the workers and the food. reviews.text: Kervens and chicken legs were amazing they thought us alot of dances, and they were very friendly. I love it here

reviews.title: Beach update
reviews.text: The beach used to be excellent. Now the beach is shrinking due to hurricane erosion . The sea weed was raked daily by tractor , so it wasn't an issue. The other problem due to less beach is less room for beach chairs, it will vary by hotel.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: i have been to Punta Cana 3 times and every time it has been a pleasure . This year we met  Roger on the beach who was selling tours . He usually is in front of Ocean blue and sand  or nearby . He sold us 2 tours and both were a lot of fun. one was an ATV adventure muddy but a hoot and the other was a snorkeling trip . In both cases  he made sure we were well taken care of . We screwed up on the ATV and missed the bus but he had  his cousin pick us up and get us there . And he was there to make sure the boat showed up . He was a caring person and stood behind his sales. the vendors were there but if you said you weren’t interested they left you alone. every day there was someone cleaning the beach more than once and we ended up tipping them because they work so hard.. we have always had a great time in Punta Cana.

reviews.title: Beaches
reviews.text: All beaches are great, the sand, the blue water, the sound of the waves, the sun. We spend most  of our mornings on the beach and the afternoons around the pools.

reviews.title: very nice beach to visit

reviews.title: Great resort - amazing experience.
reviews.text: Everything is pretty much as good as advertised. Nothing really to add. We had a great time and will come back if we can. The only annoying thing is the fact that many guests get up early in the morning to reserve a spot at the pool by placing "something" on the lounge/chair/bench. Only a few idiot guests are enough to trigger more and more guests to follow suit. Terrible habit, hard to kill.We only made one interesting observation, in all restaurants we visited and in the resort in general:  Nobody asks for "feedback" like "how do you like your food" etc....it seems they know why they avoid the question. I think with more feedback the restaurants and the resort overall could get better.

reviews.title: Beautiful endless beach!
reviews.text: Walk for miles and miles ! White and pink sand , very soft and sugary ! The beach seams endless, the water was warm and very few people trying to grab you to buy trinkets— they are around but not pushy!   Plenty of places to stop and get a drink or water or eats! Just beautiful!

reviews.title: A beautiful beach for a walk
reviews.text: We stayed at the Grand Palladium Resort which had very soft, whitish sand and easy access to the ocean. Seaweed was minimal and cleaned up every morning.

reviews.title: Best beach for walking.
reviews.text: Love this beach and visit it every year.   The sand is like powder and going barefoot is a must.  There is seaweed to deal with though. And long stretches of all inclusives thus reducing the numbers of accessible restaurants and bars.   The weather is excellent.

reviews.title: Best beach I have been on in 20 years.
reviews.text: Big, long white sand beach with 2 foot waves. Great to walk on for miles. In February, it had minimal seaweed. Everyone loved it.

reviews.title: Awesome vacation

reviews.title: Great beach!

reviews.title: Royal club Occidential Punta Cana

Hippolito, Wendy, Ruben and Nairobi and a few new servers Miguelina, Stacy and Johan ready and waiting for you. and let’s not forget the Chef Carlos Mattia . The food is the best and healthiest menu of all the resorts we’ve traveled to. nice to see Yeremy in the Oriental and Vladimir in the Steakhouse & a pleasure to see Jon Kelly who over sees all the restaurants. Slightly windy enough for sailing and other water sports. The only downside is the seaweeds during late summer months. Our favorite resort located in the best section of this beach is Barcelo Bavaro Palace.

reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text: The beach area was beautiful. The water is not  crystal clear, which came as a surprise. I had a great time and have a lot of memories.

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! We were staying at the melia wellness adults only resort.  Our resort connected to the beach. Very peaceful and relaxing. I would recommend you take like half a day to sit at the beach and relax.   You will find lots of water based activities to make the day even better.

reviews.title: Beach Bavaro
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Comfortable sunchairs. Very clean and in good conditions. Very pleasant beach resort.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in the world
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is a place that everyone should see once in their lifetime and if possible a dozen or more!

reviews.title: DO NOT GO TO NOVA BEACH CLUB RESTAURANT
reviews.text: My friends at I went to the beach it was very beautiful. The boat ride was amazing!! However, that NOVA BEACH RESTAURANT and its workers are a thief!! Because we don’t speak Spanish, they tried to rob us when changing US Dollars! And charged my card twice for food I did not ate. Upon contacting the owner he was giving attitude that he charged what I ate (lies) I only ordered 1 burger which they charged $700 DOP then charge me $5,962 DOP for what I do not ate or know about. He stated that he’s always right. But sir, you are so wrong, from the day you were born!! Very dishonest and your burgers makes us sick to my stomach!!!! I STRONGLY DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!PSA: I ONLY RECEIVED ONE RECIPT WITH $700 DOP when I paid with my Visa card . They did not give me a receipt that said I ate $5,962 worth of food (receipt shown was what he sent me). We did not need to buy any drinks because the boat provided beverages for us!!!

reviews.title: beachy
reviews.text: Great long , sandy beach lined with palm trees and the beautiful crashing waves of the Atlantic . The sea is too rough to snorkel in though

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is beautiful.  The water is warm.  The waves are plentiful so swimming very far out is not possible but the views are spectacular.

reviews.title: Birthday weekend
reviews.text: First time at punta cana and the experience was definitely nice from you step of the plane you feel a different vibe people are very welcome and courteous with a sincere smile the culture is what called my attention they are happy people and the contagious of happiness is in the air.

reviews.title: Beautiful site
reviews.text: Great beach and an embarking site for a lot of water-based excursions. A lot of vendors, though... Cool beachfront bar.

reviews.title: Not as expected
reviews.text: Not a clean beach. You will find cigarette buds everywhere on the beach. Also lots of seaweed and sargassum

reviews.title: Cool and Clean
reviews.text: The sand feels so nice and cool.  It's clean, but there is way too much seaweed. Maybe December is high time for seaweed.

reviews.title: Super soft sand!
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach has some of the most wonderful sand in the world. However, Sargasso is washing up on shore here like it is throughout the Caribbean. The hotels keep their beaches pretty clear but stretches without hotels have a lot of Sargasso. Windier and wavier this visit then we remember in the past.

reviews.title: Gorgeous waters, beautiful sand
reviews.text: This place is gorgeous.  Nothing like kicking back with a drink in your hand and listening to the waves crash.

reviews.title: Beautiful Water
reviews.text: While enjoying the lounge area on the beach, the frequent interruptions from merchandise sellers is annoying. The water and breeze is amazing, but I wished there was no seaweed.

reviews.title: Where did all the seweed come from ?
reviews.text: Last time we were here the beach was amazing. This trip the entire length of the beach was one big pilke of seaweed. We did enjoy the bavaro native market and found vendor #4 luis to be the most stocked best prices and luis and his son spoke perfect english

reviews.title: Royalton Bavaro
reviews.text: It is a beautiful resort with lots to do for kids, kids pool with slides and lazy river were popular with the kids. Beach was beautiful with lots of seating. We were there for a week family trip.We had an unfortunate start; our flight was 5 hours late. We were a group of 13 with 6 grandkids aged 10 months to 12, when we arrived, I told them we were diamond club but were still directed to the regular check-in where we waited for 20 minutes while the group in front checked in.  Once they verified, we were diamond club we were taken to the diamond club registration where we were treated like kings. There was a small buffet, we were offered drinks, and someone took our documents and went away to complete the paperwork while we had another drink. Our rooms were great, very large and comfortable. Buffet restaurants were great, we seemed to have some difficulty in getting an early reservation for the a la cart restaurants. I believe they are still rebuilding staff after COVID. Twice at dinner we were told they had no highchairs, I don't think the staff knew where to get them, because there were many children at the resort who would need one. Although we had trouble getting an early dinner reservation (we needed one for the younger kids) we were not always seated together and there were empty tables. Believe this was caused by a lack of staffing. The outdoor pools were all great, 2 with swim up bars, and 1 for the diamond club. Although the diamond club has access to different areas the other areas were great, and we used both. I would look at the price difference for the diamond club if I were to return..

reviews.title: Sand flea bites
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royalton Bavaro hotel, and accessed the beach via the resort (which many other hotels back on to). We took a walk along the strip for a 30 minute stroll, and although at first the beach seemed nice, we noticed there was a lot of seaweed and the sea was very choppy so we didn’t go swimming in it. The real issue however were the sand fleas. This isn’t something I’d ever heard of before, but later on that evening I realised I had 28 x red, itchy bites from my ankles to my knee caps. My friend however, didn’t have any bites (so some people must just be more susceptible). I’ve never experienced these types of bites on any beach before, but would advise that you take extra care as they’re extremely irritating to the point where it can affect your sleep. Our resort didn’t sell any insect repellent, and only had one tube of anti itch cream available to buy - therefore make sure you’re prepared and pack the right creams before you travel to Punta Cana.

reviews.title: Great beach in the Cortecito area
reviews.text: We stay at Playa Turquesa Ocean Club with it beautiful beach and 2 large pools.—wonderful area with great restaurants close by .The condos a very nice.

reviews.title: One fine beach
reviews.text: This is a wonderful beach.We walked along the shore everyday, the sea warms up by lunch, just incredible.The palm trees, make it look like the beaches you dream of and I suppose it really is.The sunsets are something else, you wouldn’t believe the colours if you hadn’t seen it.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Just spent 2 weeks lying on this beautiful beach. Walked along almost everyday, water is so warm too. Lots of seaweed but workers try to keep clean as best they can. Loved my stay here

reviews.title: All Inclusive Hotel
reviews.text: Stayed at sotogrande de cap cana a beautiful resort with a vast amount of cuisine selections ,service perfect and cordial as what u get in Dominican republic.Area of beach sea service and security excellent

reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Our experience was amazing!! The sunsets on the beach are priceless.The people were friendly, the water temp felt so good

reviews.title: beutiful endless beach
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is white sand and blue clear waters A group of hotels sit along the beach you can walk endlessly along this beach

reviews.title: Briliant
reviews.text: Great stay great place staff were good would go back hopefully with family next year till on year 23

reviews.title: awash with seaweed
reviews.text: Hotels tend to collect and pile up the seaweed which ends up stinking in the sun. Beaches are cleaned constantly

reviews.title: Our Fave in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Excellent!!! Travelled with our adult sons and their friends. We travelled back, just the 2 of us. Food is fantastic. Staff is excellent!! The family side is great and perfect for a outing but then the privilege of traveling back to the adults side for peace. My only negative is the dolphin experience being right out front in the ocean. As a advocate of Dolphins long free and this is just a poor display of how awful these dolphins are treated. You can see when they are left to the small pens. Beyond that, everything g was excellent. Thank you!!!!!

reviews.title: Just be
reviews.text: Stunning beaches. We obviously had read how the beaches are and in real life they are so much better. Even photos don’t do the turquoise sea and sky any justice. It has to be seen to be believed and of course remembered. This is one of those situations where you need to quietly be and take it all in. We did, it was very special.Go if you can.

reviews.title: Stunning -  just a shame about the captivity!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach - its absolutely stunning!Just so gutted that those disgusting,  tiny dolphin enclosures are allowed in the sea 😔 sourced from seaworld too according to our hotel!

reviews.title: Unforgettable experience.
reviews.text: White sand, blue water, aquarelle skies, great drinks, wonderful food.  The serenity of the scenery will perdure in your memories.

reviews.title: Lot of seaweed
reviews.text: The beach was definately sub-average in the area of the Royalton Bavaro hotel. Small beach front - lots of seaweed. I know there are better areas in Punta Cana - so take it with a grain of salt. But during that time in that exact area....poor.

reviews.title: Sargasm
reviews.text: We were at Iberostar Bavaro in August. The water was in brown color due to the huge amount of sargasm. Some people were still in the water since it was a natural phenomena and water is not dirty. The beach at our resort was cleaned by tractor everyday. The beach itself is wide and clean and beautiful.

reviews.title: Wave action!
reviews.text: Though this beach is not very wide the swimming is great. There is a lot of wave action and soft sand. There are also many shells to find. Especially early in the morning.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach but the vendors..
reviews.text: The beach itself was beautiful! The water was a great temperature and it was clean. We loved it for the short time we were there. But the vendors were aggressive and because of it, we limited our time there. They were consistently bombarding you when all we wanted was to relax.

reviews.title: Knowing this we wouldn't have booked this place
reviews.text: We were expecting one of the most amazing beach holidays ever, when we decided for the Carribean Punta Cana Grand Bavaro Princess Hotel. We spent almost 10k Euro to make the dream come true. When we arrived we saw it was almost impossible to swim in the Ocean because of thousands of tons of sea weed in the water and at the beach. We were told its a well known problem in the duration from July til November. The reality was: nobody was swimming in the Ocean; the pools were overcrowded and the water quality there was almost criminal. We are thinking to sue our travel agency for not informing us about this serious quality problem.

reviews.title: One of a kind
reviews.text: Everything . This place is just simply amazing. I have zero complaints Fermin was so sweet and friendly Sindy  was super sweet . I loved it and looking forward to my next stay there

reviews.title: Destination Wedding
reviews.text: Beaches were beautiful but water was rough.  When you go to Punta Cana you just don't want to leave the white sand beaches, the servers by the beach and the great food.

reviews.title: Really nice beach
reviews.text: We went on an excursion here and swam with sharks and went on speedboats at this amazing water area which was crystal clear

reviews.title: Covered in seaweed and brown
reviews.text: They told us they can not contain the seaweed for the last two years.  We had expected beautiful, clear water.  It was brown and nasty with seaweed.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: This amazing sandy beach was so beautiful. A couple of days we got a strong breeze, I loved it. Seaweed was blown in the last couple of days of our holiday, but it didn’t worry us. Most fantastic blues and turquoise sea and sky, I’ve ever seen, felt so lucky to be there.

reviews.title: Amazing Impressive Premium
reviews.text: Shout out to maximo for an amazing concierge experience. The hotel grounds were beautiful and the staff was incredible!Only issue was the seaweed but this hotel will surpass expectations for the price point!

reviews.title: Lots of waves and algae
reviews.text: Very windy so lots of waves and algae on the beach and in the water so we could not swim in the ocean; the beach is small also compared to Punta Cana

reviews.title: Amazing white sand
reviews.text: Amazing white sand and clear water near Lopesan Costa Bavaro hotel, to the left and right sides of the hotel near Barcelo Bavaro and Melia hotels tons of seaweed, impossible to even get in the water (just an unlucky period for them)

reviews.title: never calm water
reviews.text: if you like rougher seas rather than the calm tranquil Caribbean sea then this is the one for you, not my preference and a lot of sea weed

reviews.title: Clean it up!
reviews.text: The beach is FULL of kelp and the beach rake does nothing to help the situation since it goes up and down the beach without the rake down. Besides kelp, the beach is dirty and needs a good grooming!

reviews.title: Beach Experience
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach Sand & Weather were perfect!!! The Melia beach resort has a private section which was a fantastic place to be at.

reviews.title: We enjoyed the People of DR it was a great experience!!
reviews.text: Super Friendly staff always ready to help. The food was okay the drinks were fantastic. We stayed at the adults only side it wasn’t as lively as we thought it would be. The Beaches were a let down because of the Seaweed. The rooms are a little dated 70’s to 80’s but the A/C was very nice.

reviews.title: our hotel was in front of Bavaro beach
reviews.text: beautiful/clean/sandy/lots of waves for fun - lots of sports/games on the beach/ people selling lots of goodiesdidn't see much seaweedVERY upset to see monkeys and parrots being used

reviews.title: Gorgeous beach - Lots of sargassum/algae
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, but during our stay almost always with lots of sargassum/algae (and it seems to be not cleaned much, in the hotel we stayed -Occidental Punta Cana- they seem to clean 3x,4x/day, but it´s a difficult situation).

reviews.title: Seaweed Problem
reviews.text: We were told this was the best beach in Punta Cana but unfortunately we never went in. The Caribbean is experiencing a seaweed problem and it was definitely not under control. We traveled so far for the clear blue waters and white sand beaches of the Caribbean only to find we couldn't really want to access it from our hotel. Mountains of seaweed, brown murky water and too many party boats and fishing boats allowed to park on the horizon. We really wanted to see the vastness of the sea with beautiful blue water and white sandy beaches. The beach itself felt more like the brown beaches of Galveston Texas. IT was the only bad part of our entire holiday. For the water and sand you want - take a tour to Soana Island.

reviews.title: Seaweed and smells.
reviews.text: I am not sure why Bavaro Beach is ranked number one this list. It is covered in seaweed, and the water is not very clear. Macao Beach is far superior. They do their best to clear the seaweed, but because of the heat, the large heaps of seaweed stink and the smell drifts up towards the hotels and markets.

reviews.title: Quieter
reviews.text: Our resort was on this beach. It is a quieter spot as you walk both ways on the beach - due to the only adult resort we were at. It has nice sand and you can swim here. It is close to a little shop as well that sells touristy stuff, sunscreen, snacks, etc.

reviews.title: Super Dario
reviews.text: SUPER Dario ....an amazing server at the marketplace.. he made our stay that much more enjoyable.... Great job Dario 👏

reviews.title: Seaweed
reviews.text: Not sure if it is the time of year or not but the seaweed was crazy, not a pleasant experience getting in the water.  Had to opted for the pool to cool off.

reviews.title: seaweed infested pressure pot
reviews.text: i am sure you can find some nice parts of this beach.  however in ou 7 days here and one long walk i can not say we found any redeeming properties.  it certainly is pretty from your hotel pool. but many of the hotels are warm down collapsing disasters. the beach is full of seaweed.  ans the boats ans just ugly.  go elsewhere

reviews.title: Barcelo Bavaro Palace
reviews.text: The beach itself was beautiful, plenty of chairs for everyone, the hotel was beautiful also with many amenities. The restaurants were very good but would not recommend the seafood restaurant Coral. The staff was helpful and very friendly. The ocean in front of the hotel was awful, so much seaweed and algae. We went in one time only. The crew did clean the beach every day but there is so much algae it is difficult to keep up with. Loved the resort and the people but the ocean was a definite disappointment.

reviews.title: Barcelo Bavaro Beach -Adults Only
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at the Barcelo Bavaro Beach - Adults Only resort. The hotel was in pristine condition and the staff was super friendly.  It looks like it's been recently renovated as everything looked fabulous!They have beautiful facilities! From the pool area with  plenty of chaise lounges  to the 3 restaurants you'll  find there, everything was tremendous. The  staff is always attentive to your needs so that you can enjoy your stay to the max.  Our room was super spacious and had a beautiful sea view, our mini-fridge was stocked with beer, sodas, water, every day we were there!!! I was truly impressed by that. They give you a bottle of rum as a complimentary add-on. The food was ok, but the drinks were AWESOME. I was expecting "house spirits" but, no! They even have Jack Daniels, great vodka choices, etc. Now, bear in mind that the theater and bars are in the "open":  there are fans, not AC in those areas, so you'll be sweating like crazy. That's something they need to work on, put more fans for God's sake! A lot more! The only downside was having to go to their main hotel, the "Bavaro Palace" to go to the spa, the nice restaurants, are shops ( the adult-only where we were staying only had 3 restaurants and a gift shop). While in Bavaro Palace, brace yourself as there is no AIR CONDITIONING in the stores!!!! It was unbearable, really. I found it hard to breath trying to shop!  Even the restaurants have poor air conditioning system, I mean poor, you'll be sweating. That was really a bummer! Beware of the excursions: they tell you it's a whole day affair. Sure it is! But you spend 80% of the excursion traveling: first by bus, then a small boat, then a katamaran. When you arrive at the island (we went to Saona)  you barely have two hours left to spend.  We got there , got a massage, immediately after, went to get in line as it was buffet time (several excursion groups were there, so be patient. After that, we had maybe 15 minutes to spend in the water before it was time to go. It was a complete disappointment. On the way to the island, after the 40 minutes  on the bus, the tour guide says  we'd arrive at this hotel for a bit so that you could use the restroom and  have coffee and croissants and to boot and open bar. All lies, we walked through the hotel, got on the boat and that's when they gave us coffee and croissants. The "open bar" was cheap rum, period.

reviews.title: Beautiful 🌊🪸
reviews.text: The beach/ ocean was beautiful. There was some seagrass but nothing that would make it not swimmable. You mainly just had to step over some to get to the ocean.We stayed at Riu Republica mostly everyday were yellow flags, the undertow was strong but still able to swim. I was surprised to not see many lifeguards at all. I saw one place that was so far down. Other resorts I have stayed at, the resort had their own lifeguards.  There are vendors walking up and down the beach selling everything. There are also police that patrol the beach. There are two men that walk up and down one with a huge bird and one with a monkey. They try and change you outrageous prices to take your pic with the animals. Always negotiate with them bc for $25 per animal is ridiculous 🤣. I know they're trying to make money, but one thing that bothered me was I never saw any water for them. And as everyone knows in the Dominican Republic it's hot 🥵 as hell. 😂 So hopefully they get water somewhere for them. The beach is what you make of it. Relax and don't sweat the seagrass. There are more important things to worry about in life.

reviews.title: Weeklong stay at beautiful beach resort!
reviews.text: We stayed for a week at this beautiful resort. The beach was magnificent and the facilities is clean and well kept. The beaches were not crowded and with their location the waves were never a problem. We received assistance from Giancarlos Moreno with blue travel partner services and he was great! He set us up with a fantastic snorkeling trip and a great deep sea fishing trip.

reviews.title: Perfect in most ways
reviews.text: Bavaria Beach Adults section was fantastic. Stunning beach with perfect weather every day. The staff is amazing and the room was beautiful. The only disappointment was that the food was not good. Just stick to the all inclusive cafeteria and keep it simple meaning fruits and veggies and fish. The restaurants were a disappointment. Food served cold and all of the soups were not good. Overall we had a great time and you will be pleased. Make sure you tip the servers at the pool each time they bring you a drink. I was amazed that guests were not doing this.

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: You can walk long distances along this beach. A  lot of hotels are on the beach as you walk along but as long as you avoid salesmen (who don't come over if you walk along in the sea) you can do wonderful 2 hour walks up the beach and even reach isolated areas. Some areas have seaweed. Very clean lovely beach

reviews.title: All in all very pleased
reviews.text: Really clean beach and locals are very welcoming.this is my 1st time coming to the Dominican and I have no complaints.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sandy beach
reviews.text: A beautiful white sandy beach but the sea was a disappointment because it wasn’t crystal clear or blue due to lots of seaweed everywhere. Maybe it’s the time of year for it .

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The beach was beautiful.  There was seaweed but it was cleaned everyday by hotel staff.  There were many boats anchored in the water, many of them trying to offer excursions from the beach.  Water was warm and clear.

reviews.title: Very beautiful palm lined beaches
reviews.text: The beaches at Bavaro are beautiful & allow one to take shelter from the sun under the palm trees. Lifeguards were on duty & a security guard was also in the area all day. The drawback this time of year was the seaweed which is prevalent throughout the Caribbean. Seaweed is a nuisance but the views made up for it.

reviews.title: i like
reviews.text: nice there service i like it very much. thanks for providing this for us. I also join with this. I share with some of my friends

reviews.title: Commercial area
reviews.text: full of street vendors who won't leave you alone, the beach is dirty and a lot of pickpockets, be careful.

reviews.title: All Depends
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach can be fickle! It all depends on Sagassum seaweed that is becoming more prevalent as the ocean warms. The beach can be beautiful or a complete mess depending on this. The other bad thing are the vendors and hawkers always trying to sell you someting....anything. Legal or not. Its a pain in the ass.

reviews.title: Great Beach
reviews.text: Lovely beach, super soft sand, hardly and shells. Great breeze, relaxing in the beach chairs. Waves were pretty big by the time we left - but ohhh the beautiful blue water! So clear - amazing!

reviews.title: Nice beach and flea market
reviews.text: Bavaro beach flea market was ok. The pricing was much higher than the local flea markets and they weren’t willing to negotiate as much.They do have white Hennessy but wanted $120US (only place I’ve seen it since we’ve been here) The beach was nice. We took a tour with a local tour guide on the beach for $100US to swim with sting rays, sharks, observe the dolphins, and swim in the natural pool, they promised a snorkeling spot which we never went to.They did let my husband drive the small speed boat to the dolphin holding place just off the beach. They did have options for party boats, parasailing, and an expensive restaurant (NOVA Beach Club) that wasn’t good in my option.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach / just a bit of seaweed
reviews.text: Beautiful Beach--not too deep for the kids nor too wavey. Just enough waves in the late afternoon to have fun in the waves. The Beach is kept clean but could probably clean the seaweed more often. In April the water was warm. We really enjoyed the beach here and have been here 3 times with my family.

reviews.title: We needed this get away
reviews.text: I love this place I go 3-4 times a year and I’m pleased most of the time. I will say eater sunday was a crowded noisy time to be on the beach in bavaro.  Already counting down the days til I get back there.

reviews.title: Beautiful Sands and water
reviews.text: Beach was the highlight of the trip, beautiful sands, tropical breezes, access to bar and lots of lounge chairs and shade trees

reviews.title: Babymoon vacation
reviews.text: My wife brought me to celebrate my birthday and babymoon. Joel Santana in the front desk was super cool and made us feel welcomed during our stay. We stayed in the adults only area of the hotel. The food in the Caribbean was great from breakfast to dinner. The beach was great, clean, little to no waves, the pool was good too. Security was great, they are cameras everywhere. The drinks at the bar was mostly cocktails and their top whiskey were black label so not a lot of variety there. We have been told Santa Fe was the best restaurant in Bavaro palace. The food there was ok. I honestly feel the Caribbean was the best restaurant in the hotel. Our room was good size wise, bed was huge, and in a good location close to the pool and beach. Animation was cool too, very entertaining, energetic, especially playing volleyball was fun. The bed in our room was extremely uncomfortable, seemed orthopedic catered for elderly people so every morning we would wake up with back pain. Cleaning staff were late cleaning our rooms two times during our stay they had to clean while we were there.  La brisa was like having leftovers from the Caribbean restaurant. The Chez gourmet was not good for us. Portion was small and taste was mediocre at best. Me and my wife had arrived two hours late to return the towel because we were getting spa massages in the palace. The spa was very good and relaxing by the way.I went back to area to return the towels but it was closed so I asked other staff where can I return the towels. I was informed I could also return the towels to front desk. The front desk Carlos I did not get his last name but he was extremely rude for no reason while I was returning our towels, he was more attentive to people working in the airlines and ignored me while I was first in line. From now on for any questions I had I would go to anyone but him because of this experience.During the trip I wish there was an area where people are allowed to smoke in the hotel. People were smoking in the bathroom, lobby, restaurants, beaches, and in the pool. It was a little annoying. Hopefully that changes. If you are a smoker then you would not mind but if you are not, you’re not going to like it. Overall it was a good experience, great vaca before our baby is born but I highly doubt I will come back.

reviews.title: White sands and tranquil turquoise waters
reviews.text: Beautiful white sandy beach, Turquoise waters and vibrant energy at the beach. There are many excursions and activities including glass bottom boats, Para sailing, cruises

reviews.title: Grand
reviews.text: Golf Course & Beautiful Beach & Pool Areas and service in these areas.Perfect Vacation, no problems getting to or from.

reviews.title: Third visit
reviews.text: Having had enough of the lockdowns, COVID fatigue, and just needing a break, we headed to the DR for some R&R! The resort was clean, friendly staff, smooth check in process and a well equipped room. We enjoyed each of the buffets and had the best al a carte at the steak house. The beach was white sand, blue waters, and no seaweed as several reviews seem to complain about. This was my third stay at the Bavaro property and each time there was never a problem.Golfing at the Lakes course located on site was our main draw and the course was well maintained, the staff friendly. The buffet at Hoyo 19 was closed due to COVID restrictions but we did enjoy cocktails afterwards. Overall another great visit and I look forward to another visit.

reviews.title: Lovely long beach
reviews.text: great long beach, really nice for long walks when we stayed at the Majestic Mirage. You do not often get uninterrupted stretch of nice sand for a few km's.

reviews.title: Beach heaven
reviews.text: Beach is awesome no rocks pure white fine sand, you are lying on a beach chair and staff will come from the bar pool are and offer you drinks.

reviews.title: A stunning Caribbean beach
reviews.text: Pristine white sands and turquoise sea. The sea is warm and crystal clear so snorkelling is absolutely brilliant.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world!
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beaches stretching for miles with coral-free access to the water.  Absolutely stunning!  Given the time of year, yes, there may be some grass washed up on the shore, but there are many workers cleaning the beaches every day.  The constant solicitation on the beach is annoying at first, but eventually the beauty of the beach will help you ignore them.

reviews.title: Nice very clean hotel
reviews.text: I was in the adults only part of this complexvery large you need to use the little train to travel around the other hotels in the complexlots of different resturants  to choice fromThe 2 buffer ones in this part where very goodif you need a boat trip just go onto the beach turn left and walk to the pier and small villageSecurity is very goodCould not understand why the disco was closed as in the Casino it was crowdedcoco bongos was very busy so could not see the reasongood hotel for adults only

reviews.title: The Scam Artist
reviews.text: I came back from Dominican Republic in February of 2022 and you thinks a resort of this caliber would care about their guest, that was a wrong conclusion.  The vacation was alright until we were about to leave. One very important is watch out for those nasty "COCK ROACHERS". The one we saw in our room was huge and I had to smack him with my shoe twice as my wife screamed out. The next day when I confronted customer service, they were pissed when I showed them the "COCK ROACH" in a clear bottle. It just shows they were not doing their job. The last incident was these so called PCR Test. We took one 3 days before we left the resort, the following day we all tested POSITIVE which I did not believe. So we immediately asked for another test. The following day that one came back as NEGATIVE. Go figure, so a few hours later I figured that were scamming us with the old double testing. This in my books is medical fraud. When I got home I contacted both SUNWING and ROYALTON. Both of them would not accept any responsibility what so ever for this type of blatant fraud.This only illustrates that they do not care about you the customer.  As of today I am not going to do nothing with Royalton Resorts. I am still fighting with Sunwing looking for a refund for our medical tests.

reviews.title: It’s nice but not the nicest
reviews.text: It’s nice but there are much nicer beaches. The water here is never calm. So if you are nervous in the water….there will always be lots of waves. Every morning was too rough to go in, but by noon it started to settle. No snorkeling here is it’s all sand and nothing to see with the waves constantly turning up the sand. Lots of resorts don’t take and clean up. A few do so just double check on the reviews. Locals trying to sell things are annoying. They start at 8 am and go until dinner time….everyday. You’d think after seeing you daily and asking you every single time the same question, they learn not to bother. Nope…wow😳 I prefer beaches in Aruba and grand cayman over this beach.

reviews.title: Best Beach
reviews.text: To me the best beach in Dominican Republic. Amazing sand, great water, no seaweed. Always seems to have lots of people walking the beach. Love people watching.

reviews.title: The beach was where we started each day after the wonderful breakfast buffet.

Lots of water sports and activities on offer, beach vendors are there but not too bothersome. It is quite windy, but to be fair it just takes the heat away from the sun making it bearable. Idyllic beach location, which is cleaned and debris cleared several times a day. Certainly one of my favourite beaches worldwide!

reviews.title: Blue water and Clean Beach
reviews.text: We chose Punta Cana because of the beaches and this didn't disappoint. Clear blue water, clean beaches and cool sand.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach

reviews.text: It was fairly quiet when we visited. May be busier in normal peak season. There are lots of sun beds (and plenty of beach sellers too! )

reviews.title: DR best beach

It's a postcard beach you see in ads with leaning palm trees, flour white fine sand and turquoise sea. Sea weed was present, but not that much and was cleaned regularly. Paradise.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Bavaro is the only beach we’ve been to in the DR, but it’s beautiful. Abundant clean white sand that is fairly level and continues well into the ocean.Mostly a string of all-inclusives along the beach, but the beach walkers were chill and there were few beach vendors to bother you.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach

reviews.title: best beach in Punta Cana

reviews.text: Wow, I have never been to a beach more beautiful than Bavaro Beach. The water was gatorade blue, yes I am not exaggerating. reviews.text: I had heard about beaches with super-soft sand, and now I know the myth is real.  I'm ruined for all other beaches.

reviews.title: Awful vacation
reviews.text: This place is less than desirable. The hotel and beach was dirty. The employees didn’t speak English. Not helpful in anyway. The food was awful. They had no idea what celiac was. We had diarrhea every single day we were there.  They really don’t like Americans. I would never travel to the DR again. Such a shame.

reviews.title: Nice Beach
reviews.text: It's beautiful and nice.  If you're looking for a beach for great photos and beautiful scene, this is the best spot on this side of the island.

reviews.title: Bavaro Beach is Amazing!
reviews.text: This beach is gorgeous! Even though it is the pacific ocean the water is turquoise like the carribean. The beach and water are white sand - so no rocks or coral to make it difficult to get into. The beach is soooooo long - and amazing to go for long walks. Depending on the wind - the wave are small to medium - so depending on where you enter the ocean it will be easier or more difficult to get into - but this allows for places that are fun to play in the ways or just to enjoy floating around or cooling off. Varadero beach in Cuba is similar - from what I can remember - it was at least 20 years ago. Long  - which sandy beach! There is a gentle slope for walking to which is amazing. I can't say enough about this beach. You can see huge waves breaking in the distance where the coral reef is - however I don't think that surfing is a big thing in the DR. There were kite surfers out most days though. No sharks cause of the reef around the entire island and also didn't see or hear anyone talk about any jellyfish either! Hope you get to see if someday - if you haven't already.

reviews.title: Lovely beach to stroll along and cool down in the water
reviews.text: Our resort plus quite a few others are based along this beach. It goes on for miles and is great to stroll along with your feet in the water. There are many others doing the same and this was our daily exercise. There’s also lots of water sports available.Swimming in the sea was very popular.All the sales people on the beach are extremely polite and friendly. They are all licensed, wearing the same colour polo shirts with their name and number on display. If you’re not interested, they immediately respect your wishes.My wife had 3 massages along the beach, set back a little behind the sign Kukua, who were very good and a third of the price charged at our hotel.There’s a lot of hotel security and tourist police patrolling the beach which always felt very safe.

reviews.title: Worst resort I ever seen.

reviews.title: Beautiful

Beach is very clean but there is a seaweed problem which is attended to daily.  Sea is warm and easily accessible.

reviews.title: Caribbean waters
reviews.text: Blue waters and fine, white sad. What could be better?Public with shops and massages, tour packages, excusions of parasailing, boat rides, pretty much anything you could want. Lots of resorts lined up and down. Pretty and picturesque. Total beauty.

reviews.title: Clean  Beaches

reviews.title: Looking for a Punta Cana Chauffer?
reviews.text: My husband is Dominican living in Punta Cana.  We are waiting for his visa to be processed to come live in the States.  We have been to many locations on Bavaro Beach.  It's beautiful with many establishments to eat and get chairs.  At different times of the year, there is lots of seaweed on the beach.  However, that's mother nature and once you hop over it the ocean is wonderful.  My husband, Freddy is driving for Uber and is the friendliest person (speaks great english) to get you around Punta Cana!  Text him on WhatsApp at 829-740-5528 for a personal chauffeur!   He used to be a butler at a resort, but since coronavirus business has been slow.

reviews.text: Before going to PuntaCana you sould know this. It will safe you time and money. You vacation could turn into s disaster in minutes

reviews.title: Friendly Staff and Lovely Resort
reviews.text: All staff were polite and courteous, and tried to provide helpful guidance. In particular, Jose went out of his way to make our days at the beach comfortable and pleasant.  He always answered our questions, provided sound guidance, and his English is excellente!

reviews.title: Nice beach

reviews.title: Amazing beach

reviews.title: Beautiful, but beware sellers
reviews.text: We visited Bavaro Beach in September 2021. There were lots of seaweed, but they have trucks cleaning it.Beware the sellers! They will ask you to come with them, and try to sell you overpriced souvenirs, activities, and even drugs. The "shopping mall" they try to take you is crowded with other sellers and some threatening people. Don't go with them, tell you're not buying anything, and safely continue your beach walk.

reviews.text: We did the horse back riding and the buggies. We had sssooo much fun!! We rode the horses through a country side. The buggies was more of a thrill ride. Prepare to be full of mud and dirt. But it was one of the most fun memorable experiences I have shared with my husband and my Children. If you are into a thrilling day definitely go for it. You will love it.

reviews.title: Too much seaweed

reviews.title: Dominican Fun with the Family!
reviews.text: Pros: Beautiful grounds , easy to get around , good drinks , fun beach activities, variety of restaurants, our room had an upstairs loft which we loved. A lot to do at night: casino, arcade , bowling , shops , sports bar  and a dance club . Two water parks which my daughter loved. Cons: excessive seaweed( you can smell it from the pool) buffet is under staffed and we often sat there without utensils.  They did not have a poolside grill and we could not take food from the buffet to eat by our chairs by the pool . (I saw people bringing food out but I was told by the manager no ! )Air conditioning in the restaurants didn’t seem to work well . A few nights it was uncomfortable during dinner. Some of the staff were friendly others not too much! Covid tests ( go early ) it gets busy . It took us about 21/2 hours to finish everything. Overall I think it’s a very nice resort !

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Only one word can save to describe this piece of paradise and that is beautiful. After almost 2 years of not taking a vacation, when we finally landed in the Dominican Republic and saw Bavaro Beach we almost cried, tropical paradise!!!The beach is lined with hotels and some are nicer than others, it can get crowded and noisy at different parts of the day at different times, but still, no complaints!

reviews.title: Escaped the Seaweed

We searched for some options and luckily found and post from Nancy xpo tours and contacted her. She arranged us a Saona Island tour with NO SEAWEED guarantee. Book through their web site XPO tour DR which went really smooth and next day we were on the most amazing beach I've ever seen.Thanks for the great day at Saona and please, hotels please clean your beach in front of the house.

reviews.title: The 2021 Pictures of Bávaro Beach they don’t want you to see
reviews.text: This is only my second time at Bávaro  Beach, Punta Cana and perhaps my last visit.First I want to mention that on my first visit, the Bávaro beach was a top 6 on my list of beaches I’ve visited, up there with Cancun, Bahamas, Negril Jamaica, etc. So I wanted to share this pictures with people planning to travel to the DR in the upcoming months, these are the pictures nobody wants you to see. Sadly, the entire beach is covered by seaweed, and I’m not talking about a leaf here or there, I’m talking about mountains of seaweed.There is no chance of getting in the water and this is not something that will be cleaned in the next 2 months. I had some locals who told me, “This is normal, it only lasts about 7 months when it happens” Long story short, check with your hotels before you travel, as this is not something they will happily disclose on their own.

reviews.title: Reality of Bavaro Beach
reviews.text: Bavaro beach is not on the Caribbean Sea, it is on the Atlantic… there for there is seafood everywhere.  If you want truly want crystal clear waters visit the area of Bayahibe.  The sand in Bavaro is beautiful as long as you are not at the waters edge.

reviews.title: Best place and best beach in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Amazing resort even with pandemic regulations.  They try there best to serve you.  Food is amazing and rooms are super comfortable, spacious and super clean.  The Barcelo Palace rooms are Junior Suites all of them, with jacuzzi in the balcony.  The premium level are just the new buildings that are the same and some have very closed beach front.  Pool is huge and they clean it every single night. I payed $25 dollars for a Covid test that was never asked for.  The only thing they asked for was a form of the CDC that if you don’t have it they will provided it at the airport.Restaurants in the hotel are great, and the buffets are amazing.  They don’t serve lobsters anymore, :( but the always have fresh seafood available every day.The beach is kids friendly.  It doesn’t have waves much.  It is just a natural pool.  I personally love it.  During this horrible aglae season the resorts cleans the beach constantly. I have been going to this resort since 2008 and I have experience other places and other resorts, but like this one so far none.

reviews.title: Mother Nature Seaweed
reviews.text: Mother Nature Seaweed, escalated from the past years because of the climate changes, takes the beauty of this and other beaches in Punta Cana area.

reviews.title: Quiet and Relaxing
reviews.text: Mother Nature was/is not kind to this beach at times.  The seaweed is massive and a daily problem.  HOWEVER, the staff at the resort work tirelessly to clean it up; seems like a loosing battle but I thank them for their efforts.  The palm trees provide a lot of shade for those who are not sun worshippers.  Perfect choice for your time in the DR.

reviews.title: Great Beach with seaweed problem

On the pool the attentions from Dolores, always taking care of keeping us well hydrated and always with the nicest surprises like fresh Mango and Pineapple, all just to make us feel at home. Felix in Reception was alert and ready to help and give us great and sound advice. reviews.title: Bavaro Beach Is The Real Deal
reviews.text: Cana means sugar cane in Dominican.  Bavaro Beach is 17 Km or so from Punta Cana, and it is the most famous beach in the area- and for good reason.  The texture of the sand is fine and granular.   It is cuppy when you walk on dry sand, but it is firm and does not "give" when wet, so you can easily walk into and out of the mild surf without having the sand sucked out from under your feet.  You can also take nice strolls along the beach due to the sand's firmness.  Bonus: The mild breeze keeps you from sweating when laying out on a beach deck chair.  We are staying at the Occidental Punta Cana (excellent-see separate review) and there are a number of other All Inclusives in the area.  This is a great beach to enjoy and relax on.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: We were looking forward to seeing this beach due to the reviews and information in blogs etc.  I think the people that give it five stars haven't seen a five star beach in their lives! Do t believe what you see on Instagram. I to can take Instagram worthy pictures, but in reality the beach is full of seaweed. I mean mountains of it! Some hotels try daily to remove it with a JCB. Then you have the fumes coming from that. Hotel resorts have taken over the beach. They try to stop you walking passed. But remember every beach in Dominican Republic is public. Just tell them that, it soon shuts them up. You can walk all along it as long as you don't use their sunbeds etc. Then you have the hawkers. Constantly harassing you to buy something or go on a tour.   We could only lay for 40 minutes to an hour before we had enough. It definitely wasn't the dream beach we were expecting, so very disappointing. Bayahibe beaches are well nicer with less hassle.

reviews.title: The beach  was beautiful
reviews.text: Was hard to get to water a couple times because of seaweed. It was beautiful. I did love the waves. Love it!!!!

reviews.title: Not what I expected
reviews.text: I was pretty disappointed by the following: 1. SeaweedThe amount of seaweed is insane, you can't even get into the water. Only one beach we saw that were cleaning it well, the rest are not cleaned much. 2. Every step you make someone is trying to sell you something The other thing I didn't like is that you can't just lay down on the beach or walk, every step you make someone is trying to sell you something and this can be really frustrating because they won't leave you alone even if you say "No, Thank you".  3. FoodIt's really hard to find a good restaurant with good & fresh food. We have been here for over a month and haven't found one. Food is bad, drinks are made of mixes and too sugary. 4. reviews.title: What you can do as you walk Bavaro Beach
reviews.text: I enjoy walking the beach for several reasons. One is to see all the resorts long our walk. Seeing how the ocean changes in color and in calm water to pretty nice waves. Being able to walk into the ocean as you walk along. Hearing a variety of languages from other walkers as the walk past and chat with their fellow walker. People from all over the world are at Bavaro Beach. So different in many ways, yet the same ... enjoying the sun and the surf of this beautiful beach. The joy of just being able to walk for a couple of miles or more if you choose and then being able to turn around and retrace your steps to your home resort. There are even several small restaurants where you could stop and get a drink or something to eat. Shops to purchase some trinkets to take back home as a remembrance of your trip to Bavaro Beach. If you are an early riser you could go down to Bavaro beach and watch the sun rise. I do this every chance I get. I take pictures of this quiet time when a new day begins on Bavaro Beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: We have been to Bavaro Beach, Punta Cana several times over the last 4 years.  We have stayed at Bahia Principe Ambar, Occidental Puna Cana and Bavaro Beach Resort and walked about a mile and a half in both directions from the resorts.  It is one of the nicest beaches we have found.  Some times of the year it has a lot of sargassum seaweed.  Last year, it had some severe storms and a lot of the beach and Palm Trees were washed away but the beach seems to be coming back.  Most of the Resorts have not reopened so the beach is not raked so it is not as nice for walking but you can walk for miles if you want.DR has changed it's requirements for tourists.  You do not need to get a COVID-19 test before arriving.  You must fill out a health questionnaire and they will do random testing of  passengers before immigration.  The resorts are doing everything they can to prevent the spread of all infectious diseases.   If you are afraid of getting sick, hide in your basement.  If you want to live go on vacation.

reviews.title: The Caribbean at its finest!
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is special...it was the first place I experienced the Caribbean sea and the pristine beaches that make it the paradise that it is. My first experience was that of a jet lagged tourist awake at 5am having only arrived to the Dominican Republic 7 hours before I was sat in bed, eyes wide open when I seen the sky turning to lighter shade of blue.I knew the likelihood of actually getting back to sleep was not going to happen, so instead threw on some clothes and strolled down stairs and onto the beach. It was quiet, cool and serene. Yes at that time of the morning there is some seaweed, but there are also teams clearing it with rakes ready for the busy day ahead.Strolling along the sand, it was already warm to the touch, scrunching between my toes it was soft and not grainy and rocky like you get in the Uk. I sat perched on the edge of a sun lounger and watched as a couple of other people walked along the waters edge and the maintenance teams cleared the seaweed.I sat and watched out to the sea whilst the warm breeze swept across my face and the sky turned from the light blue tone to a warm pink. After a few minutes the sun broke the horizon and glided across the rolling waves braking on the shore. It was relaxing and peaceful and a moment of bliss.Returning to the beach later in the day around 11am it was clear the quiet and peaceful time I had earlier that day was not going to be the case but instead the beach had transformed into a bright, vibrant and energetic place to be. Music playing, people sipping cocktails and swimmers galore it was a place to enjoy.Occasionally there are the odd sellers walking the shoreline offering cigars, photo's with animals but not often enough to become irritating and they were quick to move on if you were uninterested in their offering.This beach is the one to be at, I was very fortunate and was staying at a resort on this beach and as such enjoyed it at all times of day in its quietest and most energetic forms!

Great place for couples or a family vacation. It has around 7 restaurants my favourite one is The Japanese. Come to Dominican Republic and enjoy the weather, beach, good food and great people.

reviews.title: Unsurpassed
reviews.text: Incredibly beautiful. Turquoise water. Tides make the gold beach grow or shrink twice daily. Palm tree forests hide the buildings of the inland resorts. While sunbathing, walking, swimming in the ocean or sailing you may believe it is totally wild and natural all along the shore. Still very clean despite big crowds of vacationers sunbathing or walking along the waterfront. Cleaned daily by motorized teams. Spectacular sunrises, different every morning. Warm water all year around, swimming possible even in winter. Nice warm breeze eases strong insolation, occasional clouds are irrelevant. Make sure to wear sunscreen, hats  and other protrective clothes; many careless people with serious burns can be seen around!

reviews.title: One of the best bar none
reviews.text: Been to Bavaro 4 times now. Bavaro is one of the most beautiful white coral sand beaches in the world. You can walk it for hours it’s so long. Large sections are very wide so lots of room. There are a few small sections that have washed out from storms but they are isolated. Surf is not super rough due to the reef but it IS an ocean fills so there are always waves. Reef keeps sharks etc out so it’s very safe for swimming. Not many weeds and most resorts do constantly take what does wash up. Yes there are sellers on the beach in a couple small clusters of shanty style shops and they will approach you but they are not rude, just politely decline and keep walking and they will leave you alone. Once past the 500ft of shops it’s clear again for miles.

reviews.text: This time at TRS Turquesa was a fantastic 11 days of relaxation and service by a wonderful staff! It's difficult to share the most efficient butlers, but Randal and Jose definitely were our favorites. Jose spent an hour trying to find us a decent clicker for the TV... and always did things with a warm, wide smile! While there are a number of great restaurants available, we usually went to Helios... because the food was fresh, plentiful, and delicious; the buffet had too many dishes to count. Also was wonderful to see Jesus...  one of our favorite waiters.  Also love the 2 Hectors, Anito, and Wilvin. Can't forget our man Nilson - truly and "excellente" man! We loved the time on the beach and the drinks like Miami Vice that our server brought. Snooze, drink, have lunch on the beach...  someone has to do it!!!  The room was beautiful and spotless; the fridge was filled daily.Service was extraordinary; too bad it had to end. BUT: next year 2 weeks!  Can't wait

reviews.title: Amazing beach and water
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches! Water is clear and clean, an amazing place. We stayed at the Bahia Principe Grand Punta Cana. Amazing staff and beach.This all being said...The beach is flooded with mobile vendors, tour salesmen and ‘pay for play’ operators of parasailing, snorkelling etc.  Add in that there are multiple helicopters flying overhead constantly, I did not find the beach experience ‘relaxing’, but if you’re interested in getting your picture taken with parrots, monkeys and iguanas, you’ll be fine.FYI....EVERYTHING is negotiable. We asked about a parasailing trip for our family, started out at $90us per person, settled on $35 per, and I’m confident we could have gotten lower, but I felt dirty and greasy after the day, simply from all the real making and constantly being asked to buy something.My opinion only, I just didn’t like the constant barrage while trying to relax.Beautiful beach and water though, amazing, and I could tolerate just about anything to go see the sunrise each morning.

reviews.title: Purchased a day pass for the Barcelo Bavaro Beach Resort Hotel.
reviews.text: Purchased a day pass at the Barcelo Bavaro Beach Resort.  Be sure you tell the driver you are going to the resort.  A day pass will include private beach access and the resort is all inclusive.  You do not need towels, they will provide them. You will need a driver's license as you will have to pay at the security gate and they will put a band around your wrist. Drinks and food are included. My wife did not have her license but it was not a problem since I had mine.  Security guard was very friendly.  This is probably the largest buffet I have ever been too.  It was spread through several large rooms and the food is high quality.  The beach is beautiful.  There are a lot of people, but with the palm trees, sitting just off the water with the bar near by is fine.  This is well worth spending the day there if you are in port on a cruise like we were.  We were thinking about going back there for a week, but a couple with us had been to the Bavaro Beach Resort near Playa Del Carmen was much better.  Still when in Dominican Republic this is a great place

reviews.title: one of the best unique beach with different types of waves few feet apart
reviews.text: One the best unique beach of earth.This is beach where one experience meeting of Atlantic ocean and Carribean Sea. Its an awesome to experience this. As one walks on Bavaro beach from Barcelo resort up north to Secrets resort. Along the way one can observe and enjoy how waves are very less near Barcelo resort area with more carribean feel and how waves pick up a little around Lopesan resort area and more waves near Melia resort area and after that if one walks more north one can feel extremely high waves reflecting Atlantic ocean. This is one of the most unique thing one can experience only on Bavaro beach. depending on ones mood and requirement of waves, one can enjoy that part of beach suited to them as some may like less waves, some may like medium waves, some may be high waves typical to Atlantic ocean. I would confidently say Bavaro beach is one of the top best beaches of earth. The sand is sooo soft. walking on sand with bare feet feels soooo good. I would highly recommend Bavaro beach to every one.

reviews.title: To add to your travel bucket list
reviews.text: According to UNESCO, Bavaro is nothing other than one of the three most beautiful beaches in the world. Shining from the top of its prestigious podium, Bavaro Beach includes 40 kilometers of soft white sand and postcard views.We went for one week at Majestic Elegance, so we only enjoyed a small part of its length, taking daily leisure walks. Surprisingly, the beach vendors are not aggressive, and they take “No, thanks” as an answer. Don’t be shy to apply high factor sunscreen, and watch your step when is windy. In addition, if you have a disability, the waves may surprise you, watch carefully once in a narrow portion. Enjoy the safe and long stretch of luxury resorts.

reviews.title: Speed Boat Rentals on Bavaro Beach Update
reviews.text: Last year I was asked a question about boat rentals on Bavaro Beach.  I went back to the place rental boats are located.  In last years review I posted a very negative review.  The rental boats were trash, beaten hard and put to bed wet.  I was surprised when this October I was in the area and I saw that the owner must have seen my review.  He purchased 6 or 7 new boats. They told me they were built in Canada. I didn't take pictures showing the new boats.  But don't to excited.  They look wonderful from a distance but when you get closer you see they are starting to look beaten.  They sit just off shore all day long in the surf which is hard on the boats.  The people who rent them run them hard and the surf beats them up a lot. Don't get me wrong, these boats are 80% better than the boats they replaced but in the few months between when purchased and October they show wear and tear. The outboard motors are new and they are fast.  If you are going to rent one look them over before paying and pick one that is in better shape.  It was good to see they upgraded their fleet of rental boats.  I watched them launch the boats and the way they do it works for them but I would never use their method. They have a wood trailer and the put half of the boat on the trailer and a half dozen men will run it into the surf.  At the end of the day they drive the boats up onto the beach at high speeds.  I know that sand is not rock but constant running up onto a sand beach each night has to cause minor damage after a couple of years

reviews.title: Punta Cana As a Backpacker
reviews.text: I went to Punta Cana from Sousa during a backpacking trip through the DR. Once I arrived, I discovered that the public transportation in Punta Cana didn’t turn out to be terribly complicated as $40 DPO (.75 cents) got me anywhere I wanted to go in the regions surprisingly efficient public transportation system. My first run was a little rocky as I attempted to go to the beach and ended up at an outlet mall. However, once I got familiar with the area, I was able to go about wherever and whenever I wanted. Although the hotel wasn’t terribly impressive, the neighborhood that it was in, Fruisa, had pretty much everything I needed. There were two gyms, an internet café, and several ATM’s within walking distance to my hotel. There were also several juice and empanada stand within a two-block radius. Had it been closer to the beach, it would have been an area where I could see myself staying long term. I did finally make it to Playa Cortecito, one of the main beaches in Punta Cana. While it did have white sand beaches and aqua blue water, 95% of the beach was either closed off to the resorts or had motorboats zipping through the water. There was really no place to lay a towel down without being hassled by a security guard or an excursion salesman. However, I did eventually manage to find a bar where I bought a non-alcoholic Pina Colada for $200 DPO ($4 USD) which secured my access to one of the restaurants beach chairs. I ended up staying at the beach for a few hours before calling it a day. In between relaxing at the beach, I continued to do extensive work on the travel website which is getting more detailed and refined by the day.To say I survived the three days in the outskirts of Bavaro would be overexaggerating, nevertheless I was glad to finally be able to move out of the Hotel 2 Bavaro to the White Sands Bed and Breakfast closer to beach. I left the hotel yesterday at 11:30 AM. I hate traveling with my backpack because it automatically identifies me as a tourist and puts a target on my back for locals to hassle me or try to swindle me out of my money. I would face this problem not even 5 minutes after I left the hotel as I stopped to get lunch at the local empanada stand. I went to same place that I had been frequenting the last few days where the empanadas cost $20 DPO (.40 cents) a piece. I ordered two and gave the guy a $50 DPO bill. With my empanadas in hand. I sat there for about three minutes and waited for my change of $10 DPO (.20 cents). When it became obvious that he wasn’t going to give it to me I called him out on it. Even though there was a sign that clearly stated the prices, he (and his mother) tried to claim that there was a “tax” on the purchase. I might have believed him had I not come to the same stand at least five times in the last two days. I told him there was no tax and asked if $10 DPO (.20 cents) was worth getting the police involved. At that point he knew he was wrong and went to give me my change. I let him keep it because it was never about the money, it was about the principle and I had made my point. I caught the local bus from the central plaza to my new hotel. However, halfway through the drive, the bus pulled over and we were told to get off. It turns out that the bus caught a flat tire, and I would have to wait for the next one. As a result, I stood for about half an hour on the side of the road with my big touristy backpack. After turning down every moto driver in the city, the next bus finally arrived. I got to the stop and knew I was in the right place when I had to help 2 girls communicate with a moto driver because they didn’t speak Spanish. I walked about 800 meters when I arrived at the hotel building. I walked into a lobby and told the lady that I had a reservation. She was adamant that I didn’t and when I showed her the receipt, she said that was for the OTHER hotel located in the same building. After trying the “other” hotel, I found out that the building actually had four hotels in it and I didn’t find my hotel until the last stop. Despite the difficult in finding it, the owners seemed to be fairly nice people. The husband was an American white guy that spoke perfect English while the wife was Hispanic (not sure if she was Dominican). They actually gave me an “upgraded” room with a bigger bed. After settling into my temporary home, I spent the next few hours working on my website. The hotel was fairly close to the beach and while there was a nice comedor with cheap food, the beach itself was designed for tourist groups and there weren’t many chairs for lounging or relaxing. All in all, while I did get a more authentic experience than being in a resort, there are much better beaches in the Dominican Republic that are less touristy and corporate

reviews.title: Just beautiful
reviews.text: This was our first visit to the Dominican Republic and at the the Bavaro area. Reading some of the reviews on here we were wondering if we had made a mistake, especially about the seaweed. All I can say is we didn’t experience any real problems with the seaweed at all. There seaweed did tend to drift in a little but nowhere enough to bother us. Yes, there is a constant clear up operation in action from the locals with tractors but we thought this to be a positive thing. They take pride in their beach and do everything they possibly can to maintain it. I don’t understand why people have a fault with it. The sales people on the beach can get a bit tiresome and repetitive but we found none of them to be aggressive or challenging. They simply took no for an answer and moved on. We are looking at returning back to the Dominican next year and we will be definitely staying in the Bavaro beach region. The beach is stunningly beautiful and exceeded our expectations. I just wish I hadn’t taken so much notice of some of the petty comments on here. Please note the general amount of seaweed we encountered on our stay in my photos.

reviews.title: Gorgeous...but it also depends what youre looking for....
reviews.text: We took two tours to Bavaro, one to snorkel and the other to para sail...cant recall the tour company but I found them through concierge at Excellance El Carmen ( great staff, felt safe, and very reasonable prices, especially for the memories made!!) So we left our very quiet resort area and headed to the main beaches of Punta Cana and Bavaro. They are gorgeous, white sand, crystal clear water , small waves and ALOT less seaweed than on the Atlantic bay our resort was on...however...it is crowded, screaming kids, drunk tourists wearing thongs they have no ...and i do mean NO BUSINESS wearing any where near kids or anyone with eyes. There were alot of pushy vendors, which understandably are trying to make a living, but we were warned off by our captain and guides, suggesting that they might not be the most upstanding citizens to exchange cash with. As you travel from one location to another , You will find it impossible not to notice how lovely and kept the tourist areas are in comparison to the abject poverty that is a majority of the area.  Its a wonderful , beautiful, busy area but it seemed counterproductive to relaxation...so..if you're looking to party, family style and people watch...great place...if you're looking for quiet relaxation...not so much...

reviews.title: Beautiful resort, nice people, okay rooms
reviews.text: Apple Vacations dropped the ball on our late check in. By the time we got to our room, all the places to eat were shutting down and preparing for dinner. Our room's air conditioner broke and we spent the whole first night sweating in our room. They sent someone 2x at 11PM and 1AM and it was still broken. I complained the next day and demanded a new room. They upgraded us and we were satisfied, albeit losing a day of our vacation. The food was take it or leave it, with the afternoon snack bars the best options. The Italian restaurant was very good. The place is beautiful and the people are very nice and hospitable. The servers and maid services were just fine and the rooms were clean. The pool bars are fun but a younger drunk crowd was a little too much for our tastes. Oh and you can't get a good beer, only that El Presidente stuff, which tastes like tiger piss I'd imagine. And you really can't get good booze, I had to settle for Jim Beam instead of any good bourbon.All in all though, we had fun, a beautiful resort with friendly staff,good breakfast and awesome views. Tips: Don't spend too much time with your hosts, all they want is to make you spend. If something is not up to your liking, let them know but don't be the angry American. If you leave the resort on the beach side, wear your headphones, sunglasses and a hat to shield you from the relentless barrage of natives begging you every two seconds to buy their products.And if you do,haggle until you get the price you want

reviews.title: Royal Bavaro

I also loved that they only utilized plastic drinking cups so that glass would not hurt anyone if it were to break on any of the surfaces near the beach. The resort staff did an amazing job cleaning up after thoughtless patrons and keeping the lounge furniture nice and neat. They also did a great job keeping the seaweed from building up too much on the shore. Understandably though it’s hard to control nature but the water was warm so you can’t complain about seaweed when the beach and ocean were so beautiful. We had one person come up to us to partake in a water adventure but the solicitation on the beaches were not bad at all. We walked them quite often and were never asked anything or bothered. The armed patrolmen made you feel safe, but we had no problems at all even walking close to evening hours.
