reviews.text: If you like sand, sun and tropical waters, then this is the beach for you! Unreal sights to take in.

reviews.title: Family Trip
reviews.text: We stayed at the Iberostar Punta Cana and we had a wonderful time. It was never over crowded. There are quite a bit of vendors. I highly suggest negotiating prices.

reviews.title: Beautiful!!!
reviews.text: This beach was absolutely gorgeous! My friends and family had a blast. We were able to Parasail and Banana Boat from the beach. I highly recommend this beach to anyone visiting Punta Cana.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Excellent beach with minimal seaweed and many excursions available. Security present but not overbearing. Great walks!

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: I recently visited Bavaro Beach and it was love at first dip. This time around the beach was as clear as I’ve ever seen. I visited last year and it was plagued with seaweed and was a big disappointment. Having been to countless different beaches across the Caribbean this has to be in the top five. Just picture perfect

reviews.title: Buggies and beach ride
reviews.text: Fascinating time at this beach.  Many locals selling stuff the beach is clear and sand is soft.  Did the tour with atv biggies it was exhilarating.

reviews.title: Victor Almeida’s
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach 🏖 opposite the Bahia Principe Ambar was outstanding, clean, fresh , clear with lots of Dominican Republic 🇩🇴 fish, well done Bahia Principe Ambar staff & Management.

reviews.title: Beach of dreams
reviews.text: The beach was amazing, miles and miles of gorgeous well maintained sand beach. The oceans was wonderful not a lot of seaweed or current.

reviews.title: Beautiful white sand crystal clear water
reviews.text: Occasional seaweed is cleared away as quickly as possible. No rock on entry to sea but current can be strong

reviews.title: everything for people
reviews.text: unforgettably beautiful places beautiful weather friendly people you all like it here I am sure of it

reviews.title: Nice beach, calm water, lot of sellers
reviews.text: Enjoy a nice sunny day at the beach with some beautiful views.. but be aware,  a lot of people trying to sell you on buying hair braids, cigars, towels, coconuts..etc. and some may even put an animal on you and demand $40.00 like they did to me.

reviews.title: Bavaro Beach (at Catalonia Hotel)
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach (at Catalonia Hotel) is very nice and well kept clean. Of course when you walk outside of the resort area you'll see the beach as it is. With pollution of plastics, etc. and lots of sea grass.

reviews.title: Good beach
reviews.text: Nice sandy beach, the hotel cleared the seaweed all day and it was never an issue. The sea was warm and very few rock in it

reviews.title: Spicer
reviews.text: Nice beach swimming in beautiful clear waters food good beach was really clean not not a lot else I can say coconut trees to shade under someone comes around to see if you would like a drink coconut milk you have to pay

reviews.title: Nice Warm Water Beach with some Small Waves
reviews.text: I enjoyed the beach very much. The water was surprisingly warm. There were some waves. Catamaran was not easy to handle due to the wind and waves. But further south the water was calm. Just very pleasant to swim and enjoy the water.

reviews.title: Absolute paradise
reviews.text: The best Caribbean beach I have visited! Extremely clean, calm, and well maintained daily. Silky sands and crystal clear water. You won’t be disappointed!

reviews.title: Best part of our holiday
reviews.text: Absolutely loved this beach, the sand and the water were beautiful and perfect for sunbathing, swimming or just playing around.  We spent almost everyday for 2 weeks on this beach!

reviews.title: Outstanding beach!
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful beach I have ever been to. Have traveled to here 6 times in the last 25 years and it is still just as nice.  The sand is white and at least at the resorts I stayed at (5 different ones) always clean.  The water is crystal clear  and not rocky or full of seaweed.  Perfection!

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: In general very clean. But sam of the parts are full of seaweed, depends of the category of the hotel.

reviews.title: Veshma
reviews.text: This was a very good experience. The staff is happy, helpful and extremely helpful. Food was excellent and the options were plentiful. I would definitely return.

reviews.title: Sanichar
reviews.text: Very good resort .friendly and courteous staff staff, clean facilities the food was very very good. The entertainment was a blast. Lots of games, fun and laughter.

reviews.title: Magnificent beach
reviews.text: Finest white sand, wide and well maintained. The water is clear, we had seaweeds from time to time, but that was something you could live with compared to the beauty around you

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: White soft sand, beautiful sea.  It's fabulous with plenty of water sports, well worth a visit.Even when its coudy its still gloriously warm.  Plenty of sun beds and the Riu Hotels dotted along.

reviews.title: nice day at the beach
reviews.text: we had  great time here. its relatively clean and not too far. we saw some kids activities and some shops. but didn't really explore any shops. they didn't seem right. jet ski was a lot of fun too. great day at the beach!!!!

reviews.title: Beautiful and Relaxing
reviews.text: White sand, lots of activities for the kids.  Hagglers selling junk, but not to bad. Beautiful light blue ocean

reviews.title: 10 Km of Heaven
reviews.text: A very clean beach 10 km long.  Take some water with you if you plan to travel off the resort as you can't get it anywhere else

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is just lovely the sand is so white and  the sea blue and turquoise with parasailing and more beach activity’s for a fee .

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is amazing, this is the happening place to be, Bavaro knows how to party. The beach is very calm, relaxing and beautiful

reviews.title: Rather busy but lovely beach
reviews.text: The beach is powder soft sand and the sea, on a calm day, is crystal clear.  No rocks to hinder getting into the sea. Take some bread and watch the fish gather.  Bliss.

reviews.title: Beautiful and clean
reviews.text: Beautiful turquiose waters, the beach and sand is fine. Beautiful palms everywhere. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.title: No shells
reviews.text: Beautiful wide beach with sand as soft as new carpet. Only disappointment is no shells to hunt for; not even any pieces of shells. Lots of seaweed when we were there but still beautiful.

reviews.title: Clean beautiful beach
reviews.text: Our first trip to DR and this beach was very well manicured.  After reading plenty of reviews about the Punta Cana beaches being loaded with seaweed, I read this beach was different.  We were not disappointed!  Gorgeous white sand and minimal seaweed on the beach.  Workers were diligently clearing each day to rake away the seaweed so guests could enjoy the beautiful soft sandy beach.  We would definitely visit here again.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: The water at the beach was very nice & warm. The sand was so white and fine. The best part about the beach is that it’s very clean! I loved it! Let’s not mention the beautiful Caribbean sunset!

reviews.title: Majestic Elegance, Bavaro Beach, Punta Cana
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! A bit cloudy around May 19th-25th, rained a couple of times but it didn’t last long. Plenty of lounge chairs and cabanas. Not crowded at all during this time of year at the Majestic Elegance. Sun rises at 6am! Noon-2 seems to be the sunniest time at the beach. Nice long walks and visited other resorts. We 💙 Bavaro beach. Our 3rd time back in Punta Cana 💦💙⛱ Always a good time! ~Sheila & Justin~

reviews.title: Relaxing Beachfront
reviews.text: Walked the beach and relaxed a few hours a couple of days while in Punta Cana. The weather was perfect both days, enjoyed the beauty of it all. Just say “no thanks” to the beach peddlers; the only downfall to the best day at the beach one could have.

reviews.title: Not crystal blue
reviews.text: Although it looks so from pictures, the water isn’t crystal clear and blue, although still very beautiful. There is a huge seaweed problem but the sand is combed and the seaweed removed quite early in the morning.

reviews.title: Great beach
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful with white sand. You can walk the beach a long ways either direction. There are shops and restaurants nearby as well.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful clean white sand beach crystal waters great swim warm water loved every minute of it, I am not really a every day beach person but I spent a lot of my days there lots of seating and cabanas.

reviews.title: Polaris and Ziplining
reviews.text: We had a fun time.  I would rather have done the dune buggy with wet mud instead of dry dirt, but it just depends on the current weather.  It was fun though!  Zip-lining was great over the trees and then into the water, splash zone.  And the lesson on cigar making, coffee and cocoa was nice. The photos taken were a nice momento to a fun day!

reviews.title: Second Time Here- prob look farther next time...
reviews.text: My BF and I were here 3 years ago and it was spectacular! This time... not so much. The premium liquor we had at our first visit was not available on the Adults Only side at all- so we went in search and found that it is readily available at the Palace (main site) without an upcharge.  Our room was ocean front and the layout is still convenient- although the time has made the rooms much shoddier than I recall... mildew all over the bathroom grout, spotty housekeeping (swapped towels but didn’t sweep the floor), toilet required multiple tweaks to flush and not run constantly.Food went from great to average at both sides of the resort.Perhaps it is my age (42), but the MASSIVE amounts of plastic and waste without options to recycle just seem outdated- every drink has a plastic stir stick and /or straw....😳 no options to recycle copious water bottles consumed daily.Price is now ok versus my previous “great”.We had a premium package but overall did not really get us much outside of a different checkin with snacks and access to hydrotherapy at the spa. Grounds were less lush and cared for than previous visit-Good resort, but the overall quality has diminished.  Our excursions to swim with dolphins and ride dune buggies were great! Good run Bávaro! We will keep perusing for our next visit!

reviews.title: Great soft sand and beautiful water
reviews.text: Bavaro is my favorite beach in Dominica Republic. The Atlantic side is calm and the beaches are wide with lots of area to walk and swim. It can get busy but never overcrowed. Great place to people watch. there are beach venders but they are not overly agressive and juat trying to survive too. Seaweed anc be a bit of a problem but many of the resorts pick up seaweed daily and I noticed some have their own tractors to remove it. I wish they had more professional massage place like Mexico where it is $30 an hour for a message by a trained professional.

reviews.title: Took my breath away
reviews.text: What a beautiful place to remember why you’re in love, and to fall in love all over again... not just with others, but with yourself. We stayed at a hotel, less than 2 minutes walk to the oceans edge, and watched the sun set, and rise. Lovely, temperate water, always a perfect turquoise blue, and soft white sand. A little piece of paradise.

reviews.title: Graduation/anniversary celebration
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach. Staff worked very hard to keep seaweed down. Disappointed the ocean trampoline was down for service. That's why we picked this particular resort ,Dreams Palm Beach.

reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.text: This beach was lovely on one part then very Corroded the other side we stay at the Riu Republica and the beach was lovely but up royalton was not in great shape place lots of seeweed The photo are from end we stayed lovely the sea bit rough there so no jet ski etc  definitely like the post card looks

reviews.title: White sand and soft waves
reviews.text: The sand is beautiful and mostly clean.  There is a fair amount of seaweed that washed up each night but the resorts keep it cleaned up.  The water is beautiful and the waves are minimal.  Lots of beautiful palm trees line the beach and the sun rises over the ocean.

reviews.title: Some seaweed and foul odor
reviews.text: Figured I would put this review under the area and not the resort that we stayed at. The beach had seaweed that would come and go during our stay from 5/8-5/17. Some days it wasn’t that bad and others it was. There was an odor as well that came with it. Somewhat of a septic smell. I don’t exactly know what is causing it to get worse. There is always seaweed but not generally this much. Could be water temps. I noticed while diving that the reefs are getting bleached and and you can see the seaweed growing on them.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach, very clean!
reviews.text: The beach is very clean and lovely.  We always make sure that we are on this side of the island when we stay just for the beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful White Sands!
reviews.text: Bavaro beach is one of the prettiest beaches I have visited, however there can be a bit of seaweed during the peak season.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: I could lay on the beach all day. No seaweed and plenty of chairs to layout on.The waiters service on the beach was awesome. The breeze was perfect one of the best beaches I have been on.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Clean sand and gorgeous views!Just stay clear of the peddlers that want to charge $50 to take photos with their monkeys, lizards, exotic birds.

reviews.title: Bavaro Beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach.  Workers clean it every day for sea weed and debris. Beautiful sight of the ocean which is so nice to swim and play in.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: This beach is so nice.  The sand is soft, and not hot like other beaches I've walked on. The water is warm and relaxing. Vendors stroll along the beach selling local crafts and jewelry. I like that option.. saved me time from walking into town and being able to buy things right from my spot on the beach. There is some seaweed, but not like the kind that wraps around your legs, this kind just swept by to the shore.

reviews.title: Week in PC
reviews.text: great clean, walkable beach. water was very warm and just the right amount of waves. it does get shoulder deep pretty quick.

reviews.title: Perfect sand, clear water!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach - whether to sit or take a stroll, it is relaxing! There are vendors throughout the shore to sell various items, if you so desire.

reviews.title: Beautiful Bavaro
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches anywhere. With soft white powdery sand and turquoise water, what more could you ask for? There's also ample palm trees for shade if the sun gets too hot. You can't go wrong in choosing to spend time on Bavaro Beach!

reviews.title: Best beach ever!!!!
reviews.text: I been to several beaches including Montego Bay Jamaica and this beach by far out ranks them all. They water is so clear and still and the sand is so fine it didn’t even bother my daughter who hates beaches.

reviews.title: epic photos and sunset
reviews.text: I am a true beach lover and boy oh boy the beauty of this beach was spectacular. very clean beach except for the washed up seaweeds. lovely views, many activities on the beach, lovely shade area if you like and refreshing cool Caribbean breeze. Take my advice and wait for the wonderful sunset you could ever see. trust me. water had strong currents so be careful. besides that its beautiful and enjoy. thank me later

reviews.title: You most see that!!!!
reviews.text: You most see that!!!! Very beutiful place! There sunshine was wonderful!!! We loved this beach very mach!!!

reviews.title: Not a beach lover
reviews.text: Not a beach person but the beach is a nice refreshing place to relax. Tons of seaweed that washes up on the sand but to be expected. Watched the sunrise one morning. Nice blue water

reviews.title: Bahia Principe Amber in Punta Cana
reviews.text: Can’t finds a better all inclusive in the Caribbean!The rooms , staff and restaurants are fabulous.Can’t say enough about this resort🏝

reviews.title: Absolutely beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, bright blue waters, soft white sand, goes on for miles, never feels too crowded. Loved it

reviews.title: Awesome Bavaro Beach
reviews.text: White sand, warm water and miles of beautiful beach for romantic walksThe water was as warm as a pool. The beach was actually pretty clean of sea weed

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Miles of white sand and blue ocean. There is the issue with seaweed but you'll find that all over the Caribbean.Lots of vendors along the beach but they'll leave you alone if you ask them to.

reviews.title: Dolphin swim
reviews.text: Spent a whole morning with the offshore dolphin aquarium, were we learned of the dolphins and swam with them tickled them and kissed them bye bye, then over to the nursery shark pool for a snorkel with the rays and sharks, fantastic staff, great team of trainers and well worth the visit

reviews.title: Excelente Lugar
reviews.text: An excellent place to spend the holidays or for a trip in itself a place and pleasant to take the family or the companion

reviews.title: Kittiwat Lertpenmaeta
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Punta Cana. Very clean, sand is beautiful and white. The water is clean and crystal clear. It is located near many large all inclusive resorts in Dominican Republic.

reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: went to the beach as part of an excursion. Beach was not clean and locals were very aggressive with solicitation

reviews.title: Gorgeous!
reviews.text: We walked about two miles each way.  One way was full ofresorts and the other had undeveloped land. Sunrise is at 6:00 I highly recommend going!

reviews.title: Stunningly beautiful beach/ CONSTANT undending stream of vendors
reviews.text: Fantastic beach marred only by the fact that you cannot get a minutes rest due to the constant stream of vendors plying their wares.  "No thank you" doesn't deter them, they come back again and again and again.

reviews.title: Soft Sand
reviews.text: Not the widest beach I've ever been on , but one of the cleanest for certain. Lovely soft sand with the occasional bit of Coral. No problems with hawkers as they move on if you say no thanks. We walked in both directions from where we were located and not too much seaweed present end of April / start of May. Lovely beach

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: The beaches were pretty with wonderful light colored sand.   Great Caribbean locale.  Xoxoxo.  Would return.

reviews.title: Could be nice ...too many solicators !
reviews.text: Nice beach but too many vendors ... a lot of seaweed ...expected it to be better more relaxing and beautiful ...

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Absolutely a must go and see! This is probably one of my top beaches I love everything this beach has to offer. I know the seaweed at time is a bit much but your at the ocean its not like you can control this

reviews.title: Soft Sand Beach
reviews.text: Every time when I travel to Punta Cana, I select a hotel that is located on the Bavaro beach. Beautiful, bright and soft sand, nice and usually calm waters, not good for surfing but great for everything else (paddle boarding, water bikes, kayaking and so on), and that extensive walkable stretches of beach.

reviews.title: Dirty beach
reviews.text: Did not like the beach that much because it was dirty. Some areas were clean but most of them were dirty and smell disgusting.

reviews.title: Beautiful!!!!
reviews.text: Wow!!! Wow!!! Sensational Speechless just amazing if you visiting Dominican Republic is a must!!!!!White sand,clear waters!!!I highly recommended!!!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text: The resort was spotless, the staff was amazing, and the fact that you could go from resort to resort to try different buffets and bars was great. We went adults only and couldn't have been happier. Beach was beautiful and clean as well. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Depends on the time of year
reviews.text: Love my sea water but Bavaro can have challenges depending on the time of year.  Some parts of the beach experience a lot of sea weed where others do not.  In early spring the Rip Tides and high waves are there making it hard to enjoy but Dec-March is a perfect time to enjoy the beautiful beaches and almost clear waters.  Never found the waters like parts of Cuba or Barbados that are crystal clear but overall a beautiful place.  I have seen on average 2 weddings per day on the beaches here and this is only at 1 resort.

reviews.title: Entertainment
reviews.text: Solani is a great entertainment manager. She makes every day so much fun!Very kind and helpful!Thank you so much!As for the hotel - its amazing!It has so much to do: restaurants, shoping, evening shows, very good customer service!I strongly recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to visit Dominican Republic.🌴

reviews.title: Impressive premium resort and spa
reviews.text: Trip of a lifetime- I have never met such amazing and friendly people The weather was perfect and the beaches are well cared for

reviews.title: Vacations
reviews.text: The beach is good very very beautyful, the services is very good, bartenders, the housekeeping, the food is delicious, the drinks are very very nice, and the receptionist are very friendly and helpful, the people who work at the beach are very helpful, and the disco is very nice I enjoyed..........

reviews.title: Bavaro Beach was impeccably clean and well maintained. All the employees were extremely kind and caring. My forst time
reviews.text: Wonderful service, all inclusive means ALL inclusive- even minibar! Wonderfully maintained beach, great cuisine, versatile activities and friendly faces. I liked the adults only feature too.

reviews.title: Like something from the TV
reviews.text: We stayed at the IBEROSTAR hotel, the beach front was amazing... clear blue seas, spotless beach.  Depending on the waves, the beach varied from gently sloping to gently sloping 10 1.5 M the dropping off to more 2 M.

reviews.title: beautiful beach
reviews.text: The sand was soft and had zero rocks. You can walk far in both directions.  Blue and green color. Rough waves.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Stayed at the Occidental Punta Cana and absolutely loved it The water was clear and warm and the beach was amazing

reviews.title: Bavaro beach is simply stunning
reviews.text: all for running, walking, bathing, but nothing to see when you snorkle, there is no sealife, seen 1 fish in 12 days, which was eaten by a pelican, Turists pushing wildlife away

reviews.title: Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: Bavero Beach has some of the most breathtaking views I have ever seen. The water is so warm and inviting. Clear and turquoise waters as far as the eye can see. Very clean beach. The sand is like powder. Very comfortable for walking. You can walk for miles and miles and not be disappointed. Lots of opportunity for water sports. Parasailing, kayaking, paddle boarding, boating, snorkeling...you name it! My most favourite beach that I have visited. Will definitely be back. See you soon.

reviews.title: Beach fun
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with miles of white sand. The beach is busy with people. Nice for tge children to play.

reviews.title: White sands
reviews.text: This is the best beach on Caribbean islands , few miles long, nice for walking and its safe. its is quite busy and you can buy from native sunglasses, cigarettes or hats.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: Lovely turquise water. Some would complain about the seaweed on the beach making it less pretty in photos, but fair play to them: They have security and clean up crews on the beach all day every day 👍

reviews.title: stunning beach
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach is by far one of the longest and most beautiful beach.  You can walk for miles every day

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!!
reviews.text: This beach is amazingm has beautiful soft powdery sand and the views are amazing and lots of beach to walk. love this beach will be here again definately!

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: Bavaro beach is absolutely gorgeous. Crystal blue water and very small waves make it perfect for even families with small children. The constant gentle breezes make it comfortable in 85+ degree heat. The sand is fine and there are no rocks anywhere. The gentle waves make for a very wide and gradual slope.One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited.

reviews.title: In true honesty not the top beach in the DR.
reviews.text: Bavaro Beach and the Bavaro area is ok.  The beach is nice but not a top beach in my view.  I have seen many beaches in the DR and I can think about 20 beaches that are much nicer.  I personally will put beaches in the Samana area as one of the best beaches in the DR.  In my view, Bavaro is oriented for the first time visitors.

reviews.title: Secrets Royal Beach Preferred Club
reviews.text: On arrival you hear “Welcome Home”, champagne served, and top-service. Like arriving in Paradise. Massive pool-beach porch, Like a week of total Calm. Food not far, not spicy, weather in April was 83 daytime, 73 night, nice breeze, white sugar sand beaches. Can’t be beat. A definite return site for sure.

reviews.title: 6 times 2 plus one
reviews.text: we have been visiting the carribean to differant spots for over 25 years,and we have found bavaro beach to be one of the best there is ,soft white powder sand very calm waters,and the beach is almost flat which means its very good for long walks as it won.t make your back sore and its a beautiful long beach,strewn with lots of palms along the way,beauty in paradise

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach!
reviews.text: This is a very beautiful beach, clear water and white sand.. a great place to relax and enjoy the nice weather of the DR!

reviews.title: Bavaro beach
reviews.text: Heaven on earth! Amazing, although were was alot of seaweed, but the water was warm and the beach was white sandy warmth and goodness 😁

reviews.title: Beautiful Sunrise.
reviews.text: We were here for our nieces wedding but managed to watch the sun rise a couple mornings, which was beautiful.  The beach was very clean and you could always find a lounge chair either in the sun or in the shade. We were never bothered by people selling things which was really nice.

reviews.title: Wonderful excursion
reviews.text: Awesome trip snorkeling was out of this world. Loved the dine buggies. Party cove was awesome. Drinks were great

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Royalton Bavaro on Bavaro beach and the beach is gorgeous!  The sand is very fine.  Sone seaweed, but a beautiful beach.

reviews.title: Soft sand and warm water.
reviews.text: If you like soft sand between your toes and warm ocean water, then this is the place for you! Try it.

reviews.title: Spring Break
reviews.text: Beautiful blue waters. White sandy beach. Lots of water activities to do. Lots of seaweed in water and on beach.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: The family and I explored the beach just off of the property of the Royalton. Beautiful sand, not too crowded, and not a vendor in site trying to sell us anything. We happened to be there as a wedding was happening. And it was a very pretty site.

reviews.title: Great Beach, Regularly Cleaned.
reviews.text: Really nice beach, clean and tidy, entry to sea good, can have good walks along, not much shade as not many palm trees at the waters edge, but good shade just off the beach, we spent a lot of time on the beach, good swimming.Recommended.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Lovely clean beach. A few vendors but they ask you once and then leave you alone. There were a few shops at one end

reviews.title: Spring break in Punta Cana
reviews.text: This is an excellent resort for couples and families. Lots of activities, good restaurants and a lovely long beach

reviews.title: Barcelo brava palace
reviews.text: Just got back. Beautiful place and the beach was awesome. Spent 7 days in the sun and on the beach with my wife, 16 daughter and 14 year old son.  The water is calm and beautiful we swam non stop. There is no snorkeling so don’t try. Seaweed in not bad a all but there is patches of grass in parts. Sand is white and soft it’s  Paradise. Be carful sun is hot hot hot as in all islands. Trade breeze is a life saver. Things to know if you have teens and want them to stay young! Topless women and thong back bottoms are on the beach! 10% of the absolutely beautiful women are topless daily! Not the locals but the tourist.  My 14 year old son grew up a lot this week. We saw 4-5 lady’s daily with no tops and at least one person (men and women) per day changing at the beach generally with a robe or towel hardy covering themselves. Seem stupid to me because bathrooms are 12’ away.  Tuesday we had a stunning beauty that was sitting 5’ from us drop her bottoms bend over and put a dry pair of shorts on. This was a full and clear shot directly in-front of us. By the time shock value wore off and I looked at my son it was to late! That poor kid ended up sun bathing his back for an hour, if you know what I mean. She turned around and faced us and took her top off and put a shirt on. She just smiled and walked off. This is not that weird I saw things like this all week just not at that distance.   My daughter was not kept from the naked body either. Men in short shorts with their junk falling out were daily. We had a guy 10 chairs away fast asleep one day with his legs up and his full penis out had fallen out of shorts. He had a dozen lady’s infront of him taking pictures and videoing. I wanted to tell him but didn’t, he made Some Interesting home movies I’m sure hahaha. Beach chairs are gone by 9:30. I throw my towels done every day at 8:30 and went to breakfast. We had no issues. The local market on the beach in not for the faint at heart. It’s overwhelming for sure. Lots of aggressive vendors. But as long as you expect it it’s fine.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world
reviews.text: You will not regret visiting Bavaro Beach.  The white sand and aquamarine and turquoise colored water will leave you breathless. It's a safe, and clean beach and a few spots that offer various water related activities.

reviews.title: Water was MAGNIFICIENT
reviews.text: this was a beach we stopped at during our boogie ride. absolutely beautiful. The history behind the beach and location was so enlightening and interesting.

reviews.title: Beautiful Beach
reviews.text: What we like most is the beautiful wind sands, little shops on the beach and is so calm - a must to walk each day for a great, relaxing time.

reviews.title: Very nice stay at the Royalton
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel for 7 nights in January (sorry for the late review). We had an awesome time. It was our second stay at a Royalton (we stayed at the Cancun one before). The hotel is very clean, very modern and well situated on the Bavaro Beach strip. We had a few issues - not really affecting our 5 star rating - but wanted to share. We were assigned a room that was an adjoining room (but we were not travelling with another party). I am not sure if that is the reason we could hear every single noise from the other room (as the connecting door may have affected the room soundproofing) but it was awful. The room next door housed 5 people, which at least 2 were children (1 a baby) and we could hear the baby crying at all hours of the day and or night. We could hear coughing, talking,etc. It was quite annyoning and we eventually asked to be moved. The staff was willing to switch our room. We have never been to a hotel where noise was an issue. We were on the 2nd floor... and we could hear noises coming from the 3rf floor (floor above us). It sounded like they were moving furniture or moving/dragging stuff on the floor. Not sure if this is a poor construction issue or an issue of guests being disruptive and or excessively noisy.  The 2nd issue we had was the kids. There were kids EVERYWHERE. By everywhere - I mean, we were tripping on them at the buffet restaurant, tripping over them at the nightly bar/disco area YES !!  At the infinity pool (not the kids pools) kids were crawling everywhere. I thought that by having a very nice children’s pool, a lazy river and a shaded wading pool that we could at least get some peace and quiet at the infitinity pool. NOPE !  I am not sure if this is a hotel that caters to children, but we have never been to a hotel where there were kids everywhere at all times. We sat at a late dinner at the Italian restaurant and a father was singing a lullabuy to his baby, rocking its stroller (at 10pm!).   The food was very good. The buffet was very ordinary. Good variation and ok selection. We’ve just had better buffets at different hotels. The a la carte restaurants here though were all above average and all excellent. We had excellent steak at Hunters (and we never get steak down south for obvious reasons but this was recommended to us and it was delicious). We went to the Italian restaurant twice because it was that good ! The Martini Mix bar was excellent. Great selection of martinis and the staff were so nice and friendly ! A big shout out to Miguel Angel (makes the BEST Peach and mango martinis!) and Osivis Cabrera. Best service ever !!! All in all, we would recommend. The hotel is extremely clean, nice decor, nice beach, nice staff, good food and drinks. Don’t hesitate to book !PS we also visited the other Royalton Punta Cana. It seemed a bit larger, nicer and had more boutique options inside the main area. If having to choose between both of these I would probaby go to the Royalton Punta Cana - but that one seems to be more expensive.

reviews.title: Warmest and Bluest Waters I have ever seen
reviews.text: As we were looking for a place to go on our girls' getaway, we tried to find a place where we could fly non-stop and where the beaches and water would be blue. We got a lot of advice and they all said, if you are going to the DR, YOU MUST STAY ON BAVARO BEACH. So, we made reservations at a hotel on Bavaro Beach. I can tell you that we did not spend too much time in the pools. The sand is as soft as powdered sugar...having had been to many Caribbean locations and beaches, I can honestly say that I have never felt sand this soft in my life. Not only soft, but clean and white. The ocean was as blue as I have ever seen it...maybe close to the Bahamas, but still absolutely gorgeous. No matter how deep you go, you can see clear to the bottom, which is white sand. There are some little reefs, if you want to snorkel and see fish. We swam out to a beautiful sand bar  and enjoyed sitting out there in the beauty of it all. We went parasailing and kayaking....the water was incredible. On another note, we didn't have any one hassling us on the beach to buy things. I have always had this experience at other beaches at resorts and islands previously visited. It was nice and quiet....going for a walk without feeling hassled and safe was also awesome. We will come back here again and again, FOR SURE.

reviews.title: Great beach, shame about the rough sea !!!
reviews.text: We were staying at the RIU Republican in bavaro for two weeks. We are beach & sea lovers. The white sand beach is a great beach, that you can take long walks in either direction. Every hotel has its own section of beach & you know when you come to the public beach as there marked out of bounds. I use to walk out of bounds all the time, it’s perfectly safe, but the rubbish at the back of the beach is chronic to say the least. The hotel beaches are cleaned every morning, the out of bound ones are never cleaned, which is a shame for locals who like to go to the beach. The other draw back was the sea, it was very rough to say the least. Global warming winds have not helped the waves in this part of DR & there’s the tropical storms that hit the Caribbean. September is the worst month of the year for storms in the Caribbean. We had none in late June & early July. It rained a few times but mainly at night time & it’s  always warm with or with out sunshine. One warning about the sand, from mid day onwards it can get boiling hot depending on the amount of sun, so it’s hot on most days. The wet season is May to November, but it’s not a monsoon, it can rain for 10 mins then the sun is back out. Plus quite a lot of rain is in the evening, which is ideal. If your a Brit TuI only fly to punta Cana now, which is a shame as the sea & beach in puerto plata are outstanding. Plus starting from May 19 TUI are putting all exit taxes in the Caribbean on the ticket price. So that’s when my next Caribbean holiday will be, where depends on the best deal !!!

The water is warm, with heavy seaweed in certain spots. Seaweed is raked off some parts of the beach with regularity (but why did they do it in the middle of the afternoon right in front of my lounge chair every day?). Also a lot of activity in the water close to shore-- parasailing, booze cruises, etc.

reviews.title: Definitely use again  4.5*
reviews.text: First time to Punta Cana, Barcelo guest for last 6 years, mainly in Mexico.  Rooms were nice sized, ours well kept.  To my surprise, no liquor in the mini fridge here, and beer stocked every other day, unlike Playa Del Carmen.  Beaches are Beautiful,  Pool was nice, clean, STAFF VERY FRIENDLY.  Had a slightly harder time communicating but that is on me, I know very few phrases in Spanish, they were definitely more bilingual than I.  Buffet's were good, more variety every other night even would be good.  Restaurants were all very good to me, some I liked better than others.  I will return during non-spring break month and suspect 5 stars will be a non-issue.  oh yah, check in and check out, a breeze, unlike Mexico which can become very time consuming, at least in my experience.  Only reason for not giving a 5 star is the food, which is a tough one I know when trying to satisfy so many different nationalities and taste buds.
